jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer (Kubernetes, CI/CD)
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will stand up and operate the delivery pipelines and cloud infrastructure that carry federal systems into production, keeping all of it secure and automated. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Expect your first project to put assigned delivery pipelines squarely in your hands, along with the environments under them. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Create secure, cloud\-native infrastructure in Amazon Web Services (AWS), develop the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines used to deploy to that infrastructure, and maintain both. * Capture that infrastructure in code, using Terraform or CloudFormation. * Build security into the delivery path with static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST), software composition analysis (SCA), vulnerability scanning, and secrets management. * Support the workloads that run on Docker and Kubernetes, and run down faults in infrastructure, networking, deployments, and security. * Script the repeatable operational work, and automate provisioning and releases so that health checks and rollback are built in and every run produces its compliance evidence. * Put National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\) controls in place, and keep authorization and continuous monitoring evidence up to date. * Use Python, and Bash when appropriate, to automate the work; speed it up with AI\-assisted tools; and improve the quality of everything that ships. Every pipeline you deliver enforces the required controls and hands release review the evidence it needs. You strip every manual step from the release path and build progressive delivery with automatic health checks and rollback, until a deployment is a non\-event. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 4\+ years of experience in DevSecOps or platform engineering * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline * Practical experience creating security\-gated CI/CD pipelines in AWS\-native tools (CodeBuild, CodePipeline) or in comparable tools (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) * A background in standing up Kubernetes clusters and running them * Practical work containerizing applications and creating Docker images, plus infrastructure as code in CloudFormation or Terraform * Vulnerability scanning, along with automated security testing like SAST, DAST, and SCA * Ability to program and script in Python (Bash skills a plus) * Proficiency working in Linux operating systems and writing shell scripts * Strong knowledge of networking, including routing and load balancing, along with application programming interfaces and the way web applications are architected * Using Git to track and manage versions * A background in both logging and monitoring * Experience generating code, reviewing it, and validating it with AI\-assisted development tools, for example GitHub Copilot * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * A background in secrets management using tools such as AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or a similar product * A federal security background covering NIST SP 800\-53 control implementation, Authority to Operate (ATO) support, and support for Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance * Certification from AWS **Who you are** From day one, security and reliability are part of your work, since a federal environment leaves no room to treat them as afterthoughts. You replace other people's manual work with automation and leave an audit trail as you go. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * Hands\-on, owner\-level work on assigned CI/CD pipelines built with AWS\-native or comparable tools, plus the Docker containerization, infrastructure as code, and Kubernetes clusters used to deploy real systems in AWS or in on\-premises environments that clients manage. * Command of Linux in practice, and of how web applications interact with networks, so you can trace faults below the pipeline. * Pipeline security skills, among them least\-privilege design, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and automated security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA). * Python scripting that reaches past pipeline configuration, backed by Bash, to automate whatever the tools leave out. * Judgment fit for building in settings that demand security and auditability. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $140,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description: **About the role** As a Developer Relations Engineer your focus will be technical content, demos, and distribution. Your work will help developers and researchers discover AC2, understand what they can build, and put it to work. You’ll work directly with researchers and engineers, run experiments yourself, and turn the results into useful technical resources. You’ll define our DevRel strategy and standards, with the opportunity to hire and lead a team as the function grows. **What you will do** * **Build runnable demos and cookbooks.** Show developers how to train a decision model, evaluate a router, or deploy a trained checkpoint. Include code, sample data, expected results, and explanations that make each example reproducible. * **Explain our technical work.** Partner with researchers to publish technical articles, walkthrough videos, and interactive demos. Explain the methods, results, tradeoffs, and limitations so developers can judge where an approach is useful. * **Own distribution.** Get technical work in front of relevant developers through X, GitHub, developer communities, and collaborations. Experiment with topics and formats, and use the response to improve what we create and where we share it. * **Educate developers.** Run workshops, livestreams, and office hours. Speak at relevant events, and build a tutorial series spanning evaluation, training, and deployment. * **Help developers succeed with AC2\.** Help new organizations get set up, run their first evaluation and training job, and interpret the results. Turn questions and recurring problems into resources other developers can use. * **Improve the developer experience.** Improve quickstarts and troubleshooting guides. Bring specific, reproducible problems to engineering and help prioritize improvements. **What you bring** * A strong engineering background. You can independently build, test, and debug useful demos and example applications. * Hands\-on experience fine\-tuning and evaluating language models. You can explain your training setup, evaluation design, and what you learned from the results. * A track record of clear technical writing. You have published articles, tutorials, documentation, or other work that helps developers understand and apply technical concepts. * Experience getting technical work in front of developers, and an interest in experimenting with new ways to reach and teach them. * You listen closely, welcome technical feedback, acknowledge uncertainty, and enjoy helping developers work through problems. * The judgment and initiative to define priorities, take projects from idea to publication, and build a function that can grow beyond your own work. **Strong candidates also have** * An established audience among AI developers, particularly on X / Twitter. * Previous experience as a founder or at an early\-stage startup. The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$175,000–$250,000**. Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast\-growing startup, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, interview performance, market data, and work location. The listed salary range is intended as a guideline and may be adjusted. **About us** ============ Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence for the enterprise. We provide the continual learning infrastructure for companies to build agent workforces trained on proprietary data and institutional expertise. Our researchers and platform embed directly within customer environments to build custom evals, train models, and deploy agents that get better with use. * **Why we’re excited:** We get to work at a rare intersection. Our product team builds the platform powering a new generation of digital coworkers. Our research team pushes the frontier of post\-training and reinforcement learning. Our applied AI team sits side\-by\-side with customers as they ship agents into production. This combination of strong product, deep research, and boots on the ground is what we believe it takes to bring AI to the enterprise. We are product\-led, research\-enabled, and forward\-deployed. * **Who we are**: We’re a team of engineers, researchers, and operators. Many of us are former founders. We've built RL infrastructure at OpenAI, data foundations at Scale AI, and systems at Together, Two Sigma, Watershed, and others. We work with F50 customers and are fortunate to be backed by partners like Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia, Lux, and Greenoaks. * **Who Thrives Here**: We're looking for people who are excited about applying novel research and complex systems to real\-world problems. Our team genuinely enjoys working with customers: listening, empathizing, and understanding how work actually gets done in their organizations. Former founders, people who've built a lot of side projects, or anyone who's shown they can own something end\-to\-end, tend to do well here. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401k match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer II
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Epia Neuro is a neural technology company developing intent\-driven systems designed to restore function and independence for people living with neurological conditions. Its platform integrates implantable neural interfaces, adaptive algorithms, and assistive devices to translate neural intent into real\-world action. The company's initial focus is stroke\-related motor impairment, with expansion into cognitive decline and other neurological disorders, focusing on long\-term solutions for the growing aging population. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Firmware Engineer II who is passionate about developing and testing embedded software for medical devices. You'll contribute to the design, implementation, and testing of firmware for our implantable neural interfaces and external devices, working across the embedded software development lifecycle—from hardware bring\-up and device drivers to application development, integration, and verification. This is a hands\-on engineering role combining strong technical skills with exceptional attention to detail. You'll work closely with hardware, software, and research teams to build robust embedded systems that meet the demanding requirements of regulated medical devices. **What You'll Do** ------------------ *Embedded Firmware Development* * Design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ for implantable and external medical devices. * Develop device drivers, communication interfaces, and application\-level firmware for microcontroller\-based systems. * Implement firmware features involving hardware peripherals, real\-time operation, custom ASICs, and communication protocols. * Develop Python scripts and applications to interface with embedded devices for testing, debugging, and characterization. * Participate in firmware design discussions and code reviews, contributing to software quality, reliability, and maintainability. *Hardware Integration \& Testing* * Support hardware bring\-up, firmware integration, and troubleshooting of embedded systems. * Debug hardware and firmware issues using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, and other laboratory equipment. * Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated tests to verify firmware functionality and reliability. * Collaborate with hardware, software, and research teams to integrate firmware with the broader medical\-device system. *Regulated Development \& Documentation* * Develop firmware within our regulated quality management system and software lifecycle, contributing to requirements, design, verification, and documentation consistent with ISO 13485 and IEC 62304\. * Document firmware designs, interfaces, test procedures, and verification results to support development and regulatory activities. * Investigate defects, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to improve firmware quality and reliability. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\+ years of professional experience developing embedded firmware or embedded software. * Strong proficiency in C/C\+\+ for microcontroller\-based embedded systems. * Experience with microcontrollers (e.g., ARM Cortex\-M), hardware peripherals, interrupts, and embedded communication protocols such as UART, SPI, and I2C. * Experience with Python for scripting, automation, or embedded device testing. * Experience debugging embedded systems using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and hardware debuggers. * Ability to read schematics and understand basic digital and analog electronics. * Familiarity with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) and embedded software design principles. * Experience using Git and participating in collaborative software development. * Strong problem\-solving and communication skills, with attention to detail and the ability to independently develop, debug, and test firmware features and collaborate across engineering disciplines. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with Nordic Semiconductor nRF microcontrollers, the nRF Connect SDK, and Zephyr RTOS. * Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), USB, or other embedded communication interfaces. * Experience developing low\-power, battery\-operated embedded systems. * Experience with automated firmware testing, unit testing frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines. * Experience with static code analysis tools and embedded debugging tools such as Segger J\-Link or GDB. * Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated or safety\-critical systems. * Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, or medical\-device design controls. * Familiarity with secure firmware development and medical\-device cybersecurity requirements. **Physical Requirements** ------------------------- * Ability to work on site, including hands\-on testing with prototype devices, laboratory equipment, and participation in hardware bring\-up and integration sessions. **How We Work** --------------- * **We are intentional.** We prioritize and are thoughtful about how we use others' time. * **We care for others.** We prioritize safety both for patients and one another. * **We own outcomes, not just tasks.** Our work demands the highest standards because it impacts real patients and real lives. * **Humility is a strength.** We are honest about what we know and what we don't know. Getting it right matters more than being right. **Location** ------------ This role is based in Alameda, CA, on site 5 days a week. **Benefits** ------------ Full\-time employees are eligible for the following benefits: * Competitive base salary with equity * 100% of healthcare coverage for you and your dependents * Generous vacation policy * Paid parental leave * Work from our waterfront office in Alameda, CA, with access to collaborative spaces and labs Compensation Range: $115K \- $140K

jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will share in operating the automation, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and secure cloud infrastructure that keep federal systems running. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first project** Expect your first project to put you shoulder to shoulder with engineers, on pipelines a team leans on every day. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Contribute to the Terraform or CloudFormation code that defines infrastructure. * Under senior engineers' guidance, develop and maintain deployment automation and pipelines. * Pitch in on running Docker containers and Amazon Web Services (AWS) environments, from orchestration to monitoring and logging. * Wire vulnerability checks, security scans, and policy controls into the delivery pipeline. * Turn repeatable operational tasks into Python scripts, reaching for Bash or PowerShell when those suit better, and close out every finding that comes back. * Take a hand in mapping and implementing National Institute of Standards and Technology Special Publication 800\-53 (NIST SP 800\-53\) controls, and automate the evidence that shows compliance. * Bring AI\-assisted tools into your pipeline, testing, and scripting work, and verify every output they produce. Code review sees every change you make, and you walk reviewers through the change and your reasons. That is where you learn what makes a change correct, not just that it runs. You automate the team's manual tasks, and you build your share of a practice that designs security in from the start instead of bolting it on later. This is where you start, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of experience in software development, platform engineering, or operations engineering * A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, engineering, or a related technical discipline * Practical use of one or more pipeline tools, grounded in a working knowledge of CI/CD concepts * Ability to write scripts in Python (Bash or PowerShell skills a plus) * Familiarity with Docker and containerization, together with the cloud services AWS offers * Exposure to tools that express infrastructure as code, for example CloudFormation or Terraform * A basic understanding of how containers are orchestrated * Experience with the fundamentals of Linux * Knowledge of web applications and application programming interfaces, together with networking concepts and load balancing * Grounding in the principles of cloud security and in practices for delivering software securely * Skill at tracking down and resolving problems in infrastructure and in deployments * Experience generating and reviewing code with AI\-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * Prior work in information technology for the federal government * Exposure to one or more of these areas: Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, NIST SP 800\-53 controls, or Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) compliance * An AWS certification or practical experience delivering production workloads on AWS * A background with security tooling or vulnerability scanning, for example dynamic application security testing (DAST), policy\-as\-code, or static application security testing (SAST) **Who you are** For you, security and reliability belong in the build from the first commit, never in a final gate, and you are eager to grow into an engineer whose automation replaces other people's manual work and leaves an audit trail. When you hit a wall, you ask rather than guess. Feedback is your fastest way forward, and when priorities move, you move with them. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A grounding in cloud fundamentals, networking, Linux, scripting, and delivery automation, and an appetite to dig deeper into security. * Delivery habits in secure configuration, code review, automated testing, and version control, or a willingness to build them quickly. * Clear, plain updates: what you have finished, where you are stuck, and what you need. * The care to hold up where accuracy and auditability cannot slip. You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. The technical assessment is a Python coding exercise. **Benefits** This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

jobs.title: Principal Digital Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Purpose:**Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next\-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high\-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high\-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification. With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high\-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench\-assisted planar technology to provide industry\-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium\-voltage grid and infrastructure applications. We are seeking a Principal Digital Design Engineer to join our fast\-growing, collaborative team. The ideal candidate is self\-motivated, energetic, and able to thrive in a high\-growth, innovative environment, contributing directly to technologies that are shaping the future of power electronics. **Key Responsibilities and Duties:*** Design and implement digital blocks for ASICs using Verilog/SystemVerilog and standard ASIC design flows. * Participate in pre\-silicon simulation and verification using Cadence tools and standard cell libraries. * Develop and maintain UVM/SystemVerilog testbenches, including functional coverage models, assertions (SVA), and constrained\-random stimulus. * Own coverage closure: analyze code and functional coverage, find gaps, and drive improvements in existing verification suites. * Apply formal verification where it fits, such as property checking, connectivity, and register and FSM verification. * Build mixed\-signal verification using real\-number modeling or AMS co\-simulation to verify digital\-analog interactions. * Support ASIC tape\-out activities, including synthesis, static timing analysis, and design signoff. * After silicon returns from the foundry, focus on developing FPGA\-based test builds (using Xilinx tools) to validate and characterize fabricated PMIC silicon. * Interface and integrate digital control logic with analog/mixed\-signal blocks commonly found in power management applications. * Own digital architecture specs from product requirements through tape\-out. * Lead design and verification reviews, and follow coding, verification, and methodology standards set by the team. * Mentor junior engineers and provide technical direction across multiple projects. * Lead post\-silicon debug and root\-cause analysis, and feed silicon learnings back into design and verification. * Evaluate and improve design and verification flows and tools to increase team productivity and reuse. * Write and maintain automation scripts for regression testing, build flows, and hardware validation. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including analog designers, layout, validation, and test engineers to ensure robust and reliable PMIC design. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Characteristics (KSAO’s)*** Digital design principles: synchronous/asynchronous design, FSMs, clock\-domain crossing, reset strategies, and low\-power techniques. * ASIC flow from start to finish: RTL, synthesis, STA, DFT, equivalence checking, place and route handoff, and signoff. * Verification methodology: SVA, functional and code coverage, constrained\-random testing, and formal verification concepts. * PMIC and power electronics basics: DC\-DC converter control, sequencing, protection and fault handling, trimming, and how digital logic interacts with analog blocks. * jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Agents
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Sr. Software Engineer, Agents **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Head of Engineering ### **About Plug** Plug is the marketplace for used electric vehicles. Consumers get an instant cash offer backed by battery\-health data, and dealers across the US bid in real time on that inventory. Former Tesla executives founded Plug in 2023\. We’ve raised a $20M Series A led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. ### **Why Plug** * You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You’ll be part of an AI\-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes. ### **The Opportunity** Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Much of that work can be done by agents. We already run LLM features in production, and our engineers own the core platform: the marketplace, pricing, and the systems that tie them together. What we need now is someone who can turn a stream of real operational problems into agents that work reliably, one after another. ### **What You’ll Do** * Build and ship agents and multi\-agent workflows for operations, dealers, and sellers: document extraction, inspection and title review, dealer and seller communication, and internal tooling. * Use LangChain and LangGraph to build agents, and LangSmith or Langfuse to trace, debug, and evaluate them. * Write evals, build datasets from real cases, measure accuracy and failure modes, and make regressions visible. * Integrate agents with the services the team already owns, through clean APIs and tools. Work within the existing architecture and raise design concerns with the owning engineer instead of routing around them. * Monitor agents in production: cost, latency, error rates, and human\-review rates. Fix what breaks and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time. * Ship full\-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them. * Help the rest of engineering adopt the same patterns. Build reusable tools, examples, and short write\-ups that make the next agent faster to build. ### **What You’ll Bring** * 5\+ years of full\-time industry software engineering, with a track record of shipping features to production and supporting them after launch. * Strong TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed. * Hands\-on experience building LLM features in production: tool use, retrieval, structured output, and above all, evaluation. * Experience with an agent framework and observability stack, ideally LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse. If you’ve used something else, show us what you built and how you knew it worked. * You work agent\-first. You’ve built your own tooling around coding agents, such as skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals. * Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan. * A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up. * You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit. * High agency in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup. You find the most valuable workflow to automate and ship against it without waiting for a perfect spec. * BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience with document\-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance. * Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products. * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop review tools, or with fine\-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features. ### **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $175,000 to $200,000 Salary ranges come from independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). Relocation assistance will not be provided for successful candidates. Sponsorship not available at this time. **Acknowledgments** Plug is an equal opportunity employer. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, military or veteran status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Plug will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring and the California Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Staff Applications Engineer (Integrated Voltage Regulators)
jobs.description: **Job Purpose:** Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a next\-generation power semiconductor leader driving innovation in gallium nitride (GaN) and high\-voltage silicon carbide (SiC) technologies. Our products enable faster, more efficient power delivery across AI data centers, high\-performance computing, energy and grid infrastructure, and industrial electrification. With more than 30 years of combined expertise in wide bandgap technologies, GaNFast™ power ICs integrate GaN power, drive, control, sensing, and protection, delivering faster power delivery, higher system density, and greater efficiency. GeneSiC™ high\-voltage SiC devices leverage patented trench\-assisted planar technology to provide industry\-leading voltage capability, efficiency, and reliability for medium\-voltage grid and infrastructure applications. We are seeking an Applications Engineer \- Integrated Voltage Regulators to join the IVR Business Unit and own the system\-level performance of integrated voltage regulators from the lab bench through customer board evaluation. The role develops evaluation platforms and reference designs, validates IVR performance under customer\-representative conditions, creates application collateral and customer model kits, supports design\-in and bring\-up, and converts customer requirements and field learning into product\-definition and roadmap input. Our IVRs combine power transistors, digital control, inductors, and capacitors to enable Vertical Power Delivery (VPD) and Embedded Power Delivery (EPD) for AI accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, and custom ASICs.**Key Responsibilities and Duties:*** Develop and execute system\-level test plans for single\- and multi\-IVR power delivery under customer\-representative conditions, including load transients, current sharing, power\-delivery\-network impedance, sequencing, protection, and fault response. * Build processor load\-emulation platforms, dynamic load boards, and test vehicles that demonstrate IVR performance before customer silicon is available. * Benchmark IVRs against competing power\-delivery solutions to identify product differentiation, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities. * Use and extend the team’s shared automation framework to deliver repeatable system\-level measurements and data analysis. * Perform board\- and package\-level PDN and power\-integrity analysis, including DC drop, AC impedance, parasitic, decoupling, and transient droop. * Build circuit\- and system\-level IVR models, including control\-loop stability and interactions among parallel regulators, and correlate simulation results with lab measurements. * Assess thermal and mechanical integration with processor cooling solutions in collaboration with thermal specialists. * Define, design, bring up, and validate evaluation boards and reference designs, working with internal and external PCB designers from schematic and layout requirements through system validation. * Deliver complete design packages, including schematics, layout guidelines, bills of materials, test procedures, measured results, and configuration of GUIs or scripts. * Develop scalable multi\-IVR demonstration platforms for high\-current processor applications. * Lead customer evaluations and design\-ins with xPU vendors, hyperscalers, and ODMs by reviewing architectures, schematics, layouts, package and board stack\-ups, identifying risks, and supporting bring\-up and debug. * Collaborate with OSATs, substrate suppliers, and embedded\-component PCB fabricators to enable IVR integration in vertical and embedded power\-delivery designs. * Author application notes, design and layout guides, datasheet application content, design calculators, and customer model kits covering circuit simulation, PDN, and thermal behavior. * Present customer technical reviews, train sales and field teams, position IVR technology within the grid\-to\-xPU power chain and translate customer requirements and field learning into product\-definition and roadmap input. **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Other Characteristics (KSAO’s)*** Deep knowledge of DC\-DC conversion, particularly synchronous and multiphase buck regulators and high\-current point\-of\-load power delivery. * Ability to analyze control\-loop stability, transient response, efficiency, current sharing, sequencing, protection, and fault behavior. * Hands\-on proficiency with oscilloscopes, current probes, electronic loads, power analyzers, and network analyzers for loop\-gain and impedance measurements in low\-voltage, high\-current systems. * Ability to correlate circuit, PDN, thermal, and system simulations with laboratory measurements. * Strong understanding of PDN and power\-integrity fundamentals, including parasitic, decoupling, high\-current distribution, package interactions, and board stack\-up effects. * Ability to define schematics, review/perform PCB layouts, and bring up and debug complex power hardware. * Proficiency in Python\-based lab automation and data analysis, with working knowledge of version control such as Git. * Clear technical writing skills for application notes, design guides, datasheet content, test reports, and customer\-facing documentation. * Confident customer communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work across engineering, sales, field, packaging, substrate, PCB, and product teams. * Self\-motivated, hands\-on working style with sound technical judgment and the ability to execute effectively in a fast\-growing, collaborative environment. **Required Qualifications****Basic*** BS in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least 5 years of experience in power\-electronics design, systems engineering, or semiconductor applications engineering. Levels may be adjusted to Senior Staff level based on depth and scope of experience. * Demonstrated experience with synchronous or multiphase buck regulators, high\-current point\-of\-load systems, control\-loop stability, transient performance, and efficiency optimization. * Hands\-on experience using power\-electronics laboratory instrumentation in low\-voltage, high\-current systems. * Circuit simulation experience using SIMPLIS, SIMetrix, LTspice, PLECS, or equivalent, including correlation of simulation with measurement. * Experience defining schematics, reviewing PCB layouts, and bringing up and debugging power hardware. * Track record of producing clear technical documentation and presenting technical results to customers or cross\-functional teams. * Willingness to travel for customer engagements, on\-site bring\-ups, and industry events. **Preferred*** MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering with emphasis in power electronics, power management, or power integrity. * Experience with integrated voltage regulators, Vertical Power Delivery, Embedded Power Delivery, or advanced point\-of\-load architectures for AI accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, or ASICs. * Customer\-facing semiconductor applications or design\-in experience with hyperscalers, xPU vendors, or ODMs. * Experience with PDN and power\-integrity tools such as Ansys Q3D and/or SIwave, Cadence Sigrity, or Keysight ADS, and thermal tools such as Ansys Icepak, COMSOL, Simcenter Flotherm, or Cadence Celsius. * Knowledge of advanced packaging, package\-level power distribution, embedded components, or substrate co\-design. * Experience with digitally controlled multiphase regulators, current sharing, and interfaces such as PMBus, I2C, I3C, AVSBus, or processor VID protocols. * Familiarity with data\-center power architectures, including OCP rack power and intermediate\-bus converters, and with GaN or SiC power stages. * Working knowledge of semiconductor\-device characterization and statistical analysis is sufficient to support product\-engineering activities. **What We Offer*** **A front\-row seat to the future of power electronics.** Work on cutting\-edge GaN, SiC and integrated voltage regulator technologies that are transforming AI data centers, electrification, and global energy infrastructure. * **A fast\-paced, high\-energy environment**. We move quickly, make decisions with purpose, and empower employees to take ownership and drive real impact from day one. * **A team that shows up and delivers.** We care deeply about our mission, our customers, and each other. We collaborate, support one another, and bring intensity and accountability to everything we do. * **Full support to succeed.** You’ll have access to leadership, cross\-functional collaboration, and the resources needed to innovate and execute at a high level. * **Competitive total rewards.** Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited PTO, and a competitive compensation package including base salary, bonus, and equity awards.

jobs.title: Head of Tax
jobs.description: **About Arca** -------------- Arca is a wealth management firm built from the ground up with AI. Most people get financial advice that's reactive: an annual check\-in, a plan that's a document instead of a living thing, a relationship where you're one of three hundred clients your advisor is trying to remember. We think that's backwards. The kind of service that used to require a team of specialists behind you, the kind that makes you feel like the only person in the room, should be available to far more than the ultra\-wealthy. So we're building it. We're not SaaS — we are the wealth management business, rebuilding it from the inside with AI. Our platform is an Iron Man suit for advisors: it takes over the low\-leverage work so they can focus on what actually requires a human, showing up with empathy, context, and judgment. Underneath, it keeps a living understanding of each client. It remembers the thing you mentioned once, six months ago. It notices when your life changes — a new job, a new kid, a market shift — and adjusts before you think to ask. You won't see the technology. You'll just notice your advisor seems to know you better than any financial professional ever has. That's the product we're growing: client by client, on the strength of the experience itself. We started by acquiring firms managing over $1B in client assets, which gave us real advisors, real clients, and real financial outcomes to build against from day one. But acquisition was the starting line. The bet is that an advisor backed by this platform delivers something good enough that clients come to us on their own. It's a $20T market, and we think it's ready to be rebuilt. — Rron, CEO **The receipts** ---------------- * **Stage:** Series A, $64M raised * **Backed by:** General Catalyst, Index Ventures, Venrock * **Board \& Advisors:** Former CEO of Vanguard, Former CFO of Schwab, Founder of Altruist, Morgan Housel (author of The Psychology of Money), Will Guidara (former co\-owner of Eleven Madison Park and author of Unreasonable Hospitality) **The team** ------------ We’re small on purpose and engineering heavy: about 80% of the team is technical. We’re based in NYC and hail from high growth startups like Stripe, Ramp, Rippling, Plaid, Doordash, and Glean. We’re fully in\-office in Flatiron, five days a week—lunch together, coffee breaks, basketball games, happy hours. **The role** ------------ As Arca's Head of Tax, you'll build our tax practice from zero — the first tax hire, with a blank page and a mandate to make tax a proactive part of clients' financial life. Tax is where most of our clients feel the most friction, feel the most uncertain, and get the least help. A scramble for documents every spring, a preparer who sees one year at a time, and a wealth advisor who's never quite looped in. We think tax should be continuous, coordinated with the rest of the plan, and done ahead of the deadline instead of after it. You're here to build an AI\-native tax practice from day one including the document gathering process, return preparation and review, client projection/planning before a client thinks to ask, and more. You'll design what the agents do, where a professional's judgment has to step in, and ensure end\-to\-end quality. This is a hands\-on role involving return preparation, directly helping clients on their most complex situations, partner closely with our wealth advisors so tax and investment advice move as one, and own the service as a business: pricing, revenue, capacity, and the team you'll hire behind you. Most of your time goes to two things: doing the tax work and designing the platform that does it better, sitting next to the engineers who build it. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **The tax practice.** What we offer — starting with individual returns (1040s) and year\-round planning, projections, and notices, and expanding to business returns (S\-corps and other entity returns) for clients who own businesses — who it's for, and the standard every engagement is held to. You set the scope, the service model, the quality bar as well as selecting vendors (core tax return software in particular) to enable the business. * **An AI\-native tax process.** End\-to\-end design of how tax work gets done at Arca — document collection, data normalization, preparation, review, filing, and post\-filing. You'll work side by side with engineering and product to build it, and be the domain authority on every workflow. * **Clients.** You prepare, review, and own returns for clients whose situations take real expertise: stock options and RSUs, business income, S\-corp owners, rental real estate, and multi\-state filings. You explain tax in plain English and give clients confidence their needs are handled. * **Partnership with our wealth advisors.** Tax and investment advice as one plan, not two silos. You work with advisors on tax\-loss harvesting, Roth conversions, charitable strategy, equity comp exercise timing, and with  the kinds of questions the first year of this practice has to answer.* * **Tax season without the scramble.** We already manage client accounts and know most of their financial picture. What does it take to have 80% of a return assembled before a client uploads a single document — and how do agents chase the remaining 20% seamlessly? * **Where the agent stops and the professional starts.** An agent can reconcile a 1099\-B in seconds. It probably shouldn't be the one deciding how to treat a messy ISO disqualifying disposition. Drawing that line, and building a review layer that makes AI\-prepared work more reliable than the traditional kind, is the core design problem. * **Tax as a year\-round signal.** A client gets a bonus, sells a rental, or exercises options in July. How does the platform notice, rerun the projection, and get the right recommendation in front of the advisor while there's still time to act? * **One plan, two disciplines.** Every rebalance has a tax consequence, and every tax decision changes the investment plan. Designing how tax and wealth advice move together, inside one system, is what makes the model work. **The kind of person who thrives here** --------------------------------------- *You’re excited by ownership, ambiguity, and building things that matter.* * **You're a licensed tax professional.** Active CPA license required, with 8–15\+ years in individual and high\-net\-worth tax experience at a top firm, family office, or planning\-focused practice. You've prepared and reviewed complex 1040s yourself and signed off on others' work. Equity compensation, rental real estate, and multi\-state are familiar ground, and you're comfortable with the business returns that come with owner\-clients: S\-corps, partnerships, and C\-corps. * **You're a change agent.** You've stood up a practice, introduced a new service line, or materially improved ways of operating. You take initiative, operate independently, and have driven impact and results. * **You're AI\-pilled.** You already use AI in your work and have strong opinions on which parts of the tax process it should own. You don't need to write code; you need to know exactly what's slow, what's error\-prone, and what a great system would do instead — and enjoy working next to the engineers who build it. * **Clients and advisors trust you.** You can sit with a client and make a complicated situation feel simple, and you see wealth advisors as partners. Experience working alongside a wealth management or RIA practice is a big plus. * **You hold a high bar because of what's at stake.** This is people's money, their filings, and their standing with the IRS. "Good enough" means something different when a mistake shows up as a notice in someone's mailbox. * **You're someone people actually want to be in the room with.** This is a small team, one office, five days a week, working on problems that don't have clean answers. Kind, direct, and low\-ego, you can give candid feedback without being a jerk, and you're genuinely energized by this environment. **Why now is the moment to join** --------------------------------- *This is a narrow window with unusually high leverage.* * **You're the first.** No legacy process, no inherited tools, no one else's practice to fix. Whoever takes this on defines tax at Arca. * **The clients are already here.** We have real advisors and over $1B in client assets on the platform, and more firms and advisors joining. You're building a practice with demand on day one. * **The platform is live.** Agents already do real work for our advisors. You get to extend a working system into tax rather than wait for one to be built. * **Tax is the next chapter.** As Arca expands from wealth management into tax, estate planning, insurance, and beyond, tax is the first step. The patterns you set become the template for every service line after it. **Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k), and more. Compensation Range: $175K \- $250K

jobs.title: AI and Image Processing Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ASP Health is an early\-stage commercial company working to develop and bring to market novel medical devices. We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer specializing in medical image processing, software development, and AI to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in computer science, mathematics, and engineering, with a focus on developing and optimizing algorithms for image analysis, enhancement, and recognition. This role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and testing software solutions that process and analyze images of cytology and pathology slides, from image acquisition through AI\-assisted assessment. It will involve collaborating with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, develop innovative solutions, and ensure the highest quality of software deliverables. If you are passionate about image processing and eager to contribute to cutting\-edge projects, we would love to hear from you. We offer a competitive salary and benefits package to full\-time employees that includes health/dental/vision, company\-paid life insurance, optional medical/dependent care FSA, HSA, 401k, and many other benefits. Our team enjoys paid holidays and paid, flexible PTO (paid time off) as well as an adaptive work schedule. **Duties** * Develop, optimize, test, and validate image processing models/algorithms/software. * Create, maintain, and improve image processing systems, libraries, and frameworks. * Work with cytopathologists to design annotation protocols and manage labeled image datasets and annotation workflows, including integration with annotation platforms such as CVAT, data quality auditing, cloud storage, and traceable dataset versioning. * Design model validation studies with appropriate data splits and clinical performance metrics (e.g., sensitivity and specificity for sample adequacy), ensuring consistent performance across sites, operators, stain batches, and devices. * Conduct performance analysis and optimize models for real\-time, on\-device inference (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, embedded GPU), meeting defined latency and reliability targets. * Develop and maintain cloud\-based AI infrastructure (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)), including data storage, compute resources, automated data pipelines, resource optimization, and model deployment workflows. * Develop and maintain production software that integrates AI models into the company's imaging platform, connecting image acquisition, inference pipelines, prediction metadata, image visualization, and clinician\-facing user interfaces. * Build, optimize, and troubleshoot GPU\-accelerated training and inference workflows, including multi\-GPU training, checkpoint/restart functionality, memory optimization, and performance benchmarking. * Design, develop, and maintain production Python applications, including backend services, APIs, and multiprocessing workflows. * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows\-based software applications, including desktop user interfaces, software packaging, installation, and release management. * Implement software engineering best practices, including automated testing, logging, error handling, debugging, version control, and reproducible software builds to ensure reliability and maintainability. * Independently own software solutions across the full application stack, collaborating with cross\-functional teams to ensure system performance, reliability, and scalability. **Experience** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 3\+ years of experience in a related position. * Strong programming skills in Python and C\+\+. * Experience with medical image processing, specifically microscopy and cytology/pathology (e.g., whole\-slide imaging or digital pathology systems). * Hands\-on experience training and evaluating deep learning models for segmentation, detection, or classification using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, including with limited labeled data. * Understanding of computer vision techniques. * Experience developing and operating machine learning workflows on cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including cloud storage, GPU compute, Python\-based training pipelines, and resource monitoring (e.g., Prometheus). AWS or Azure experience is acceptable. * Experience with software development lifecycle and methodologies. * Experience with version control for code, data, and models (e.g., Git, DVC, MLflow). * Knowledge of signal processing and mathematical modeling. * Experience with GPU programming and optimization. * Experience working in healthcare, medical devices, or biotech. * Knowledge of image preprocessing, compression, and enhancement techniques. * Experience deploying models on edge or embedded hardware (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT, NVIDIA Jetson). * Eagerness to learn, grow, and take on many challenges and opportunities across the company. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Scientist, Cell Biology
jobs.description: **Description:** Build human cell models and multiplexed high\-content assays that reveal how drugs cause toxicity and predict their effects in people. Partner with robotics engineers, computational scientists, and ML researchers to generate large\-scale biological datasets that power frontier AI agents for translational drug discovery. **About Axiom:** Axiom’s mission is to eliminate unexpected drug toxicity and unlock an abundance of ultra safe medicines. We are starting with the liver, where toxicity remains a leading cause of drug failure. Our high\-throughput human liver safety platform combines advanced human cell systems with imaging, transcriptomics, mass spectrometry, and drug metabolism measurements. Our AI agents integrate these data with chemical structure, human exposure, and thousands of clinical reference compounds to predict whether a drug will be toxic in humans, why, and how to make it safer. We work with seven of the world’s top twenty pharmaceutical companies to design safety into molecules from the earliest stages. This applied work feeds directly into our partnerships with leading frontier AI labs, turning real discovery challenges and experimental feedback loops into scientific skill trees and reinforcement learning environments that train increasingly superhuman scientists. We then deploy these frontier models to make cancer therapies safer, unlock treatments for chronic diseases that demand exceptional safety, revive promising drugs abandoned because of toxicity, and much more. Our ultimate ambition is to build a superhuman AI agent that predicts how a drug will behave across all major human organ systems before the first patient receives it. With insanely accurate safety predictions, we aim to enable rapid, high\-throughput testing of novel drugs in humans with zero risk of toxicity. This is the key to unlocking an abundance of ultra safe, effective medicines. **What you will do:** * Build human cell models that accurately predict drug\-induced toxicity in the liver, kidney, heart, immune system, and pharmacokinetics like exposure and metabolisms. * Design and optimize physiologically relevant systems using primary human cells, multicellular cultures, organoids, and other advanced models. * Develop high\-content assays that reveal how drugs disrupt cellular function and cause injury. * Combine live\-cell imaging, transcriptomics, proteomics, and mass spectrometry to connect changes in cell behavior with underlying molecular mechanisms. * Work with robotics engineers to build a generalizable robotics platform for assay development and turning complex assays into reproducible, high\-throughput experimental workflows. * Establish rigorous validation and quality control standards to ensure consistent results across cell batches, plates, operators, and laboratories. * Investigate mechanisms of drug\-induced injury and design experiments that distinguish meaningful biological effects from measurement artifacts. * Partner with computational scientists and drug discovery teams to generate large\-scale biological datasets with the quality and depth needed to predict toxicity and guide drug development. * Partner with leading pharmaceutical companies and AI labs to interpret Axiom’s data, uncover the biochemical mechanisms behind observed effects, and guide drug discovery decisions. **What we look for:** * You’re an exceptional experimental scientist with a deep understanding of cell biology and human physiology. * You invent and refine biological models and assays to answer questions that established protocols cannot. * You care deeply about reproducibility, biological relevance, and data quality, with the attention to detail needed to catch subtle sources of error. * You hold your work to extremely rigorous scientific standards, designing decisive experiments with strong controls and drawing conclusions supported by the evidence. * You can interpret complex biological phenotypes and distinguish meaningful effects from noise, confounding factors, and experimental artifacts. * You challenge the limits of conventional cell models and develop systems that better predict human biology and drug responses. * You’re deeply curious about cell biology, experimental technologies, and drug discovery, and eager to master new methods. * You communicate complex science clearly, make a compelling case for your ideas, and inspire scientists and collaborators to pursue ambitious questions. **Technical skills we value:** * Experience with primary human cell culture, iPSC culture and differentiation, and cell engineering. * Experience developing physiologically relevant models, including co\-cultures, organoids, spheroids, and engineered tissues. * A strong foundation in cell biology, molecular biology, physiology, and pharmacology. * Expertise in high\-content imaging, Cell Painting, fluorescence microscopy, live\-cell imaging, and image\-based phenotypic screening. * Experience developing, miniaturizing, and automating assays for high\-throughput screening. * Experience measuring cell viability, mitochondrial function, oxidative stress, ER stress, apoptosis, inflammation, and other functional responses. * Familiarity with RNA sequencing, proteomics, metabolomics, and methods that combine multiple biological measurements. * Strong experimental design and quantitative analysis skills, including dose\-response analysis, statistical methods, assay validation, and quality control.

jobs.title: Senior Systems / Product Game Designer (Lobby & Economy)
jobs.description: **Overview** We are looking for a hands\-on, results\-driven **Senior Systems Game Designer** to take ownership of our game's lobby, core systems, and live\-ops features. This is an execution\-heavy, maker role—you will be rolling up your sleeves to design, balance, and implement features rather than just managing others. The ideal candidate has a proven track record on successful commercial titles, specializing in comprehensive player experiences that blend deep economy systems, data\-driven user segmentation, and rigorous live experimentation. Experience spanning both real\-money gaming (RMG) and social/casual casino models is a massive plus. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Lobby \& System Architecture:** Design and build engaging lobby layouts, navigation systems, core progression loops, and feature frameworks that drive long\-term player retention and engagement. * **Live\-Ops \& Event Design:** Conceptualize, configure, and balance compelling in\-game events, challenges, and promotional loops from scratch. * **Data\-Driven Optimization \& AB Testing:** Design complex AB testing frameworks to measure feature performance, optimize player monetization paths, and iterate based on live telemetry. * **User Segmentation:** Implement advanced user segmentation strategies to tailor experiences, rewards, and difficulty curves to different player archetypes (e.g., minnows, dolphins, whales, churn risks). * **Cross\-Functional Execution:** Collaborate closely with UI/UX, product managers, and software engineers from concept to deployment, writing clear design documentation and hands\-on configuration. **Requirements \& Qualifications:** * **5\+ years** of game design experience focusing on systems, economy, or live\-ops in mobile, social, or online gaming. * **Hands\-on Creator:** A proven portfolio showing direct design ownership of shipped features, systems, or live events (not a pure management role). * **Proven Track Record:** Demonstrated history of working on commercially successful titles with measurable performance metrics. * **Comprehensive Skill Set:** Deep expertise in user segmentation frameworks, economic balancing, and designing/executing robust AB testing cycles. * **Domain Bonus:** Direct hands\-on design experience across both real\-money gaming (RMG) and social casino/social gaming ecosystems is highly preferred. * **Analytical \& Collaborative:** Strong analytical mindset coupled with excellent communication skills to work seamlessly in a fast\-paced environment. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Build Release Engineer
jobs.description: Role : Build and Release EngineerLocation : Remote Required Skills : • Strong hands\-on experience with Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, and Azure Artifacts, and working knowledge of Azure Boards. • Demonstrated ability to create and troubleshoot multi\-stage YAML pipelines from scratch. • Strong experience administering Azure Repos permissions, branch policies, pull request rules, and merge strategies. • Hands\-on experience designing and consuming reusable YAML templates across multiple repositories. • Experience configuring and maintaining self\-hosted build agents on Windows and Linux, including agent pools, toolchains, permissions, and troubleshooting. • Strong Git knowledge, including branching, merging, rebasing, cherry\-picking, tagging, conflict resolution, and history recovery. • Proficiency in PowerShell and/or Bash for build and deployment automation. • Practical experience with at least one major build ecosystem: .NET/MSBuild, npm/Node.js, Maven/Gradle, or Python packaging. • Clear understanding of the end\-to\-end software build and release lifecycle, artifact versioning, environment promotion, deployment validation, and rollback. • Proven ability to diagnose failures across application code, pipeline configuration, dependencies, operating systems, and infrastructure. Required Qualifications — Certification • Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert certification is required, including successful completion of AZ\-400: Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions and the applicable prerequisite certification. Preferred Skills : • Experience with Docker\-based builds and container registries such as Azure Container Registry. • Experience with workload identity federation and managed identities for secure pipeline authentication. • Hands\-on experience integrating SonarQube with Azure Pipelines and Azure Repos pull requests, including automated code analysis, pull request decoration, and enforcement of quality gates through required PR status checks and branch policies. • Experience supporting macOS build agents, if required by the application portfolio. • Experience maintaining classic Azure DevOps release pipelines and migrating them to multi\-stage YAML pipelines. Responsibilities : Azure Repos Administration and Source Control • Administer Azure Repos repositories, repository permissions, branch security, and access controls. • Define and maintain branching strategies, repository standards, and pull request workflows appropriate to the team’s delivery model. • Configure and enforce branch policies, including: o Minimum reviewer requirements and automatically included reviewers. o Pull request build validation and required status checks. o Comment resolution and linked work item requirements. o Permitted merge strategies and restrictions on direct pushes. o Controlled permissions to bypass policies. • Manage pull request completion practices, including squash merges, merge commits, and rebase\-based workflows. • Resolve complex merge conflicts and troubleshoot Git history, tagging, and repository issues. • Establish commit, tagging, and versioning standards; manage large files and repository maintenance where needed. Azure Pipelines and Reusable Templates • Design and create YAML\-based CI/CD pipelines from scratch and maintain existing pipelines. • Implement multi\-stage pipelines covering build, test, package, publish, and deployment activities. • Design and maintain reusable stage, job, and step templates to standardize pipelines across repositories. • Use template parameters, variables, variable groups, conditions, dependencies, and output variables appropriately. • Manage shared template repositories, template versioning, and controlled rollout of template changes. • Configure CI triggers, branch and path filters, scheduled runs, pipeline\-resource triggers, and Azure Repos PR build validation policies. Configure and securely manage pipeline access to repositories, service connections, variable groups, and other protected resources. Cross\-Platform Build Agents • Configure and administer Microsoft\-hosted and self\-hosted build agents and agent pools. • Install, register, configure, and maintain self\-hosted agents on Windows and Linux; support macOS where required. Provision and maintain SDKs, compilers, package managers, build tools, and other agent dependencies. • Configure agent capabilities and demands, service accounts, permissions, and network access. • Troubleshoot agent availability, toolchain incompatibilities, workspace contamination, connectivity, and platform\-specific build failures. • Maintain consistent build environments and appropriate isolation between workloads. Build Automation and Artifact Management • Automate source checkout, dependency restore, compilation, unit testing, static analysis, code coverage, packaging, and artifact publication. • Support the organization’s application build ecosystems, such as .NET/MSBuild, npm/Node.js, Maven/Gradle, or Python. • Configure and administer Azure Artifacts feeds, package permissions, upstream sources, retention, and package versioning. • Manage pipeline artifacts and package feeds appropriately for their respective purposes. • Improve build performance through caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, and agent optimization. • Diagnose failed builds, flaky tests, dependency issues, and differences between developer and CI environments. Release and Deployment Management • Build and maintain deployment stages using Azure Pipelines and Azure DevOps Environments. • Configure approvals, checks, deployment conditions, and environment\-specific configuration. • Promote the same versioned artifacts across development, test, staging, and production rather than rebuilding for each environment. • Collaborate with application and platform teams on deployment validation, rollback procedures, and release troubleshooting. • Maintain release documentation and traceability between source commits, builds, artifacts, and deployments. Security, Traceability, and Continuous Improvement • Apply least\-privilege access to repositories, pipelines, agent pools, feeds, service connections, and environments. • Protect secrets and use approved authentication methods, including workload identity federation or managed identities where supported. • Use Azure Boards work item links to support traceability from requirements and changes through pull requests, builds, and releases. • Monitor build success rates, execution times, queue times, and recurring failures; implement measurable improvements. • Document standards and provide guidance to developers on Git workflows, pull requests, pipeline templates, and build troubleshooting. Expected Deliverable(s) : You will work closely with development, QA, platform, and release teams to deliver reliable, repeatable, secure, and traceable software releases.This electronic message and all contents contain information from Apexon which may be privileged, confidential, or otherwise protected from disclosure.
