jobs.title: Manager, Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **About Alvarez \& Marsal** Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action\- and results\-oriented professionals. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and helping them reach their potential. A\&M is different by design: we give people ownership and impact from day one, fuel development through real opportunity, and provide direct access to leaders who invest in our growth. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact clients and shape our industry. Guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, our collaborative, globally minded environment is why our people love working at A\&M. **The Team** The AI Lab Team sits within A\&M's Global AI \& Knowledge Organization (GAIKO). GAIKO brings together the firm's AI and Knowledge Management capabilities to put trusted, governed AI into everyday consulting work. The Lab's job is to turn repeatable business workflows into scalable agents and AI skills. Many of these workflows run today on Microsoft tools such as SharePoint, Power Platform and Power BI, and the pod reworks them into AI\-first solutions that can be reused across the firm. Others will be built from scratch as internal teams bring new requests. In this role, you'll work closely with the leads of A\&M's business units, the Knowledge Management (KM) and Data team leads, and the AI Skills lead and engineers, product partners and knowledge specialists across GAIKO. Together you'll design and build headless skills and agents: reusable capabilities that work behind the scenes and connect to the AI tools our professionals already use. You'll be the bridge between the business and the build: translating what each business unit needs into working skills and agents, and teaching the rest of the pod to do the same. As the pod's go\-to technical expert for skills and agents, you'll report to the AI Skills Pod lead with technical direction from the Intelligence Layer tech lead. Your work will directly shape how thousands of A\&M colleagues use AI in their work with clients. The team is growing, the work is technically demanding, and priorities will move quickly, so this role requires sound judgment, adaptability, and a willingness to contribute wherever the build needs support. We're looking for a fast builder who can take an idea from prototype to working capability quickly, learn from feedback and keep momentum without sacrificing quality. Just as important, you make the people around you better. You teach, share knowledge openly, step in across workstreams when needed, and adjust quickly when priorities shift. **How You Will Contribute** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of applied AI solutions, from proof of concept to production: problem framing, build, deployment, monitoring and iteration. * Partner with business unit leaders and their teams to understand how they work, translate their needs into skills and agents, and agree clear success metrics. * Work with the Knowledge Management and Data team leads to gather and clarify requirements, and translate them into skill and agent designs. * Partner with our Data Engineering, BIU, and Intelligence Layer teams so that solutions are built on reliable, production\-grade data. * Design, build and operate headless skills and agentic workflows, including multi\-step orchestration, tool routing, retrieval, guardrails, evaluation and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * Build and maintain automated skill\-building pipelines (templates, scaffolding, testing and evaluation harnesses, packaging and deployment) so new skills can be created and released quickly and consistently. * Build integrations with large language model platforms and use the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to make skills available to approved AI tools and the Intelligence Layer. * Integrate structured and unstructured content from enterprise systems while preserving source permissions, metadata and governance requirements. * Guide the team in assessing current Power Platform and wider Microsoft stack processes, reimagining them as AI\-first workflows rather than one\-to\-one rebuilds, and converting them into, or connecting them to, skills and agents. * Train the wider team on how to build skills, through workshops, playbooks, templates, worked examples and office hours. * Mentor engineers through pairing, code and design reviews and hands\-on coaching, raising the quality bar for skills and agents across the pod. * Apply and help shape engineering standards for skills and agents, working with the Intelligence Layer tech lead, including evaluation, CI/CD, versioning, reproducibility and performance monitoring. * Bring forward recommendations on tools, frameworks and design patterns. Technical decisions are made by the Intelligence Layer tech lead together with the Intelligence Layer lead. * Support responsible AI use, including data privacy, client co pting, evaluation and agentic patterns * Demonstrated track record of designing, building and shipping multiple AI agents and skills into production (examples or a portfolio will be discussed at interview) * Experience building automated pipelines for creating, testing, evaluating and deploying skills or agents at scale * Hands\-on experience with MCP, agent frameworks (for example, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel or similar) and reusable skill design * Experience with CI/CD, testing and observability for production systems **Nice to Have** * Experience with the Microsoft stack (SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Fabric/Power BI, Azure), including hands\-on Power Automate and Power Apps experience and the ability to re\-engineer existing flows (strongly preferred) * Experience with SQL and modern data platforms * Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum or Kanban * Experience in a professional services or consulting environment **Communication, Mentoring and People Skills** * Excellent communicator who explains technical concepts in plain business language and can run discovery sessions with business unit leaders to draw out real requirements * Proven mentor and teacher who has upskilled other engineers or non\-technical colleagues, and enjoys building capability in others * Confident presenting to and facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders * Collaborative team player who builds strong working relationships across teams * Bias toward action: builds quickly, ships often and learns through iteration * High ownership and comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities * Sound judgment on when to ship, when to iterate and when to stop **Open Items to Confirm (remove before posting)** * Salary band: $140K to $180K (centered at $160K) is proposed; confirm with Talent Acquisition. Expect strong candidates to land in the upper half given the scope. * Experience requirement: confirm 5\+ years (including 2\+ on LLM or agent systems) is right for the Manager level. * Work arrangement: confirm remote, hybrid, or office\-based expectations. **Your journey at A\&M** At A\&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands\-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real\-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high\-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one. Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez \& Marsal Holdings' fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD\&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez \& Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy\-two (72\) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A\&M's benefits programs. The salary range is $140,000 \- $160,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A\&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

jobs.title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS PrivateLink
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion AWS PrivateLink carries private connectivity for roughly 200\+ AWS services and third\-party providers, without traffic crossing the public internet. For many customers it sits on their critical availability path, and for those whose policies prohibit public egress it is the only route. We are hiring a Senior SDE to build the next generation of PrivateLink: a control plane engineered for 20x our current tens of thousands of TPS, a data plane to match, and the product vision behind both. The goal is private connectivity that keeps pace with AI. Inference platforms, agentic systems, and ML pipelines now provision and reconcile connectivity continuously, at machine speed, and move far more data over it. The limits in our way are structural, not numbers we can raise. The read path, the tenant isolation model, the provisioning architecture, and how bandwidth scales with demand are all open decisions, and you will make several of them. jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. The Radar team is seeking an experienced **Senior RF Engineer** to help us design, test, and deploy the next generation of US radars. The team owns the full stack: antenna element design, RF front\-end (RFFE) electronics, array integration, and the test infrastructure to verify it all. We move fast, hold high standards, and are looking for engineers who want their fingerprints on fielded systems. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Design**: Own the RF design of analog beamforming AESA subsystems — incorporating T/R modules, beamforming ICs, corporate feed networks, and front\-end filtering — for radar applications. Conduct trade studies, RF simulations, and prototyping to drive innovation and ensure optimal system performance. Lead design reviews and make architecture trade decisions across antenna, RFFE, and digital. * **Cross\-Domain Collaboration**: Work across antenna, digital, mechanical, and systems engineering to define array architectures that meet the needs of users in the field. Bake in design excellence, including DFM and DFT, so that our systems can support the warfighter for the long\-haul. * **Test**: Lead RF characterization of AESA hardware — including near\-field antenna range measurements, RFFE performance mapping, and system\-level radar mode verification. Own the troubleshooting process when hardware doesn't behave and drive root cause to closure. * **Teach**: Mentor junior RF engineers on phased array fundamentals, measurement techniques, and design discipline. Set the standard for schematic quality, simulation rigor, and test documentation across the team. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's in electrical engineering, electronics engineering, computer engineering or related field. * 8\+ years of professional experience in developing RF electronics, phased arrays, antennas or related radar electronics. * Experience leading the designs of active phased arrays using beamforming technologies from concept to production in a defense or aerospace environment. * Deep understanding of electronic systems engineering, including design specification, part selection, and test planning for RF systems. * Proven ability to lead technical initiatives, solve complex problems, and implement innovative solutions with attention to detail. * Strong knowledge of PCB design (schematic capture, specifying and reviewing layout), with experience in tools like Altium. * Proficiency in RF design and analysis tools such as Ansys HFSS, Keysigh cal experience and cultural fit. If you choose not to share your transcripts, you will need to provide detailed information regarding your academic performance in relevant courses, including projects and coursework specifics, to ensure we evaluate your academic accomplishments properly. If you do provide academic transcripts, feel free to redact non\-technical information (e.g., student ID, dates, non\-technical coursework, etc.). Unofficial transcripts obtained online acceptable for this assessment. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer (SMT Manufacturing)
jobs.description: **About Bitdeer Technologies Group** Bitdeer is a world\-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure. Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence. Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com/ #### **About the Role** The Process Engineer (SMT) is responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining Surface Mount Technology (SMT) production processes. In this role, you will focus on solving process\-related challenges, driving line efficiency, and ensuring high product quality across the SMT assembly line. #### **Key Responsibilities** * **Process Development:** Formulate and implement new SMT production processes to satisfy product design specifications and quality requirements. * **Continuous Improvement:** Continuously analyze and optimize existing SMT processes to maximize efficiency, reduce line waste, and enhance yield. * **Root Cause Analysis:** Troubleshoot and resolve process\-related issues encountered during SMT production, identifying root causes and executing corrective/preventive actions. * **Process Control:** Conduct process capability studies ($C\_{pk}$) and implement Statistical Process Control (SPC) techniques across assembly operations. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with R\&D, Equipment Maintenance, and Quality Assurance teams to ensure smooth New Product Introduction (NPI) and overall process stability. * **Documentation \& Standards:** Develop, update, and maintain comprehensive process documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and best practices. * **Training \& Support:** Provide technical training, guidance, and day\-to\-day support to SMT production operators and technicians. * **Industry Insights:** Stay current with industry best practices, emerging SMT technologies, and equipment advancements. #### **Qualifications \& Requirements** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline. * **Experience:** 3–5\+ years of hands\-on experience in a detailed manufacturing environment. Extra credit if an active SMT manufacturing environment. * **Technical Expertise:** Knowledge of core SMT processes, including solder paste printing, pick\-and\-place, reflow soldering, and automated inspection (AOI/AXI). * **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical and problem\-solving skill set with a structured, data\-driven approach. * **Design Standards:** Familiarity with Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles. * **Methodologies:** Experience with process optimization methodologies (e.g., Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma) is highly desirable. * **Soft Skills:** Excellent verbal/written communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across departments. \- *Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – BPS Monetization
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ Bloomberg is looking for a **Software Engineer to help build, modernize and operate the platforms that power our marketing websites and digital experiences**. You will work on highly visible digital properties that connect Bloomberg's products, services and brand with audiences around the world. This is a hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, taking ownership and delivering results. You'll work across our web ecosystem—from CMS platforms and frontend experiences to APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure and developer tooling. We're looking for engineers who are self\-driven and comfortable taking ownership of problems that are not fully defined. You should be able to understand the desired outcome, ask the right questions, work with stakeholders and teammates to determine the right solution, and drive it through implementation and production. You'll be part of a collaborative engineering team, so technical ability alone isn't enough. Strong communication, teamwork, curiosity and a willingness to help others succeed are essential. **Team Culture** ---------------- We're a new team that works closely with our partners in Product and Design to build thoughtful digital experiences. We like to experiment with new ideas, collaborate across disciplines and learn from each other as we shape how the team works. Because the team is still growing, it's a great time to join—many of us are learning the space together, and you'll have an opportunity to help influence our engineering practices and culture from the start. We also encourage participation in Bloomberg's broader employee communities and initiatives and value teammates who contribute beyond their immediate project work. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- You'll become a trusted engineer who can take on a complex problem and **drive it toward a successful outcome with increasing independence**. You'll deliver high\-quality software, contribute to the modernization of Bloomberg's marketing technology ecosystem and help establish engineering practices that make the entire team more effective. Over time, your impact will extend beyond your individual contributions: you'll improve the systems around you, make your teammates more effective, identify opportunities before they become explicit requirements and use modern engineering and AI tooling to continually increase the speed and quality with which the team delivers digital experiences. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, test and operate **modern web applications and digital experiences** supporting Bloomberg's marketing ecosystem. * Build and evolve our web publishing platform on **Optimizely**, helping shape content models and data structures while developing reusable components, templates, integrations, publishing capabilities and supporting services. * Build new digital experiences from the ground up, working with Product, Marketing, Design and other engineering teams from requirements through production. * Take **end\-to\-end ownership** of engineering work, including understanding requirements, evaluating technical approaches, implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support. * Translate evolving business requirements into clear technical solutions and communicate trade\-offs, risks and dependencies. * Develop solutions with **quality, maintainability, performance, accessibility, security and SEO** in mind. * Build automated tests and contribute to engineering practices that allow the team to release software confidently and frequently. * Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, code reviews and engineering standards across the team. * Experiment with and adopt **AI\-assisted development tools and workflows** to accelerate development, improve quality and increase individual and team productivity. **You'll Need to Have** ----------------------- * At least **5 years of professional software engineering experience** building and maintaining production web applications or digital platforms. * Experience working with **CMS platforms or content\-driven websites**. * Comfort with enterprise, headless or composable CMS platforms is particularly valuable. * Familiarity with automated testing, source control, CI/CD and modern software development workflows. * Understanding of modern web technologies, APIs and frontend/backend application architectures. **We'd Love to See** -------------------- * Experience developing on the **Optimizely platform**, including building or extending CMS\-driven websites, components or integrations. * Experience building web applications using **.NET and its broader ecosystem**. * Experience building websites or digital experiences for **marketing organizations, digital agencies, media companies or other organizations operating large public\-facing web ecosystems**. * Experience with CMS migrations, website re\-platforming or other large\-scale modernization efforts. * Familiarity with **technical SEO**, including site architecture, rendering, structured data, metadata and web performance. * Experience with cloud platforms such as **Microsoft Azure**. * Experience with CDNs, caching, content delivery and performance optimization. * Familiarity with headless CMS architectures, content APIs, design systems and modern frontend frameworks. * Experience with analytics, experimentation, personalization or marketing technology platforms. Salary Range \= 160,000 \- 240,000 USD Annual \+ Benefits \+ Bonus The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level. We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) \+match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns. Discover what makes Bloomberg unique \- watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success. **Accommodations** ------------------ Bloomberg provides reasonable adjustment/accommodation to individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC\_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia\-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. We may share your information with a third party provider of accommodations services who may use this information to reach out to you for the purposes of accommodating your application. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Bloomberg is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination in employment. It is Bloomberg’s policy to provide equal opportunity and access for all persons, and the Company is committed to attracting, retaining, developing, and promoting the most qualified individuals without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, marital status, national or ethnic origin, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, self\-identified or perceived sex, sexual and other reproductive health decisions, parental or caring status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, or parental leave, protected veteran status, status as a victim of domestic violence, or any other classification protected by applicable law (each, a “Protected Characteristic”). Bloomberg prohibits treating applicants or employees less favorably in connection with the terms and conditions of employment, in all phases of the employment process, because of one or more Protected Characteristics.

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer, Cameras & CI
jobs.description: We're Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers – farmers, construction crews, and foresters \- to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff – pixel\-by\-pixel and task\-by\-task \- leads to big gains. Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere's vision to "innovate on behalf of humanity" by quickly identifying and solving high\-value, high\-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs in industries like agriculture and construction. Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross\-disciplinary collaboration, this mission\-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won't give up until we've made a tangible and positive impact on the planet! Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA. Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Embedded Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you'll develop embedded software and systems for our computer vision\-enabled agricultural products, including the Bay Area's highest\-density compute platform for robotics. Do you thrive in a fast\-paced, innovative team environment and get energized about delivering solutions to technical challenges? If so, this role will be an outstanding next step in your career! * **Employment Type**: Full\-time * **Work Location**: Santa Clara, CA * **Visa sponsorship:** Available for this position. **Job Responsibilities** * Develop, enhance, and debug new and existing software applications, kernels, and device drivers for impactful robotics computing in C/C\+\+ and Rust within a Linux environment. * Enhance camera and sensor capabilities, image quality, and exposure configuration; support training data collection operations. * Ensure OS (Yocto) support is implemented properly for sensors. * Build automated driver and camera regression tests that run in continuous integration on hardware\-in\-the\-loop platforms. * Conduct embedded design reviews and code reviews, providing guidance to resolve difficult driver bugs which may require extensive troubleshooting. * Implement embedded design best practices and methodologies to ensure high performance and reliability, with a strong emphasis on real\-time programming considerations. **Required Experience and Skills** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field. * 1\-3 years of experience developing embedded software. * Familiarity with cameras/other sensors and camera interfaces (e.g., MIPI CSI\-2\). * Strong attention to detail with a focus on testing and continuous integration practices. * Knowledge of real\-time systems and performance optimization techniques. **Preferred Experience and Skills** * Camera and camera interface testing, including performance testing under physical conditions such as shock/vibe, EMI, and temperature. * Expertise in Linux kernel device driver development and tuning real\-time applications for low latency. * Experience in development on ARM platforms (NVIDIA Jetson) and Linux (Yocto, meta\-tegra) embedded systems. * V4L2 camera driver expertise. * Experience with NVIDIA driver development. * Experience building or maintaining continuous integration pipelines for embedded software. * Middleware experience, particularly with pub/sub architectures. Only individual applicants will be considered. We do not work with unsolicited third\-party agencies or proxy interview services. At Blue River, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. For this position, the reasonably expected pay range is between $122,000 – $183,000/year for the level at which this job has been scoped. Your base pay will depend on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, education, location, and skills. This position is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and a competitive benefit package. During the recruitment process, we may identify an alternative role or level to which you are more suited. If your ideal role at Blue River differs from the advertised position, we will provide an updated pay range as soon as possible during the hiring process. We're passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. While we have more work to do to advance diversity and inclusion, we're investing in our programs, including recruiting, mentorship, career development, and learning \& development, to ensure they support our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion goals. We support each employee in living a full life, enabling a thriving career, and accomplishing a meaningful, challenging mission while collaborating with incredible people. We are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align completely with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We are an equal\-opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

databases such as PostgreSQL, and message queues such as Kafka, NATS or Pub/Sub. * Operations: Experience owning customer\-facing production systems, including SLOs, monitoring and alerting, on\-call API platforms: Experience building API gateways or API frameworks used by many engineering teams. * AI infrastructure: Familiarity with GPU cloud platforms or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * In a growing community bank environment, success will require someone who is resourceful, collaborative, comfortable working across functions, and able to move initiatives from concept through implementation. As CalPrivate Bank continues to grow and invest in its technology and data capabilities, the Senior AI Engineer will help create the foundation that allows the organization to use its information more intelligently and efficiently. This role will support the development of scalable AI and analytics capabilities while helping the broader team successfully execute against its strategic roadmap. Just as importantly, this individual will help establish the technical standards, controls, documentation, and governance necessary to ensure these capabilities are reliable, secure, explainable, and appropriate for a highly regulated banking environment. **What You’ll Do** **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain AI, generative AI, machine learning, data engineering, complexity. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and vendors and provide thoughtful recommendations based on business value, scalability, security, cost, and regulatory considerations. * Develop prototypes and proofs of concept and successfully transition viable solutions into stable, production\-ready applications, taking ownership through testing, deployment, banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated industry is highly desirable. ***Mindset \& Values*** * You lead with accountability, integrity, and consistency. * You thrive in a collaborative environment where transparency and follow\-through matter. * You model professionalism, calm under pressure, and a solutions\-oriented mindset. * You embrace data\-driven decision\-making while maintaining a client\-first perspective. * You embody CalPrivate’s culture, heart for client, excellence in service, and deep commitment to the Bank and its people. ***Physical Demands**** May require some travel in order to support team, department and initiatives. * Ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time. * Ability to physically use a keyboard/mouse * Ability to walk to and from workstations * Ability to frequently lift and/or move up to 10lbs and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus **Why CalPrivate Bank?** This isn’t just another bank job. jobs.title: Web Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About Care Access** Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. **With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world\-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care.** We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, **and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.** With programs like *Future of Medicine*, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and *Difference Makers*, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all. To learn more about Care Access, visit www.CareAccess.com. ### **How This Role Makes a Difference** As a **Web Design Engineer** you will own how Care Access shows up on the web — designing and building the landing pages, campaign sites, and brand experiences that turn interest into action. You will work across the Care Access family of brands, moving fluidly between design and production front\-end code, and partnering with web designers, illustrators, marketers, product engineers, web engineers, and DevOps. Some days you are 80% dev and 20% design; other days it is the reverse; and some days you are half project manager keeping several launches on track. You will join a growing design team and make valuable contributions to its culture. ### **How You'll Make An Impact** * **Design and build web experiences end to end** + Take conversion\-focused landing pages and brand experiences from first concept through production front\-end code. Prototype in the browser so decisions get made against something working rather than a static mock. Sweat the interaction detail: states, transitions, loading and error behavior, and motion. * **Own the look and feel of our corporate and marketing websites** + Keep the experience coherent across many concurrent initiatives and brands. Build with SEO in mind — technical SEO, metadata, structured data, and site architecture. Maintain what already exists: redesigns, migrations, template debt, and keeping older campaign pages from rotting. * **Collaborate across disciplines and communicate the work** + Partner with web designers, illustrators, marketing, product engineers, web engineers, and DevOps. Present and defend work in reviews with stakeholders and leadership, with clear rationale behind the choices. Work transparently and share progress, early and often, with remote teams. * **Scope, sequence, and quality\-check the work** + Break work down, size it, and flag trade\-offs early rather than at the deadline. Run design QA on implementations, including builds that aren't yours, so what ships matches what was intended. ### **The Expertise Required** * A portfolio of shipped web work, ideally with live URLs and the code behind them * Strong production front\-end skills: semantic HTML, modern CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, and a framework like React, Next, or Astro * Real design craft — typography, layout, hierarchy, and restraint — with enough Figma fluency to work alongside designers and the confidence to design in the browser when that's faster * Brand sensibility: the range to work within an established identity and the judgment to extend it to the web without breaking it * A feel for conversion\-oriented web design and the willingness to let data settle the argument * CMS experience, headless or traditional (Contentful, Sanity, Webflow, or similar), and an eye for how marketers will actually use what you build * A version\-controlled workflow you're comfortable in: Git, branches, code review, CI * Cross\-browser and real\-device testing rigor — you check the work where people actually use it * Content sensibility: comfort working with copy, sometimes writing it, and knowing when the layout should bend to the words * Strong written communication — documentation, handoff notes, and async updates that keep a cross\-functional group aligned * An ability to present remotely to communicate ideas and clearly convey your decision\-making process * Self\-direction in an environment where priorities shift: you can run several initiatives at once, sequence your own work, and communicate status without being asked * Enthusiasm for working with AI tools to prototype and iterate faster * Highly collaborative skills across marketing, design, product, engineering, and DevOps * A solid grounding in accessibility (WCAG, keyboard navigation, screen readers) and web performance * An interest in designing and building experiences that help people access healthcare and research * **Preferred Qualifications:** + Experience b a site needs more than a front end + Product design and development experience, in\-app and beyond the marketing site + DevOps expertise: build pipelines, environments, previews, deploys, and infrastructure + Experience in healthcare, clinical trials, or another regulated, trust\-sensitive space + Experimentation and analytics work: A/B testing, event tracking, funnel instrumentation + Motion and animation work (Framer Motion, GSAP, or similar) + Localization or multi\-language site experience + Illustration, 3D, or other visual skills beyond UI ### **Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience** * Minimum Education: + Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience * Minimum Experience: + 5\+ years of professional web design and front\-end development experience ### **How We Work Together** * **Location**: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment. * **Travel**: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role. * **Physical demands associated with this position Include**: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment. The expected pay range for this role is $100,00 \- $140,000 USD per year for full time team members. ### **Benefits \& Perks (US Full Time Employees)** * Paid Time Off (PTO) and Company Paid Holidays * 100% Employer paid medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options * Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Accounts * Bi\-weekly HSA employer contribution * Company paid Short\-Term Disability and Long\-Term Disability * 401(k) Retirement Plan, with Company Match ### **Mandatory Employer Disclosures** **Notice to Illinois applicants:** Applicants are not obligated to disclose expunged juvenile records or adjudication, arrest, or conviction. **Notice to Connecticut applicants:** Care Access may require applicants to submit to a urinalysis drug test in connection with an application for employment. **Notice to Arizona, Georgia, Indiana, and North Dakota applicants:** Care Access complies with applicable laws prohibiting smoking in and around places of employment. **Notice to Massachusetts applicants:** It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. **Notice to Rhode Island applicants:** Care Access complies with Rhode Island law prohibiting smoking in enclosed areas within places of employment. Care Access is also subject to is subject to Chapters 29–38 of Title 28 of the Rhode Island General Laws. **Notice to Maryland applicants: UNDER MARYLAND LAW, AN EMPLOYER MAY NOT REQUIRE OR DEMAND, AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT, PROSPECTIVE EMPLOYMENT, OR CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT, THAT AN INDIVIDUAL SUBMIT TO OR TAKE A LIE DETECTOR OR SIMILAR TEST. AN EMPLOYER WHO VIOLATES THIS LAW IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND SUBJECT TO A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $100\.** \#LI\-Remote **Diversity \& Inclusion** We work with and serve people from diverse cultures and communities around the world. We are stronger and better when we build a team representing the communities we support. We maintain an inclusive culture where people from a broad range of backgrounds feel valued and respected as they contribute to our mission. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY:** The Full Stack Engineer designs, builds, deploys, and supports production\-grade web applications that advance CareQuest Institute’s mission and organizational priorities. The role owns application features end to end, from technical design and backend services to user\-facing experiences, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement. Working across product, data, analytics, and technology teams, the Full Stack Engineer develops secure, reliable, accessible, and maintainable applications using modern engineering practices. The role translates business and user needs into scalable technical solutions; integrates applications with enterprise data products and platforms; and helps ensure that CareQuest applications and services are reliable, well documented, and sustainable. Emerging capabilities may be incorporated when they provide clear user or organizational value, while the position remains focused on sound application architecture, usability, performance, observability, and operational reliability. **PRIMARY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, build, test, and maintain full\-stack web applications, including backend services, REST APIs, background tasks, and integrations with internal and external systems. * Develop responsive, accessible, testable, and user\-centered frontend experiences using React and modern JavaScript or TypeScript practices. * Build and maintain backend services using Python and FastAPI or comparable technologies, with attention to code organization, authentication, authorization, asynchronous processing, and performance. * Deploy, operate, monitor, and troubleshoot applications in Microsoft Azure, including configuration, scaling, security, observability, and incident response. * Implement secure integrations with Azure services such as App Services, Storage, Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Functions, and related platform components. * Partner with product owners, designers, data professionals, analysts, and other engineers to translate organizational priorities and user needs into technical designs and working solutions. * Integrate applications and APIs with enterprise data products, platforms, curated datasets, and reusable data services. * Own and continuously improve CI/CD pipelines in GitHub, including automated testing, code\-quality checks, security checks, and deployment workflows. * Apply software engineering best practices, including code review, unit and integration testing, documentation, logging, performance optimization, and maintainable architecture. * Contribute to decisions about application architecture, frameworks, reusable patterns, development standards, and the long\-term sustainability of CareQuest technology solutions. * When appropriate, integrate intelligent or AI\-enabled features using approved enterprise services and responsible development practices, with attention to reliability, privacy, safety, and measurable user value. * Support security, privacy, accessibility, data governance, and compliance requirements applicable to CareQuest systems and data. * Communicate technical concepts, implementation options, risks, and tradeoffs effectively to technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Continuously evaluate and improve application development tools, practices, documentation, and support processes. * Perform other duties as needed or required. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS:** **Required:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * 4\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience building and supporting production systems. * Strong software development skills in Python, including code organization, typing, packaging, testing, and asynchronous programming. * Experience building backend APIs with FastAPI or a comparable framework, including routing, middleware, authentication, authorization, and asynchronous I/O. * Hands\-on experience developing frontend applications with React, including hooks, state management, API integration, and frontend testing. * Experience deploying and operating web applications in Azure App Services or a similar platform\-as\-a\-service environment. * Practical experience with Git, GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD tools. * Understanding of web application architecture, HTTP, application security, caching, performance, and accessibility fundamentals. * Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases and integrating data stores into application backends. * Demonstrated ability to own features through design, implementation, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing support. * Ability to diagnose and resolve issues across the full application stack. * Strong communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and documentation skills. **Preferred:** * Experience with Azure observability tools and practices, including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerting. * Experience with background processing technologies such as Azure Functions, queues, Celery, or RQ. * Experience integrating large language models or other AI services into applications using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, LangChain, or comparable tools. * Working knowledge of responsible AI development, including evaluation, structured outputs, guardrails, security, privacy, and strategies to reduce unreliable results. * Experience with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, or comparable technologies. * Experience in a mission\-driven, consulting, health, data\-intensive, or regulated environment. * Familiarity with security, privacy, compliance, and licensing requirements for systems that handle sensitive or licensed data. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** * Incumbent must be able to communicate effectively. * Manual dexterity and sitting is required in carrying out position responsibilities (i.e., use of personal computer). * Ability to travel or move about within and outside serviced facilities required. * Incumbent works primarily in either a private or shared office environment. The target hiring range for this role is $109,140 \- $128,400 (annually). The starting base salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and other job\-related factors. In addition, our total rewards package includes medical, dental, and vision plans; generous time off including PTO, short and long\-term disability insurance and competitive 401(k) savings match including financial planning workshops. See our Careers Page for more information. *The specific statements shown in each section of this description are not intended to be all\-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform this position.* *\*\* In accordance with CareQuest Institute for Oral Health’s Compliance Plan, all employees must conduct CareQuest Institute for Oral Health business and activities in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, professional standards and ethical standards and report potential compliance or ethical issues to CareQuest Institute for Oral Health’s designated Compliance Officer. \*\** *CareQuest Institute for Oral Health’s Affirmative Action Program affirms our commitment to make reasonable accommodation for known physical or mental limitation of otherwise\-qualified individuals with disabilities or special disabled veterans, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business and activities. Please see Human Resources for additional information regarding this program.*

jobs.title: Research Scientist - College of Engineering - Mechanical Engineering
jobs.description: Carnegie Mellon University is a private, global research university that stands among the world’s most renowned education institutions. With ground\-breaking brain science, path\-breaking performances, creative start\-ups, big data, big ambitions, hands\-on learning, and a whole lot of robots, CMU doesn’t imagine the future, we invent it. If you’re passionate about joining a community that challenges the curious to deliver work that matters, your journey starts here! Innovation. Interdisciplinary collaboration. Complex problem solving. In Carnegie Mellon University’s Department of Mechanical Engineering, faculty members, researchers, and students are revolutionizing focus areas in advanced manufacturing, bioengineering, computational engineering, energy and the environment, product design, and robotics. In addition, they are using their expertise in interdisciplinary research centers across the university. Carnegie Mellon University’s department of Mechanical Engineering is searching for a Research Scientist to join their team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in an interesting and challenging work environment. You will contribute to the department by leading the Safe AI Lab's research program on scenario generation, simulation, and digital twins for embodied AI. The role builds digital twins of industrial work cells and assembly processes, generates safety\-critical and long\-tail scenarios from incident data, standards, and procedural variation, and runs simulation\-based evaluation of robot policies in physics simulators (NVIDIA Isaac Sim, MuJoCo) to produce quantitative safety evidence and sim\-to\-real validation. The position proposes and leads independent research goals within the scope of the lab's projects, coordinates student team members, and publishes at leading venues. **Your core responsibilities will include:** * Build digital twins of industrial work cells and automated assembly processes from CAD, point clouds, and video, and maintain simulation\-ready asset and layout libraries with controlled variation. * Develop scenario generation pipelines that turn incident reports, safety standards, and recorded human motion into simulation scenarios, including procedural generation of long\-tail and safety\-critical cases. * Run simulation\-based evaluation of robot policies (classical, RL, and VLA/VLM controllers): define safety metrics (separation distance, contact speed and force, near\-misses), apply importance sampling to find rare failures, and validate sim\-to\-real transfer on lab robot platforms. * Propose and lead independent research goals within the scope of the lab's projects; coordinate and direct the work of student researchers; co\-write papers, documentation, and progress reports; present at national and international conferences. * Other duties as assigned. Flexibility, excellence, and passion are vital qualities within Carnegie Mellon University. Inclusion, collaboration and cultural sensitivity are valued competencies at CMU. Therefore, we are in search of a team member who is able to effectively interact with a varied population of internal and external partners at a high level of integrity. We are looking for someone who shares our values and who will support the mission of the university through their work. **Qualifications:** * Master’s degree preferred. * 5\-8 years of experience. * Experience with robot simulation (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or game engines), 3D scene and digital\-twin construction, machine learning systems, and research project leadership strongly preferred. A combination of education and relevant experience from which comparable knowledge is demonstrated may be considered. * **Requirements** : Successful background check. * **Joining the CMU team opens the door to an array of exceptional benefits.** **Benefits eligible** **employees enjoy a wide array of benefits including** **comprehensive medical, prescription, dental, and vision insurance** **as well as a generous** **retirement savings program** **with employer contributions. Unlock your potential with** **tuition benefits** **, take well\-deserved breaks with ample** **paid time off** **and observed** **holidays** **, and rest easy with life and accidental death and disability insurance.** **Additional perks include a free Pittsburgh Regional Transit bus pass, access to our** **Family Concierge Team** **to help navigate childcare needs,** **fitness center access** **,** **and much more!** **For a comprehensive overview of the benefits available, explore our** **Benefits page** **.** **At Carnegie Mellon, we value the whole package when extending offers of employment. Beyond credentials, we evaluate the role and responsibilities, your valuable work experience, and the knowledge gained through education and training. We appreciate your unique skills and the perspective you bring. Your journey with us is about more than just a job; it’s about finding the perfect fit for your professional growth and personal aspirations.** **Are you interested in an exciting opportunity with an exceptional organization?! Apply today!** **Location** Pittsburgh, PA **Job Function** Engineering, Research and Project Scientists **Position Type** Staff – Fixed Term (Fixed Term) **Full Time/Part time** Full time **Pay Basis** Salary

and functional tests, ensuring quality and reliability. * Debug and resolve software / hardware / firmware interaction issues using diagnostic tools and methodologies. * Ability to evaluate problems, identify solutions, and translate findings into clear implementation of tasks and plans. * Assist in sustaining efforts by providing product knowledge and consultation. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering. * 5 \+ years of software engineering. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering. * Strong software engineering experience. * Strong Java and object\-oriented programming skills. * JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Angular, Ajax, JSP, Java servlets, React and other web\-based technologies. * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process. * Experience with software lifecycle management including version control, build processes, release management. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, and documentation while critically reviewing and validating generated solutions. * Test\-Driven Development (TDD). * Unit and jobs.title: Applied Innovation Engineer - York, NE
jobs.description: **PURPOSE** The Applied Innovation Engineer builds, deploys, and supports the custom business applications that Central Valley Ag runs on — products such as RouteForge and Gravis, the grower portal, and the applications that follow them. This is an end\-to\-end role: the Engineer talks to the people who will use the software, designs and writes it, puts it into production, and stands behind it once it is there. The team is small and moves quickly. AI\-assisted development is a normal part of how work gets done here, and the Engineer is expected to use it well and to review what it produces with the same rigor applied to hand\-written code. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Design, develop, test, and deploy custom business applications, APIs, and integrations. * Work directly with CVA employees, location staff, and growers to understand a problem, and translate it into working software. * Own features end to end, from intake through production and the support that follows. * Deploy and release software; monitor applications in production; diagnose and resolve production issues. * Integrate applications with CVA's ERP, Microsoft 365 and cloud services, vendor APIs, and other data sources. * Use AI\-assisted development to move quickly, and review generated code, tests, and configuration to the same standard as your own work. * Write and maintain technical documentation and runbooks; help the Applied Innovation Analyst build the material that lets the support organization carry routine support. * Participate in code review and uphold the team's practices for version control, testing, and release management. * Provide initial support for the applications you build; escalate infrastructure, identity, and security matters to the appropriate team. * Contribute to technical decisions; evaluate tools, platforms, and approaches, and recommend them with reasoning. * Other duties as assigned. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** This position does not require direct supervisory responsibility unless specifically assigned. **INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY** All work product created in the course of employment with Central Valley Ag Cooperative — including software, source code, applications, integrations, data models, reports, documentation, designs, processes, analyses, inventions, and any other developments, whether created during or outside normal working hours and whether or not created using CVA equipment — is the sole and exclusive property of Central Valley Ag Cooperative. Employment in this position is contingent upon agreement to CVA's confidentiality, intellectual property, and non\-disclosure terms. **QUALIFICATIONS** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Three or more years building and supporting business software in a professional environment. This range is intentionally broad; candidates at mid and senior levels will be considered and the position leveled accordingly. **REQUIRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE** * Proficiency with at least one modern programming language and application framework — for example TypeScript/JavaScript with React or Next.js, C\#, or Python. * Relational databases and SQL: schema design, query writing, and troubleshooting against real data. * Cloud fundamentals: deploying and hosting an application, authentication, secrets, logging, and monitoring (AWS and/or Microsoft Azure). * System and data integration through APIs and file interfaces. * Strong troubleshooting skill. Able to reproduce a problem, find the cause, and fix it rather than work around it. * Clear written and verbal communication with non\-technical users. **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor's degree in a technology\-related field such as computer science, computer information systems, or management information systems. * Working fluency with AI\-assisted development — coding agents and assistants, and the judgment to review what they produce. **This is how the team works.** Strong engineers without this experience who are eager to adopt it will be considered. * Experience integrating with an ERP or other system of record. * Mobile or field\-facing application experience. * Experience in agriculture, commodities, logistics, or a cooperative. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to: * Sit and stand for extended periods of time. * Use hands and fingers with dexterity to operate a computer keyboard and mouse. * Occasionally lift and transport computer equipment and peripherals. * Be available for occasional after\-hours work in support of deployments and production issues. * This position may be based at any Central Valley Ag location or worked remotely. Periodic travel to CVA locations is expected to observe the work the software supports, and for team meetings. **Central Valley Ag** Central Valley Ag is a farmer\-owned cooperative headquartered in York, Neb. CVA has locations in Iowa, Kansas, and Nebraska. CVA is an innovative leader providing products and services in grain, agronomy, feed, and energy. You can find more information about Central Valley Ag by visiting www.cvacoop.com. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, CBCI
jobs.description: Description: **Job Title:** Principal Software Engineer, CBCI **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Hybrid \- Denver, CO (3 days on\-site per week) **About CloudBees** CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer. Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust. CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control\-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow. Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta\-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners. Visit us at www.cloudbees.com. **About the Role** CloudBees CI helps enterprises build and deliver software with confidence. Built on Jenkins, with a core written in Java and deployments running on Kubernetes, it brings together the challenges of distributed systems, an extensible plugin ecosystem, and the reliability customers expect from critical delivery infrastructure. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to set technical direction for the CloudBees CI product area and turn that direction into working software. You will lead architecture and execution across teams while staying close to the code: solving the hardest engineering problems, improving an established codebase, and helping other engineers do their best work. You bring deep expertise in Java, Kubernetes, and distributed systems, together with a product mindset. You understand that an architectural decision is only valuable if it improves the customer's experience. You know when to simplify, when to invest in a deeper change, and how to move an established product forward without compromising the workflows customers depend on. Requirements: **What You'll Do** **Shape the technical direction:** * Build a deep understanding of the existing CloudBees CI architecture, Jenkins internals, and customer workloads. Use that evidence to identify the changes that will make the greatest difference. * Define the technical roadmap with engineering and product partners, connecting architectural investments to customer needs and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Lead the design of resilient distributed systems running on Kubernetes. Make tradeoffs around scale, failure handling, compatibility, and operational complexity explicit, and document the reasoning behind key decisions. **Stay hands\-on with the hardest engineering work:** * Write production\-quality Java and own critical refactors, performance improvements, and stability fixes. Lead difficult changes from design through testing, release, and follow\-up. * Diagnose complex JVM and distributed\-system problems, including memory leaks, thread contention, classloading issues, and failures that emerge across components. * Evolve plugin\-based architectures and service boundaries while protecting compatibility and upgrade behavior. Simplify where possible and introduce new abstractions only when they solve a clear problem. **Bring the team with you:** * Earn the trust of an established engineering team. Listen first, explain your reasoning, and build alignment through technical judgment and working code. * Drive initiatives across teams by breaking ambiguous problems into achievable milestones, coordinating dependencies, anticipating risks, and unblocking delivery. * Lead rigorous design and code reviews. Mentor Staff and other senior engineers, share knowledge, and establish engineering standards that teams can apply consistently. **Make quality and customer outcomes the default:** * Strengthen secure coding, automated unit and integration testing, and release practices. Ensure changes are tested against realistic workflows, failure modes, and upgrade scenarios. * Use profiling, metrics, logs, and incident evidence to find root causes and validate improvements. Turn recurring problems into durable fixes and better engineering practices. * Partner with support, product, and engineering colleagues to resolve complex customer issues. Improve the feedback loop from code to customer, removing delivery bottlenecks while maintaining confidence in each release. **What You'll Bring** * 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including technical leadership at Staff or Principal scope and a track record of delive trong point of view and update it when the data says otherwise. You argue for the best answer regardless of who's in the room, and once a decision is made, you commit to it fully. * **Hard Work** — You own the end result, not just your slice of it, and you go beyond what's expected to get there. You work smart as well as hard, and you find real reward in building something demanding alongside people who do the same. * **Ship Excellence** — You hold a painfully high quality bar and keep raising it, while shipping with urgency instead of waiting for perfect. Every iteration is something you learn from. * **Direct Feedback** — You give honest, constructive feedback regardless of seniority or tenure, and you actively ask for it in return. You deliver it with enough care that people want to hear it from you. **What You'll Get** * The opportunity to shape the technical direction of CloudBees CI, with hands\-on ownership of consequential engineering work. * A global, collaborative team that takes its craft seriously, shares knowledge, and invests in each other's growth. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Base Pay Range: $200,000 \- $230,000 annually In accordance with applicable law, this represents a reasonable estimated compensation range for this role. Actual compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location and may be more or less than the amount shown above. Outside of base compensation, CloudBees also offers stock options and variable bonuses. **What CloudBees Offers** * **Time that's actually yours.** Our BEE\-Flexible PTO policy folds vacation, sick time, and personal days into one unlimited plan. Plus paid U.S. holidays and 2 dedicated Bee\-Giving Days to volunteer for a cause you care about. * **Health coverage from day one.** You're eligible on your start date, not 90 days in. Choose from medical, dental and vision options designed to support your healthcare needs. Choose an HDHP plan and we will contribute to your HSA on top of your own pre\-tax contributions. * **Real money toward your future.** Invest in your future with a competitive 401(k) company match, offering both pre\-tax and Roth options to help you reach your financial goals. * **Protection we pay for entirely.** We fully fund your Life and AD\&D, Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability protection. Plus our Employee Assistance Program is fully covered too. * **Support for your headspace \- literally.** All Bees have access to a company\-sponsored Headspace account. Plus, a dedicated Care Concierge service in the U.S. so you never have to decode a benefits question alone. * **A home office that works.** A stipend every month toward your work\-from\-home setup in addition to the opportunity to work (hybrid for Denver, CO employees) in an office with your peers. * **Upside when we win.** Base salary is the floor. Our bonus plan rewards for the goals you deliver and the growth we drive together. * **People who sweat the craft.** A team that takes its work seriously and invests in each other's growth. * **A global, collaborative team** that lives by our values: Customer Obsessed, High Agency, Truth Seeking, Hard Work, Ship Excellence, Direct Feedback. **EEO Statement** CloudBees is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: AI Security Engineer (PhD)
jobs.description: **Job Type:** Flexible Contract (Remote) **Job Summary:** We are hiring PhD\-level AI Security Engineers for a contract project that tests whether frontier AI models can handle real security work. You will create hard tasks from your field that a leading AI model cannot solve, then review where and why it fails. **What you will do** * Create command line tasks based on real security problems. Examples: * Find and patch a vulnerability in a real codebase, such as memory corruption, an injection flaw, or an authentication bypass. * Analyze a suspicious binary and report what it does, how it persists, and how to detect it. * Audit a cryptographic implementation and fix misuse of keys, nonces or randomness. * Investigate logs or a packet capture to reconstruct an intrusion and identify the root cause. * Harden a misconfigured service, container or CI pipeline. * Find and fix a weakness in an ML system, such as a poisoned dataset, an unsafe model loading path, or a prompt injection hole in an agent. * Build each task’s environment, including the code, data and dependencies, and write a reference solution. * Write automated tests that check whether a solution is correct, with consistent results on every run. * Run your task against a leading AI model, review its attempt, and adjust the task until the model fails because the problem is truly hard, not because the instructions are unclear. **Who we are looking for** * A PhD in computer science, security, machine learning, engineering or another STEM field. PhD candidates and students are welcome to apply. * Hands\-on experience in security, such as vulnerability research, reverse engineering, applied cryptography, malware analysis, secure systems or AI/ML security. Ten or more years of experience is ideal. * At least one publication, academic or professional (for example a paper, CVE write\-up, conference talk or technical advisory). * Comfort with Python, the Linux command line, Docker and Git. * Familiarity with tools such as Ghidra, gdb, Wireshark or similar analysis tooling is a plus. * Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is a plus. * Experience with experimental design, benchmarking or testing AI systems is a plus. * Peer review experience, or experience building technical tests, CTFs or assessments, is an advantage. * Able to work independently in a remote setting and explain technical findings clearly. **Why Cobalt AI** * **Advance frontier AI where it counts.** Apply your expertise to the data frontier labs cannot get any other way, where your reasoning directly shapes how the next generation of models solves technical problems. * **Grow professionally.** Expand your influence through evaluation projects, advisory roles and research collaborations, while deepening your understanding of how frontier models are trained and assessed. * **Work with a top\-tier network.** Collaborate with researchers and engineers from leading institutions and labs on high\-impact, flexible work. * **Set your own schedule.** Flexible 10 to 40 hour weeks that fit around your current role and your life. * **Competitive pay.** Paid per accepted task, with higher rates for consistently strong work. Education: * Doctorate (Required) Work Location: Remote
