jobs.title: Full Stack Java Developer
jobs.description: **Position Summary** ==================== The Senior Full\-Stack Java Engineer will architect, develop, and maintain enterprise\-grade applications while driving cloud modernization initiatives. This role bridges robust legacy architectures—including enterprise batch systems, server\-side web platforms, and mainframe integrations—with cloud\-native microservices on AWS. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in Java/Spring and Oracle database persistence with modern event\-driven architectures, automated test pipelines, and AI\-assisted development workflows. **Work Environment** -------------------- **Salary**: $95\-$100K **Role Type**: Remote **Experience Level**: 7 years Java experience, 3 years Full Stack experience **Program Context** =================== **Background and Introduction** Customer Inquiry and Claims Response System (CICRS) is used by the indemnity claims process to provide customers with an efficient means of settling their claims and service refunds. Provides an efficient process for settling indemnity claims and service refunds for insured mail, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. CICRS is designed to pay or deny indemnity claims against the Postal Service when there is loss or damage to insured articles in the mail stream. Once a claim is received into the CICRS system, the claim data is processed, and a determination is made to pay or deny the claim within 2 days. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Full\-Stack \& Batch Engineering:** Architect and deliver resilient RESTful APIs, batch processing services, and web user interfaces using Java, J2EE, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and established web frameworks (Struts, JSP, jQuery). **Cloud \& Microservices Modernization:** Deconstruct and migrate monolithic/legacy application components into event\-driven microservices utilizing Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS native services (EC2, ECS, SQS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB). **Mainframe Integration \& Migration Strategy:** Collaborate cross\-functionally with mainframe engineers, enterprise architects, and Java teams to design data contracts, migration plans, and real\-time/batch integration patterns. **Test Automation \& Quality Engineering:** Build and enforce comprehensive automated testing suites across the software lifecycle, utilizing Playwright for end\-to\-end and functional testing, alongside unit, regression, and performance frameworks. **DevOps \& Continuous Delivery:** Maintain and optimize CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins and Git; deploy and operate containerized applications across cloud infrastructure. **Modern Tooling \& Productivity:** Accelerate delivery velocity and maintain code consistency using cutting\-edge developer tooling, specifically GitHub Copilot and VersionOne for Agile lifecycle management. **Qualifications** ================== **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Must expertise in building RESTful API Applications with promises of high throughput, strong resilience, and secure controls * Must be expert in web page development, including Struts, JavaScript, TypeScript, JSP, HTML, JQUERY, CSS, JSON, etc. * Must expertise in Java, including J2EE, Spring framework, and Struts to maintain and expand current applications. * Must expertise with Kubernates, containerized micro\-services, event\-driven application with Kafka. * Must experience in writing functional tests with automation testing framework, like Playwright **Required Experience** * **7\+ years** of professional Java software development experience, including at least **3 years** in full\-stack engineering. * Proven track record architecting, developing, and supporting enterprise web applications and high\-throughput batch systems. * Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle database design, complex SQL query development, and ORM persistence using Hibernate within the Spring Framework. * Solid background in cloud engineering, deployment automation, and DevOps workflows on AWS. * Comprehensive experience implementing test automation across unit, functional, regression, and performance testing suites. * Hands\-on experience developing automated end\-to\-end test suites using Playwright and integrating them into Jenkins CI/CD pipelines. * Demonstrated experience delivering software within Agile/Scrum frameworks using VersionOne (Digital.ai Agility). **Required Technical Skills** * **Core Java \& Frameworks:** Advanced expertise in Java/J2EE and the Spring Framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Batch). * **API Architecture:** Expert\-level capability in designing, building, securing, and maintaining scalable RESTful APIs. * **Frontend Technologies:** Strong proficiency in server\-side and client\-side web development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, JSON, JSP, and Apache Struts. * **Distributed Architecture:** Working knowledge of microservices patterns, container orchestration with Kubernetes, and event\-driven messaging architectures using Apache Kafka. * **AWS Cloud Services:** In\-depth knowledge of core AWS infrastructure and managed services, including EC2, ECS, SQS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, and streaming data solutions. * **Version Control:** Strong command of modern Git workflows, repository management, and version control best practices. * **System Migration:** Ability to evaluate modern frameworks and emerging technologies to drive legacy system modernization and cloud migrations. * **AI\-Assisted Development:** Practical experience leveraging advanced AI developer tooling, specifically GitHub Copilot, to optimize code generation and delivery velocity. ### **Core Competencies \& Soft Skills** * **Migration \& Integration Communication:** Ability to articulate complex architectural concepts, reconcile legacy business logic, and collaborate smoothly across mainframe and distributed engineering teams. * **Analytical Problem Solving:** Strong diagnostic capabilities to troubleshoot production issues across distributed cloud services, high\-throughput batch jobs, and database tiers. * **Quality \& Detail Focus:** Commitment to writing clean, maintainable, self\-documenting code with proactive security, automated test coverage, and documentation standards. * **Autonomous Execution:** Comfort navigating ambiguous migration requirements, balancing immediate system stability with strategic technical debt reduction. **Job Category:** Developer jobs.description: Overview: Keysight is a mission\-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award\-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities: **About the Role** Keysight is seeking a highly skilled Wireless Software Engineer with deep wireless protocol expertise to join our Forward Deployment Engineer team. The individual will work at the forefront of 5G\-Advanced and next\-generation wireless technologies. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex protocol challenges, developing production\-quality software, and collaborating directly with leading wireless technology companies. You will work closely with customer engineering teams and Keysight R\&D to develop, customize, integrate, and optimize software solutions used in the development of next\-generation wireless systems. Unlike traditional support or deployment roles, you will actively contribute code, debug protocol stack behavior, build software features, and drive technical solutions that influence both customer products and Keysight technology roadmaps. This is a highly development\-focused role requiring strong software engineering expertise and deep knowledge of 3GPP wireless protocols. Successful candidates will be comfortable investigating issues across multiple protocol layers, performing root\-cause analysis, modifying production code, and developing software enhancements that directly address customer and product requirements. You will have the opportunity to influence both customer solutions and future Keysight product capabilities by translating field challenges into product enhancements, software innovations, and new technical approaches. **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and enhance software features within wireless communication systems and protocol stacks. * Develop production\-quality software in C/C\+\+ and Python for Linux\-based environments. * Analyze and debug complex issues across Layer 1 (PHY), Layer 2 (MAC/RLC/PDCP), and Layer 3 (RRC/NAS) protocols. * Investigate and troubleshoot issues across the full protocol stack, including areas outside your primary domain expertise, collaborating with development teams to drive root\-cause resolution. * Diagnose and resolve complex issues encountered during customer deployments, integrations, and performance optimization activities. * Modify existing software and develop new code to address customer\-specific requirements and technical challenges. * Develop APIs, software tools, automation frameworks, and diagnostics that improve development productivity and system visibility. * Analyze signaling logs, traces, packet captures, performance metrics, and timing behavior to identify root causes of system issues. * Build prototypes and rapidly validate new features and protocol enhancements. * Enhance existing Keysight software through feature development, performance improvements, and customer\-driven innovations. * Participate in code reviews and contribute to software quality, maintainability, and engineering best practices. * Develop a deep understanding of Keysight software architecture, feature implementation, and protocol stack behavior to effectively diagnose and resolve complex technical issues. * Collaborate closely with Keysight R\&D teams to translate field findings into product improvements, software enhancements, and new capabilities. * Lead technical discussions with customers and provide guidance on jobs.description: LU Calpeco Electric LLC Tahoe Vista, CA, US, 96148 **Algonquin Power \& Utilities Corp. (AQN), parent company of Liberty, is a diversified international generation, transmission, and distribution utility. AQN is committed to providing safe, reliable, and cost\-effective energy and water solutions through our portfolio of utility investments to over one million customer connections, largely in the United States and Canada.** **At Algonquin, our vision is to be the most trusted utility service provider in North America – a premium regulated utility, known for our customer focus, commitment to sustainability, and strong community partnerships. Our employees are at the heart of that vision. We believe that when people are empowered to learn, grow, and contribute their ideas, we can achieve remarkable results together.** **We are building a culture that values integrity, inclusivity, and innovation. By joining Algonquin, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future of energy and water, while creating long\-term value for our customers, communities, employees, and shareholders.** **Purpose** ----------- Liberty Utilities (CalPeco Electric) LLC has an opening for Senior Lead Engineer **(Pay: $185,000\-$277,000 \| Bonus: 15\-30%)** At Liberty, you’ll have the opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment where your contributions directly impact our communities. We’re committed to fostering a culture of inclusion, growth, and continuous learning. We’re seeking a Senior Lead Engineer to provide cross\-discipline technical leadership and perform hands\-on engineering work within CalPeco across Grid Modernization, Line Design, Planning, Asset Management, Operations, Substation Design, System Protection, and Telecommunications. This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports. Assignments vary with business need and may include leading major programs, large projects, or standards development and implementation. **Accountabilities** -------------------- * Develop, establish, and maintain CalPeco engineering standards, procedures, design criteria, and technical requirements that engineers, designers, operations and contractors are expected to follow, with the support of Engineering leadership. * Approve technical approaches on assigned projects, resolve technical conflicts between disciplines, and lead resolution of high\-consequence technical issues, including non\-standard designs, major project risks, and system performance problems. * Deliver assigned programs and projects, such as standards development and implementation, grid modernization and substation projects, within approved budgets. jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst (AI COE)
jobs.description: This is a REMOTE role. We are unable to sponsor work authorization, now or in the future, for this role. The AI Senior Business Analyst is the domain partner who pairs directly with a Forward Deployed Engineer to automate the work of the business. You will embed in one or two functional areas at a time \- learning how the work actually gets done, mapping the workflows and pain points, and turning that understanding into a steady stream of well\-scoped solutions for your FDE to build. You are the primary feeder of work to the FDE: the person who builds AI solutions and ensures it solves a real problem the right way. In the early phases you will go deep in your first area and establish the standard operating rhythm; Later, you will take on additional areas, mentor newer Business Analysts, and codify how this model scales across the enterprise. At Lineage, the aim is not to build the largest technology team; instead, we are creating a small, highly skilled group that focuses on having the right mix of talents, skills, and the capacity to learn in areas that define our core differentiation. We leverage cloud services, best\-of\-breed libraries and components, and external teams to augment our capabilities with sufficient capacity. This means that in addition to being a firsthand technologist, you also need to be able to take a project from an ambiguous business need to a production\-grade solution, and to collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver. As a company, Lineage builds state\-of\-the\-art systems to make our employees productive, to meet and exceed our customers' expectations, to assist in our growth, and to create a technology platform that enables Lineage to achieve its vision of transforming the food supply chain. This is one of the most impactful roles in that journey, and it will require someone who has a true passion for solving real business problems with the responsible application of AI, and for raising the bar for the engineers who follow.**Primary Responsibilities:** * Embed in one or more assigned business functions and build deep working knowledge of their processes, systems, data, and pain points \- becoming the CoE's resident expert on how those areas actually operate and where AI can automate or augment the work. * Partner with functional areas to document their current\-state processes \- mapping how work flows today, where the handoffs, delays, and manual steps live \- and use that map to identify the highest\-value ways to streamline and automate the work with AI. * Act as the primary feeder of work to your paired Forward Deployed Engineer \- partnering with functional leaders and subject\-matter experts to translate the pain points you uncover into a prioritized, continuously refreshed backlog of well\-scoped solution briefs ready to build. * Develop business cases for the opportunities within your areas \- including ROI estimates, effort sizing, and risk assessments \- to support investment decisions. * Work side by side with your FDE throughout delivery \- providing domain context, documenting requirements, facilitating user acceptance testing with the business, and driving adoption once solutions ship. * Create and maintain reporting for CoE leadership that quantifies the value your pod has delivered within its areas and the health of the backlog ahead. * Collaborate with the CoE to coordinate multi\-engagement timelines, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications. * Conduct post\-deployment impact analyses to validate projected ROI and surface the next wave of opportunities within your areas. * As the team scales, take on additional functional areas, mentor junior Business Analysts, and codify the repeatable BA\-FDE pod playbook for embedding in a new area and standing up its backlog. **Education and Work Experience:** * 8\+ years of experience in business analysis, management consulting, strategy operations, or a similar analytical role. * Experience working cross\-functionally with both technical teams and senior business stakeholders. * Proficiency with data analysis tools * Domain experience in Lineage's core functional areas or industry vertical preferred. * Familiarity with AI/ML concepts \- enough to assess feasibility and have productive conversations with engineers, not necessarily to build models preferred * Prior experience in an AI Center of Excellence, digital transformation office, or innovation program preferred * Experience with product management or portfolio management tools (Jira, Asana, Aha!, or similar) preferred * Background in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) preferred. **Required Skills and Abilities:** * Structure ambiguous problems, build frameworks, and drive decisions with incomplete information. * Build business cases, financial models, and ROI analyses with strong quantitative rigor. * Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, producing clear briefs, decks, and executive summaries for both technical and executive audiences. * Manage relationships and expectations across technical teams and senior business stakeholders. \#LI\-Remote Why Lineage? This is an excellent position to begin your career path within Lineage! Success in this role enables greater responsibilities and promotions! A career at Lineage starts with learning about our business and how each team member plays a part each and every day to satisfy our customers' requirements. Beyond that, you'll help us grow and learn on our journey to be the very best employer in our industry. We'll ask you for your opinion and ensure we do our part to keep you developing and engaged as we grow our business. Working at Lineage is energizing and enjoyable. We value respect and care about our team members. Lineage is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and is committed to compliance with all federal, state, and local laws that prohibit workplace discrimination and unlawful harassment and retaliation. Lineage will not discriminate against any applicant on the basis of race, color, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental disability or any other protected status under federal, state and local law. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer who lives and breathes Azure Cosmos DB and knows how it is implemented underneath. Your mission is to make throttling disappear from Microsoft's AI plugin registry with fast, surgical, high\-ROI changes. Success is objective: throttling goes away, reliability goes up, and latency goes down, even as scale grows. You will see the results in days, not quarters. We are the Agent Tools and Lifecycle team in Microsoft's Copilot, Agents and Platform (CAP) organization. We build the service behind the AI plugin registry. Admins use it in the Microsoft 365 admin center to govern the plugins (skills, connectors, and agents) that extend Microsoft Copilot, and users discover and use those plugins across products such as Copilot Chat, Cowork, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. The registry is a core part of Microsoft's AI architecture, alongside Work IQ, and Copilot experiences across Microsoft depend on it. If you use an AI solution from Microsoft, you likely are working with our service. Come join us at the center of AI transformation at Microsoft! As a hands\-on individual contributor, you will be the technical leader for the AI plugin registry's Azure Cosmos DB tier. Our catalog of plugins and agents, and the entitlements and policies that decide who can use them, live in Cosmos DB in data centers worldwide, including sovereign clouds. Traffic keeps growing as the registry expands to experiences such as Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Foundry. Experience working on the internals of Cosmos DB or a comparable database, such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, and an understanding of the hardware and network limits that make them throttle, are especially valuable. Our global reach means 24/7 on\-call service. This position is based in Redmond, Washington and requires the employee be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities*** Cut request unit (RU) consumption to make throttling go away, fast. Start with the queries that use the most RUs, where we see room for 50–90% reductions: turn cross\-partition and fan\-out queries into point reads from Cosmos DB or Azure Blob Storage, batched reads, or single\-partition queries, and tune indexes. * Pick work by return on investment. Ship several targeted fixes in parallel, each within days, and measure each one in production. Take on a larger redesign only when the data shows smaller fixes cannot get there, and deliver it in steps that each pay off. * Fix hot partitions and size limits at the source: partition keys, document design, indexing policies, and API contracts that give high\-traffic calls the keys they need for point reads. When data has to move, migrate it with zero downtime across all environments, including sovereign clouds. * Decide what belongs in Cosmos DB. Move large, binary, unbounded, or rarely queried content to Azure Blob Storage or other storage, weighing latency, availability, and data\-residency needs. * Remove redundant and sequential database calls on our busiest paths with batching, request coalescing, and caching, and use retry budgets, load shedding, and graceful degradation so database pressure does not turn into failed requests. * Work with product management and the teams that call us to give each caller a throttling budget. Find callers that request the same unchanged data again and again, help them cache on their side, and lower the budgets of the heaviest callers over time. * Make success measurable: own the telemetry, dashboards, and alerts, RU use per API and per caller, partition skew, availability, and latency. Set targets, show the effect of every change, and spot limits before we hit them. * Raise the bar through AI: write AI skills that review designs and code for Cosmos DB mistakes, find high\-RU queries, and show engineers how to fix them, so your expertise scales across the team. Use agentic tools to build and validate fixes faster, following Responsible AI practices. Mentor engineers and represent us with the Azure Cosmos DB product group. * Serve as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) in our 24/7 on\-call rotation, lead data\-tier incident response, and turn what we learn into lasting fixes. **Qualifications** ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. **Other Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or l field AND 8\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 12\+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, or Python + OR equivalent experience. * 4\+ years of experience building or operating large\-scale distributed databases, such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, including partitioning, indexing, and query performance. * Experience finding and fixing throttling, hot partitions, or resource\-heavy cross\-partition queries in production databases. * Experience building or improving the internals of Azure Cosmos DB, or of a comparable distributed database such as MongoDB, Amazon DynamoDB, or Apache Cassandra, in areas such as partitioning, replication, storage engines, query execution, indexing, or rate limiting. * Deep, hands\-on Azure Cosmos DB expertise: what drives the RUs each operation uses, physical partitions and splits, hierarchical partition keys, indexing policies, point reads and ReadMany versus cross\-partition queries, change feed, consistency levels, multi\-region accounts, autoscale, SDK (software development kit) retries, and diagnosing errors. * Track record of making throttling go away quickly, raising availability, and cutting tail latency in production, with targeted, high\-ROI changes and before\-and\-after measurements to prove it. * Deep understanding of why distributed databases throttle, from per\-partition throughput and storage limits to hardware, network, and replication overhead, and how to design data models that stay within those limits. * Experience moving large or rarely queried content from a document database to Azure Blob Storage or comparable object storage, and serving it with point reads. * Experience with zero\-downtime data migrations and re\-partitioning on live production systems. * Experience designing rate limits, quotas, and noisy\-neighbor isolation for a multi\-tenant platform, and getting partner teams to cache on their side. * Proficiency in C\# and .NET, and experience with Azure services such as Azure Functions, Service Bus, Azure Cache for Redis, and API (application programming interface) Management. * Understanding of modern AI technologies, including generative AI and foundation models, and experience writing AI skills and using agentic tools to engineer faster. jobs.description: **UAS Pilot – Industrial Reality Capture** **MiraCAD \| Houston, Texas** **Full\-time • On\-site • Hourly, nonexempt • $35–$45/hour plus overtime** **About MiraCAD** MiraCAD delivers reality capture, visualization, and digital strategy implementation for complex industrial facilities. We capture existing brownfield sites and turn accurate spatial data and high\-resolution imagery into detailed digital representations that support engineering, maintenance, construction, and turnaround planning. Our Cloud360 platform provides a web\-based 3D viewing environment that organizes facility information and documentation by location, helping teams collaborate remotely and make better\-informed decisions. Our multidisciplinary team of engineers, surveyors, designers, and programmers works closely with clients to make industrial data accessible and useful. **About the role** We’re hiring a commercial UAS pilot for our Houston team to support projects at refineries, chemical plants, and other industrial facilities. This position suits a capable pilot who enjoys hands\-on technical work, takes safety seriously, and wants to develop skills in industrial reality capture. You’ll plan and execute flights, manage equipment, and verify that captured data meets project requirements before handing it over for processing and integration into MiraCAD’s digital platforms. **MiraCAD will provide training in our industrial capture workflows, equipment, field procedures, and data\-quality standards.** **What you’ll do** * Plan and execute UAS missions for aerial photography, mapping, 3D reconstruction, and facility documentation. * Serve as Remote Pilot in Command, following FAA requirements, company procedures, and client\-specific site rules. * Assess airspace, weather, obstacles, and site activity; coordinate required flight authorizations and site permissions. * Conduct preflight inspections, risk assessments, crew briefings, and postflight checks. Make sound go/no\-go decisions and stop operations when conditions become unsafe. * Configure cameras, payloads, and flight plans to achieve the required coverage and image quality. * Review captured data in the field, identify gaps or quality issues, and complete necessary recaptures before leaving the site. * Coordinate with facility personnel, visual observers, project managers, and technical teams. * Maintain and troubleshoot aircraft, batteries, payloads, and supporting equipment. * Maintain clear flight logs, equipment records, and reports on capture progress and data quality. * Organize, back up, and transfer captured data with accurate documentation for the processing team. * Assist with related ground\-based capture, equipment testing, and workflow improvements as projects require. **What you’ll bring** * An FAA Remote Pilot Certificate with a small UAS rating and current aeronautical knowledge recency. * Demonstrated experience operating UAS safely on commercial projects. * Strong situational awareness, mission\-planning skills, and practical judgment. * Working knowledge of camera settings and their effect on exposure, sharpness, and image quality. * Proficiency with flight\-planning software and basic data\-management workflows. * Technical aptitude and a methodical approach to troubleshooting. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures for safety, documentation, and quality assurance. * Clear communication skills and the ability to work independently or alongside field crews and client representatives. * A valid driver’s license and willingness to travel to project sites. * Ability to work outdoors, wear required PPE, and perform field duties with reasonable accommodation. * Ability to meet applicable client site\-access and safety\-training requirements. Experience with DJI Matrice or ArduPilot\-based aircraft, photogrammetry, LiDAR, RTK/PPK positioning, or 3D visualization platforms is an asset. Strong commercial pilots interested in learning industrial capture workflows are encouraged to apply. **Bonus skills** Experience in one or more of the following areas would help you stand out: * **Advanced photography:** Camera settings, optics, lighting, and image quality. * **GIS, surveying, and CAD:** Spatial data, mapping, positioning, and technical drawings. * **Inspection:** Industrial asset inspection and condition documentation. * **Electronics and robotics:** Equipment integration, controls, and troubleshooting. * **Programming, IT, and AI:** Scripting, automation, data management, and practical technology applications. These skills are optional. We welcome candidates with different combinations of technical strengths. **Compensation and benefits** * **$38–$45 per hour**, depending on relevant experience and technical skills. * **Overtime at 1\.5 times the regular rate** for hours worked over 40 in a workweek. * **Paid time off:** Up to **80 hours annually**, accrued on eligible non\-overtime hours. jobs.title: Deep Learning Compiler Verification Engineer
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. We are building the next generation of compiler technologies to accelerate deep learning workloads. We are looking for an engineer to implement compiler verification software \& related infrastructure in the AI space. You will be solving critical problems working alongside a diverse set of minds in GPU computing and systems software, doing what you enjoy. If this sounds like a fun challenge, we want to hear from you. **What you'll be doing:** * Develop and maintain components of systems to reason about correctness in deep learning compilers, across graph transformations, IR lowering, and GPU execution. * Work with deep learning compiler and architecture teams to analyze and validate optimizations (e.g., graph rewrites in MLIR, fusion passes, mixed\-precision transformations), ensuring they preserve semantics and numerical behavior. * Implement and extend test generation systems that use deep learning solutions and analysis methods to drive in\-depth testing. These systems explore the vast combinatorial space of model topologies, precision modes, and hardware targets. Contribute to improving how we measure functional quality and performance as models, compiler stacks, and hardware continue to evolve. * **What we need to see:** * BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with experience in compiler development, deep learning systems, or compiler verification. * Proficiency in Python or C\+\+ and experience with one major DL framework. This could be PyTorch, JAX/XLA, TensorRT, or a similar framework. Experience should involve model execution, graph representation, or runtime behavior. Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills — ability to reason about model behavior and compiler\-generated code, investigate correctness issues, and collaborate with teammates to resolve edge\-case failures. * **Ways to stand out from the crowd:** * Experience with compiler technologies such as LLVM, MLIR, TVM, or XLA, and familiarity with compiler passes, IR semantics, or correctness testing. * Exposure to formal methods or language specification: type systems, program semantics, or proof\-based verification. * Experience with DL model internals such as quantization, operator fusion, mixed\-precision, or graph\-level optimization. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job\-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 116,000 USD – 189,750 USD. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 4, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, NVIDIA Kubernetes
jobs.description: NVIDIA is recognized as one of the technology world's most desirable employers, driving groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High\-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. You will set technical direction, lead cross\-team development, and mentor other engineers while shipping high\-quality, production\-ready software. **What You’ll Be Doing:** * Develop and build management plane capabilities such as cluster lifecycle operations (compose, upgrade, scale, repair, delete), node management, and fleet\-wide health and status reporting, from development through production. * Architect and implement Kubernetes controllers, operators, and custom resource definitions (CRDs) in Go, with reliable, idempotent reconciliation. * Drive automated cluster provisioning across bare metal, virtualized, and cloud environments, using Cluster API\-style concepts and infrastructure providers. * Lead technical build: write build docs, run build reviews, and align partner teams across the software and hardware stack. * Diagnose and improve the performance, reliability, and security of complex, asynchronous distributed systems, including debugging issues in production. * Own test strategy (unit, integration, end\-to\-end) and automate build, test, and release pipelines. * Mentor engineers, improve code reviews, and keep documentation and runbooks clear and current. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend & Integrations, TypeScript)
jobs.description: **Software Engineer (Backend \& Integrations, TypeScript)** **Role Overview** At Neurotrack, our mission is to transform the diagnosis and prevention of Alzheimer’s and related diseases by giving people direct access to the most effective, most broadly available, scientifically validated digital assessments and therapeutics to prevent cognitive decline. You’ll be a backend engineer on our API platform, working closely with our Director of Engineering. We run several REST APIs on serverless AWS Lambda, backed by DynamoDB, all written in TypeScript. You’ll help us build them, run them, and keep them healthy, and you’ll give the team real depth on the systems our products depend on. We also run a rich portfolio of integrations with our healthcare customers: SFTP file exchange on AWS, HL7 interfaces, and our Partner API. Integrations will be your first focus. You’ll learn each of these approaches in detail: the steps, the options, and the trade\-offs. Then you’ll work hand in hand with our Customer Success team and with customers’ technical teams to pick and refine the right approach, build it, test it, and see it through to go\-live. **How We Work** * **Fast and together.** We live in Slack. We help each other throughout the day, keep each other unblocked, and regularly surprise ourselves with how fast we can go. * **AI\-native.** We practice spec\-driven development and use Claude for much of the execution, with humans in the loop at all the right steps. * **Quality and privacy first.** Our product is Software as a Medical Device, and we operate under a Quality Management System. Our commitment to quality, privacy, and the people we serve shapes how we build. **Key Responsibilities:** *APIs \& Platform* * Design, build, and extend features across our TypeScript REST APIs on AWS Lambda and DynamoDB. * Design and document APIs with OpenAPI so they’re reusable across current and future products. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions. * Instrument and monitor services with Datadog, and help triage, diagnose, and fix production issues. *Customer Integrations* * Own customer integrations end to end: scope them with Customer Success and the customer, configure or implement them, test them, and take them live. *AI\-Supported Development* * Write specs, collaborate with Claude to execute them, and review the results with care. * Keep work and knowledge current in Jira and Confluence. **Qualifications:** *Required:* * 5\+ years as a software developer, with significant backend API experience. * Strong TypeScript and Node.js. * Hands\-on AWS experience; Lambda, DynamoDB, and serverless architectures are a strong plus. * Experience with GitHub Actions and with designing APIs using OpenAPI. * Comfort working directly with customers and partners on technical integrations. * Solid grounding in software design: clean architecture, domain\-driven design, design patterns. * Experience using AI coding tools in your day\-to\-day work, or real eagerness to work that way. * A focus on quality and collaboration, and the ability to thrive in a fast\-moving environment. *Preferred:* * Healthcare integration experience (HL7, FHIR, SFTP\-based data exchange). * Experience with Auth0 and Datadog. * Experience in a regulated environment (medical device, HIPAA, ISO 13485, or similar). **Working at Neurotrack** * Location: Remote (US) * Schedule: Full\-time * Travel: Minimal * Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision, LTD, STD), equity options, unlimited PTO, and a wellness account. At Neurotrack, you’ll be part of a mission\-driven team committed to improving lives through better brain health. You’ll work with innovative technology, collaborate with passionate colleagues, and make a real impact on the systems and integrations that connect our platform to the healthcare organizations we serve.

jobs.title: Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description: **Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture** ============================================== Remote – Western US (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred) **Why Us** NewRocket is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and a Claude Select partner, helping enterprises reimagine how work gets done with ServiceNow and AI. We work with public and private sector organizations, including some of the world's biggest brands, to simplify processes, remove complexity, and turn the promise of AI into measurable business outcomes. We are *"Raising the Bar"* in delivering technology's promise to create new kinds of experiences for our customers. Our Core Values: Excellence, Creativity, Integrity, Teamwork and Empathy ***\#ExCITE***. At NewRocket, these values guide everything we do: they are the foundation of our culture and define how we ***Go Beyond*** for our clients. **The Role** **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a Director of AI and Enterprise Architecture to be the technical leader on our client engagements, working alongside our forward deployed engineers as they build and deploy agentic AI inside complex enterprise environments. This is a billable, client\-facing consulting role. Large enterprises don't run on one system. They run on decades of layered platforms: ERP backbones like SAP and Oracle, service and workflow platforms like ServiceNow, CRM, HR and finance suites, custom integrations, data warehouses, and the identity and security controls that hold it all together. Agentic AI only creates value when it can work safely inside that landscape: reading the right data, taking the right actions, respecting approvals and access controls, and leaving an audit trail that satisfies IT, security and compliance. On each engagement, you're the person who understands that landscape. You map the client's systems, translate their business goals into the architecture and requirements agents need, and lead the forward deployed engineers through it as they build, so workflows make it out of pilot and into the client's production environment. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Lead engagements technically.** Serve as the senior technical leader on client engagements, setting architecture direction and guiding the forward deployed engineers who are building alongside you. * **Map the client's system landscape.** Quickly get to grips with each client's environment, including ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Workday, custom systems and the integrations between them, and turn it into a clear picture the engineering team can build against. * **Translate business processes into agent\-ready requirements.** Work with client process owners to break down workflows like incident resolution, procure\-to\-pay, order\-to\-cash and employee onboarding into the tasks, data, decisions, permissions and human approval points an agent must handle. * **Design how agents connect to systems of record.** Define the integration approach for each engagement: APIs, integration platforms, event streams, MCP and tool\-calling layers, and data access patterns. * **Get workflows into production.** Navigate the client's environments, change management, release processes, testing, monitoring and support handoff so agentic workflows move from pilot to production. * **Clear the path with security and governance.** Design identity and access models for agents (service accounts, least privilege, delegated authority), audit logging and controls, and win sign\-off from client CISOs, risk teams and auditors. * **Advise senior client stakeholders.** Act as a trusted architecture advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects and platform owners, and identify where agentic workflows can expand into new use cases. * **Strengthen the practice.** Turn what you learn on engagements into reusable blueprints, integration playbooks and readiness assessments, and share field insight with our product and engineering teams. **What you bring** ------------------ * 7 to 10 years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture or technical leadership roles within large, complex enterprise software environments. * Deep hands\-on knowledge of at least two major enterprise platforms, such as ServiceNow, SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), Oracle (Fusion, E\-Business Suite, OCI), Salesforce or Workday, including their data models, APIs, extension frameworks and upgrade constraints. * Strong grounding in enterprise integration: REST and SOAP APIs, middleware and iPaaS (MuleSoft, Boomi, SAP Integration Suite or similar), event\-driven architecture, and master data management. * Practical experience with AI or automation in production, such as LLM\-based applications, agentic workflows, RPA or intelligent automation, and a clear point of view on where agents fit and where they don't. * Proven track record moving enterprise systems from design to production, including environment management, SDLC and change control, testing, monitoring and operational support. * Solid understanding of enterprise security and governance: identity and access management, SSO and OAuth, role\-based access, audit, and regulatory requirements such as SOX, GDPR or HIPAA. * Client\-facing consulting experience, such as at a Big Four firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, KPMG), Accenture or another global systems integrator or enterprise software vendor's professional services team, including working in a billable delivery model and advising executive stakeholders in plain business terms. * Experience serving as technical lead for engineering teams on delivery engagements, guiding engineers who are building while staying hands\-on enough to unblock them. * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Location and travel** ----------------------- * You must live in the Western United States, in the Mountain or Pacific time zone. * You must be willing to travel up to 75% to client sites. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, or platform certifications (ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect, SAP or Oracle architect certifications). * Familiarity with agent frameworks and protocols, including Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool use and function calling, retrieval\-augmented generation and agent evaluation methods. * Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks). * Experience working alongside forward deployed engineering teams, or in a similar embedded delivery model. * Experience in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, public sector or manufacturing. * Public thought leadership: talks, writing or published reference architectures on enterprise AI. **What success looks like** --------------------------- This is a billable, client\-facing consulting role. You'll be embedded on customer engagements alongside our forward deployed engineers, serving as the architecture lead who helps the team navigate complex enterprise system landscapes. * **Engagement delivery:** You consistently meet billable utilization targets and are the go\-to architect on our most complex client engagements. * **Landscape mastery for the team:** On each engagement, you quickly map the client's system landscape (ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle and the integrations between them) and give forward deployed engineers a clear path through it: where the data lives, which APIs and controls apply, and who owns what. * **Production outcomes:** Agentic workflows you architect reach the client's production environment, with sign\-off from their IT, security and risk teams. * **Client trust:** Clients see you as a senior advisor, leading to engagement extensions, expanded scope and referenceable outcomes. * **Repeatable delivery:** Patterns, integration playbooks and readiness assessments from your engagements are reused across the practice, making each new deployment faster. **We Take Care of Our People** NewRocket is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value and celebrate diversity, believing that every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer, committed to providing employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, creed, color, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, citizenship, military, or Veteran status. For individuals with disabilities who would like to request an accommodation, please contact hr.us@newrocket.com.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99\.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI\-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. **About the Role** You’ll join a small infrastructure team with broad, shared ownership — the engineers who keep Niantic Spatial running. The team covers the cloud platform, the developer tooling every engineer depends on, and the edge services our customers’ requests pass through. You’ll work across SRE, infrastructure, and developer platform alongside teammates who know the stack well, and you’ll grow into owning parts of it yourself. Because every engineer here builds on what this team provides, your work will also shape how the whole engineering org builds, ships, and operates. **What You'll Do** * **Cloud and SRE:** Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code, and help improve reliability through monitoring, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * **Developer Platform:** Help run our source control, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure so engineers can ship quickly and safely. * **Production Operations:** Share on\-call, take part in incident response and follow\-up, and automate away repetitive operational work. * **Edge and Delivery:** Help run the edge API gateway, CDN, and authentication and authorization systems with the rest of the team. * **Compute and GPU Management:** Help provision and monitor compute and GPU capacity across teams. * **AI\-Assisted Operations:** Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. **What You'll Bring** * **Years of Experience:** 3\+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. * **Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with GCP, AWS, or another major cloud provider in production. * **CI/CD:** Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar. * **Containers:** Production experience with containers and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes. * **Core Technical Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C\+\+, plus shell scripting and Linux systems. * **AI in Your Workflow:** Comfort using AI\-assisted tools in your engineering work, or a strong interest in building that habit. We’ll help you ramp up on how we use AI here. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with API gateways, load balancers, or CDNs. * Familiarity with modern authentication and authorization, such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, or cloud IAM. * Experience with GPU workloads or ML infrastructure. * Experience with message queuing systems. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco or Sunnyvale, CA office, or in Bellevue, WA. We work in a high\-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on\-site a minimum of 3 days per week. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $230,000 for Bay Area candidates and $162,500 \- $218,500 for Seattle/Bellevue candidates. Actual salary is based on assessed skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity, bonus, and benefits. Your recruiter can answer questions about total compensation during the hiring process. **Inclusive Application** We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. **Equal Opportunity** Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process. **Candidate Privacy** I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice. Compensation Range: $162\.5K \- $230K

jobs.title: AI Engineer, Design
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page **About the role** ------------------ We're looking for an outstanding AI Engineer with both a passion for design and experience architecting modern AI implementations. Nu's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI\-assisted solutions and 30\+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other. The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer — which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it. This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nu scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it. **What you'll work on** ----------------------- **NuBrain** — the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30\+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture — how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful. **New tools that enable superlative creative marketing and brand expressions at scale**. As Nu scales globally, we are inventing new ways to express our brand in the product and through our marketing. Instead of hiring fleets of marketing designers in every country, we aim to build tools that enable consistent high quality creative expression to be driven centrally. **Canonicalizing what already exists.** Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds. **Deciding the shape of the answer.** Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform — that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Architect and build the systems design at Nu runs on — increasingly agentic ones. * Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable. * Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function. * Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow\-up. * Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you. * Be the technical voice in a design organization — make trade\-offs legible to people who don't read code. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- **An outstanding, deeply experienced AI engineer.** This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on, and recent years working with AI models on things like token consumption, rate limiting, response latency, MCP servers, and other modern AI engineering challenges. **A track record architecting UX systems.** Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale — design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front\-end infrastructure used by many teams. **A love for design that shows up in your work.** Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them. **Agentic systems that help design scale.** Ideally you've built them — agents, tooling, or infrastructure that let designers do more, faster, and better. This is the strongest signal for the role. **A protagonist.** You'll serve a 260\-person function as a centralized hub. That means navigating stakeholders, leading projects, and pushing work through an organization that doesn't report to you. You drive the work yourself rather than relying on someone else to run the project. **Evidence you've shipped.** Send us GitHub, live tools, demos, and systems you can walk us through. We are not asking for a design portfolio. ### **Backgrounds that tend to fit** * Design systems and UI platform engineers at design\-led product companies. * Engineers at design tooling companies. * Engineers who have been building AI and agentic tools for designers — in their day job, in open source, or in public. * Founders and technical leads who were the engineer behind a design\-led product. ### **What this role is not** * Not a designer who codes. The engineering bar is the bar. * Not a generalist backend or infrastructure role. UX systems experience is core. * Not customer\-facing mobile product work. This is internal systems and tooling for the design function. * Not a research or modeling role. (The "design modeling" profile — building the models AI consumes — is a different conversation, later.) Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Research Engineer II - Building Energy Modeling
jobs.description: Overview: At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget. Our Science \& Technology directorates include National Security, Earth and Biological Sciences, Physical and Computational Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus. The Energy and Environment Directorate delivers science and technology solutions for the nation’s biggest energy and environmental challenges. Our more than 1,700 staff support the Department of Energy (DOE), delivering on key DOE mission areas including: modernizing our nation’s power grid to maintain a reliable, affordable, secure, and resilient electricity delivery infrastructure; research, development, validation, and effective utilization of renewable energy and efficiency technologies that improve the affordability, reliability, resiliency, and security of the American energy system; and resolving complex issues in nuclear science, energy, and environmental management. The Electricity Infrastructure and Buildings Division, part of the Energy and Environment Directorate, is accelerating the transition to an efficient, resilient, and secure energy system through basic and applied research. We leverage a strong technical foundation in power and energy systems and advanced data analytics to drive innovation, transform markets, and shape energy policy. Rockstar Rewards: Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, robust telehealth care options, several mental health benefits, free wellness coaching, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance\*, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, tuition assistance, relocation, backup childcare, legal benefits, supplemental parental bonding leave, surrogacy and adoption assistance, and fertility support. Employees are automatically enrolled in our company\-funded pension plan\* and may enroll in our 401 (k) savings plan with company match\*. Employees may accrue up to 120 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year. * Research Associates excluded. \*\*All benefits are dependent upon eligibility. Click Here For Rockstar Rewards Responsibilities: This position is in the Building Simulation and Design Group (BS\&DG) within PNNL’s Electricity Infrastructure and Buildings Division. BS\&DG conducts modeling and analysis to evaluate the impacts of building energy policies, codes, and standards; develops tools and workflows to support building research and decision making; and helps accelerate adoption of energy\-efficient technologies. The group maintains core research capabilities in building energy simulation, building energy policy analysis, and tool development for building applications. The BS\&DG is seeking a **Research Engineer II \- Building Energy Modeling** with strong knowledge of building energy systems, hands\-on Energy Plus modeling expertise, programming and data analysis skills, and demonstrated ability to contribute to technical research. The selected candidate will serve as an individual contributor to project teams. They will contribute to developing technical approaches and conduct research to evaluate building energy performance, building technologies, and energy efficiency policies, codes, and standards, with particular emphasis on residential buildings. Responsibilities include developing and improving modeling tools and simulation workflows, collaborating with technical contributors, evaluating the technical quality of research results, contributing to publications and presentations, and communicating findings to project teams and collaborators. The candidate will also contribute to integrating AI\-enabled methods into modeling and analysis workflows, with an emphasis on engineering accuracy, reproducibility, and practical value. jobs.description: Points North is looking for a Software Engineer in Test who is excited about doing meaningful, high\-impact work on a product that people already depend on and making it better. Someone who is eager to experiment with AI\-assisted tooling to move faster and reach further, while understanding that AI augments good engineering judgment rather than replacing it. * A collaborator who communicates openly, takes pride in their work and their team's work, and leaves codebases and processes better than they found them. * A builder who wants to see their work ship, make an impact, and solve real world problems. ### Qualifications: * 5\+ years of experience in professional software development or software quality engineering. * Proven, professional experience building and utilizing test automation tools and frameworks. * Proficiency with languages such as C\# and/or TypeScript. * Experience testing REST APIs and using tools like Postman or equivalent automation frameworks. * Experience with source control and modern CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions). * Comfortable working with relational databases such as SQL Server. * Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work as a core member of an Agile software development team. * Solid understanding of modern software engineering principles and best practices. * Experience working in a SaaS company or small, fast\-paced development team. * Familiarity with cloud services (Azure App Services, Azure SQL, Azure Functions). * Experience bringing QA practices to legacy or established codebases. jobs.title: Principal/Senior Software Engineer - Mobile App Monetization (Ad Server)
jobs.description: **About the Role** PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next\-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high\-performance, low\-latency, scalable, and privacy\-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in\-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency. The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP\-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads. The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad\-tech domain expertise and experience building real\-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML\-integrated and data\-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic's mobile app ecosystem. **What You'll Do** * Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in\-app behavioral data using on\-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities. * Build and optimize SSP\-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy\-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP\-specific troubleshooting. * Design mobile\-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high\-value in\-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior. * Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward\-callback correctness. * Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well\-represented, privacy\-compliant, format\-compatible, attribution\-ready, and supply\-quality\-aware mobile app requests. * Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low\-quality partner supply detection. * Support privacy\-aware and attribution\-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child\-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy\-safe fallback when user\-level identifiers are unavailable. * Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal\-quality standards, request\-field expectations, placement/ad\-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply. * Build publisher\-facing and buyer\-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing\-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no\-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply\-path quality insights. * Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic's MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality. * Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities. * Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross\-team incident response. **We'd Love for You to Have** * Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high\-scale, low\-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app\-install, or programmatic AdTech domains. * Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewar rience working with incrementality measurement, retargeting systems, audience segmentation, cohort\-based optimization, or privacy\-safe targeting for mobile performance marketing. * Exposure to privacy\-preserving user ID solutions such as UID2\.0, RampID, publisher first\-party IDs, hashed identifiers where allowed, and frameworks such as SKAdNetwork for iOS post\-ATT monetization. * Experience with cross\-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session. * Familiarity with real\-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency. * Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy\-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech. **Why Join Us?** * Work on high\-scale mobile monetization infrastructure that directly impacts publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem. * Help shape the future of ML\-powered mobile monetization, real\-time ad decisioning, traffic shaping, attribution readiness, and privacy\-safe performance advertising. * Build systems that improve monetization across premium mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads. * Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product teams, machine learning experts, DSP partners, publisher teams, and marketplace quality teams. * Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company. **AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset:** We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment. **Qualifications:** * Should have a bachelor's degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well\-known Institutes / Universities. **Additional Information:** **Return to Office**: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days "in office" and 2 days "working remotely") that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions. **Benefits**: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we're back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more! **Diversity and Inclusion**: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don't just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **About PubMatic** PubMatic is one of the world's leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes. Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.
