jobs.title: Engineering Operations Lead - Configuration Management & Tools
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= Every part on a Seaglider has a story: who designed it, what revision was approved, what changed and why, and which one the shop floor built. As REGENT grows from prototype to certified production and moves our Viceroy program through certification, that story has to be true, complete, and available to everyone who needs it — engineers, manufacturing, and the regulators who will certify the vehicle. We're hiring an **Engineering Operations Lead** to build the configuration management discipline that scales with us, and to own the engineering toolchain that enforces it. You'll define and run REGENT's configuration and change management process: baselines, release workflows, the change control board, and the record of what is released and why — built for a growing engineering organization and for the regulatory path ahead. You'll own the hardware engineering toolchain — Siemens Teamcenter (with NX and Capital), and our Jira/Confluence standards — administering it, setting the rules, and keeping it a system engineers trust rather than a hurdle they route around. And you'll define how released drawings and bills of materials flow from PLM into our manufacturing execution system, so Manufacturing builds to the right revision from a single source of truth. Success looks like a Viceroy with a defensible design baseline, a change process that reaches effectivity decisions in days rather than weeks, a Teamcenter environment run as a service to the engineering team, and a shop floor that pulls from PLM. It looks like the Chief Engineer, Manufacturing, and Certification all agreeing on what "released" means — because you wrote it down and built the tools to enforce it. This is a builder's role. You'll establish the CM function at REGENT with direct partnership from the VP of Programs, the Chief Engineer, and the CTO's engineering\-lifecycle team, and shape it for the team we're becoming. If you have lived in the seam between engineering and manufacturing, if you can hold a release on procedure and then help the engineer get it through the same afternoon, and if you want to shape how a new class of vehicle gets designed, changed, and built — we want to hear from you. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own configuration management for REGENT's programs.** Author and maintain the Configuration Management Plan, define HW/SW/System baselines, and act as Release Manager for the Viceroy program — the procedural authority on what is released, in\-work, or obsolete. * **Stand up and run the change process.** Write the Engineering Change Process (ECR impact assessment CCB ECO ECN), charter and run the Change Control Board across Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Certification, and drive effectivity decisions. * **Own the hardware engineering toolchain.** Administer Siemens Teamcenter (Active Workspace, workflows, roles, attributes, release statuses) with NX and Capital integrations; own Jama’s connection to other tools; set Jira/Confluence configuration standards; manage the engineering vendor and integrator relationships. * **Define the engineering\-to\-manufacturing data contract.** Specify which released items, attributes, and BOM structures flow from Teamcenter into the manufacturing execution system, how engineering changes propagate, and how as\-designed and as\-built are reconciled — in partnership with the MES implementation lead. * **Finish the standards Viceroy needs.** Part numbering, attribute standards, CAD and data structure, role assignments, and drawing/BOM release workflows — agreed cross\-functionally and configured in the tools before design work depends on them. * **Manage engineering licenses and tool access.** Inventory, allocation, renewals, and audit evidence for the engineering software estate. * **Prepare for configuration audits.** Build the status accounting and audit approach (FCA/PCA) that certification will require on the path from PDR to CDR and first article. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * **Configuration management depth on hardware development programs** — identification, change control, status accounting, and audit, applied through formal design gates and into production. * **Hands\-on PLM administration**, ideally Siemens Teamcenter: item and revision lifecycles, release workflows and signatories, BOM structures, effectivity and revision rules, role\-based access, attribute and LOV configuration. jobs.title: Manager, Electrical Engineering
jobs.description: At REGENT, we’re on a mission to revolutionize regional transportation between coastal cities. We're not just building vehicles, we're creating a new category of transportation: the Seaglider. These groundbreaking wing\-in\-ground\-effect craft travel just above the water’s surface, combining the speed of an airplane with the low operating costs of a boat. Capable of 180 miles at 180 mph on today's battery tech (and up to 400 miles with next\-gen batteries), Seagliders will unlock fast, affordable, and sustainable coastal transit for passengers and cargo \- connecting cities, islands, and communities like never before. Backed by leading investors and powered by a team of passionate, forward\-thinking engineers, builders, and operators, we’re now scaling from a breakthrough prototype to full production \- and building the team to make it happen. **Role Overview** ================= Seagliders are all\-electric flying vehicles that operate on the water, bringing together complex electrical systems that need to work seamlessly, reliably, and safely. From safety\-critical controls and high\-voltage power distribution to electric propulsion, energy storage, electromechanical actuation, and harnessing, our Electrical Engineering team is responsible for designing and integrating the systems that make our vehicles possible. We're looking for a **Manager, Electrical Engineering who brings both strong technical depth and a passion for building, coaching, and leading high\-performing engineers.** This is a role for someone who can guide complex technical decisions, challenge designs, mentor engineers, and bring structure and clarity to a fast\-moving development environment. You'll lead and grow a team of engineers, with responsibility for electrical engineering across multiple vehicle programs as we move from development and testing toward certification and production. You'll work closely with your team to establish technical direction, navigate design tradeoffs, and ensure our electrical systems meet the demanding requirements of safety\-critical applications. Just as importantly, **you'll invest in the people behind the engineering** — coaching engineers through technical challenges, providing thoughtful feedback, helping them develop, and creating opportunities for them to grow into stronger technical contributors and leaders. You'll foster a team environment built on clear ownership, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning. Reporting to the Director of Hardware Engineering, you'll partner closely with mechanical, software, systems, certification, test, and manufacturing teams to solve challenges that extend well beyond any single subsystem. You'll also play a key role in guiding our vehicles through major development milestones, including critical design reviews and flight testing. Success in this role means delivering technically sound, well\-integrated electrical systems while developing a team of engineers who are growing in their capabilities, taking on greater ownership, and ready to tackle increasingly complex challenges as REGENT grows. If you’re energized by working at the intersection of cutting\-edge innovation, real\-world impact, and hands\-on engineering, you’ll be in the right place \- and we’d be thrilled to have you on the team! **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Lead and Build the Electrical Engineering Team:** Set technical direction, establish priorities, and guide engineering execution across avionics, power distribution, electric propulsion and energy storage integration, actuation, harnessing, and board\-level hardware. Own hiring, performance management, and team development, creating an environment where engineers have clear ownership, make sound technical decisions, collaborate effectively, and are empowered to do their best work. * **Drive Engineering Execution Across Programs:** Translate vehicle and program requirements into clear engineering priorities, deliverables, and milestones. Balance competing demands across multiple vehicle programs, remove roadblocks, and keep the team focused on delivering high\-quality designs through integration, verification, and testing. * **Provide Technical Leadership and Oversight:** Guide engineering decisions, challenge assumptions, and help the team navigate complex design tradeoffs. Lead meaningful design reviews, safety assessments, and technical risk discussions that identify issues early, strengthen designs, and maintain momentum without introducing unnecessary process. * **Build Scalable Engineering Practices:** Establish and continuously improve electrical engineering standards, design documentation, review processes, and verification practices. Partner with the team to develop the technical rigor, consistency, and documentation needed to support certification, manufacturing, and production readiness. * **Collaborate Across Engineering and Operations:** Serve as a trusted technical and organizational partner to mechanical other disciplines, with the systems\-level perspective and technical judgment to guide design decisions, evaluate tradeoffs, and lead engineers across multiple electrical specialties. * **Experience Developing Safety\-Critical Hardware:** You understand how system safety, design assurance, environmental qualification, and regulatory requirements influence electrical hardware development. You're familiar with standards and methodologies such as DO\-160, ARP4754, FMEA, or equivalent approaches, and know how to apply them to make informed engineering decisions. * **Proven Experience Delivering Hardware Through Production:** You've led electrical hardware development from requirements and architecture through detailed design, integration, verification, environmental qualification, and production readiness. You understand what it takes to move complex electrical systems from design into working, qualified hardware, navigate technical challenges, and deliver against demanding program milestones in aerospace, maritime, automotive, or other safety\-critical environments. * **Strong Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** You're comfortable working across mechanical, software, systems, test, certification, and manufacturing teams to solve complex engineering challenges. You build credibility through technical judgment, clear communication, and a willingness to listen, challenge assumptions, and work toward the best solution for the overall vehicle. * **Experience Working with Suppliers and Manufacturing Partners:** You've partnered with suppliers and contract manufacturers to define technical requirements, evaluate designs, establish acceptance criteria, and resolve issues throughout development and production. * **Comfortable Building in Ambiguity:** You thrive in environments where the technology is evolving, processes are still being established, and there isn't always a clear playbook. You can make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, adapt as new challenges emerge, and aren't afraid to get close to the hardware and work alongside your team during integration and testing. **Bonus Experience** -------------------- * **Experience with Emerging Vehicle Platforms:** You've worked on eVTOL, UAV, electric marine vessels, or other novel vehicle technologies, particularly in environments developing new approaches to propulsion, controls, or vehicle integration. * **Hands\-On Electrical Design Experience:** You've personally designed or developed electrical harnesses, PCBs, or custom electronic hardware and bring familiarity with PLM and requirements management tools. * **Passion for Aviation or Maritime:** You have a pilot's license, boating experience, or a personal interest in aviation, maritime technology, or electric transportation. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Competitive compensation** including a robust equity incentive plan. * Comprehensive **health, dental, and vision insurance \-** we cover **100%** of your premiums. * **401(k)** with company matching, so you can plan for the future. * Generous **flexible time off**, paid parental leave, and company\-wide holiday breaks. * **Relocation packages** available for those moving to join our team. * Daily, **free catered lunches** * Learning \& professional development opportunities **If you’re ready to take on an exciting challenge, grow with us, and make a lasting impact, we want to hear from you.** Even if you don’t meet every requirement, but you see yourself contributing to our mission, we encourage you to apply! jobs.title: Staff Software Test Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** **Staff SDET — Consumer Quality Enablement** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **About the Role** We have an exciting opportunity for an innovative Staff Engineer in Test to join our RDC team. The charter for this team is to build and deliver innovative solutions across the real\-estate ecosystem that deepen relationships with industry players, consumers, and brokers/agents. This role is part of Quality Enablement team. Consumer Quality Enablement is a platform team — not embedded in any single product squad but responsible for the quality infrastructure that serves the entire Consumer Engineering organization: 30\+ scrum teams, 400\+ repositories, and five surfaces (Web, iOS, Android, Backend Services). We operate as Quality\-as\-a\-Service. Our job is to build systems, frameworks, and tooling that make it easier for product engineers to ship with confidence — without requiring a dedicated QA resource on every team. We govern, audit , create paved path and enable engineers with tools , process, framework , reporting and governance **What You'll Do** As a Staff SDET on Consumer Quality Enablement, you are the technical backbone of how we build, evolve, and enforce quality infrastructure at scale. You own the design and delivery of the test frameworks, AI\-powered tooling, and quality\-gate systems that the broader engineering org depends on. This is a senior individual contributor role. You will not manage people directly, but you will set technical direction, establish standards, and pull other engineers — inside and outside the team — toward higher\-quality practices. **What You'll Own** **AI\-Powered Quality Tooling** * Evolve the Genesis AI test\-case generation platform — coverage expansion, prompt engineering, model selection, accuracy measurement. * Build and maintain the AI RCA (Root Cause Analysis) pipeline that surfaces incident and test\-failure context automatically. * Develop the Test Fix Agent: automated triage, flakiness detection, and patch suggestion for failing tests in CI. * Define the evaluation harness and quality metrics for all AI tooling — precision, recall, engineer adoption. **Test Framework Infrastructure (Paved Path)** * Own the "Paved Path" for Web (Playwright\-based) and Mobile (Appium/iOS XCUITest/Android Espresso) — the opinionated, zero\-config test setup that product teams clone to get started. Define the layered testing contract: unit integration* E2E thresholds per surface. * Build and maintain shared test utilities, fixtures, data factories, and environment\-management tooling. * Integrate with CI/CD pipelines (CircleCI) so quality gates run reliably on every PR with no manual setup from product teams. **Quality Gate Enforcement Platform** * Design and operate the quality\-gate system: code coverage gates, PR review gates, build stability gates. * Build enforcement tooling that moves gates from advisory to blocking — with clear escalation paths and override controls that don't silently waive standards. * Instrument and surface gate compliance metrics (repos gated, gate\-fail\-merge rate, PR coverage trends) so engineering leadership has a live quality signal. * Drive SonarCloud configuration hygiene: quality profiles, branch rules, coverage ingestion, and gate\-scoring across all 100\+ repositories. **Quality Observability** * Define and own the quality metrics taxonomy: escape rate, main\-branch stability, attestable coverage (vs. reported), review depth, incident detection ratio. * Build dashboards and alerting so EMs and leads get a team\-level quality picture without manual data collection. Partner with the incident management process to close the loop from production incident root cause coverage gap* remediated test. **Technical Leadership** * Author and maintain the quality engineering standards playbook for Consumer Engineering. * Run architecture reviews for test infrastructure decisions in product squads. * Mentor senior STEs and SWEs on test design, framework usage, and quality patterns. * Represent Consumer Quality Enablement in cross\-functional engineering forums (release, platform, architecture). **What We're Looking For** * 8\+ years of software development or SDET experience with at least 3 years at staff/senior staff scope. * Production\-quality engineering skills: you write code that ships to a shared platform, not scripts that live in a test folder. * Deep experience with at least two of: Playwright/WebdriverIO, XCUITest, Espresso — and a clear framework philosophy, not just syntax familiarity. * Experience designing test frameworks from the ground up — including fixture management, test data strategy, environment isolation, and parallelization. * Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) and how quality gates integrate into merge workflows. * Familiarity with AWS services used in CI/CD and data pipelines (Lambda, S3, Bedrock) — enough to own the infrastructure your tooling runs on. * Experience with contract testing (Pact or equivalent) and API\-level quality tooling for microservice or GraphQL architectures. * Hands\-on experience building and evaluating LLM\-powered applications, including eval harness design, production model integration, test\-generation quality measurement, and regression prevention across model upgrades. * Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, API design, code review, observability, and reliability for internal platforms. * Ability to influence without authority at scale — your platform serves hundreds of engineers; you write docs, run office hours, and make it easy to do the right thing. * Experience in a platform/enablement team that served multiple product squads. * Familiarity with SonarCloud, Xray, or other quality gate and test management tooling. * Python and TypeScript fluency (our AI tooling stack and web test stack respectively). * Prior work building quality metrics systems — escape rate, flakiness rates, coverage trends — not just dashboards but the data pipelines behind them. * Mobile app testing experience across both iOS and Android platforms * Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Prior experience in Performance testing for Native apps * Performance and Load testing basic understanding **Success in this Role** Success here is not measured by test count or coverage percentage alone. It is measured by whether the engineering organization ships with more confidence. The challenge isn't finding bugs; it's building systems that catch the right bugs at the right time automatically. * You think at the system level, not the ticket level. * You don't need to be an expert in all of it — but you need to be genuinely curious about all of it. * You are as comfortable in a data pipeline as you are in a test framework. * You solve problems top\-down. * You are a force multiplier, not a ticket\-taker. * You are comfortable with ambiguity and willing to get your hands dirty. * You learn fast, form hypotheses, ship something small, and iterate. * You are the kind of engineer who makes the team around you better. * You give direct technical feedback. You write things down. * You make it easy for product engineers to do the right thing without asking. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. The world's largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity's legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. We apply AI to improve every user experience, product, matter, and investigation, so users can find the truth faster and act on data with confidence. Our team values curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning: we test boldly, learn quickly, and improve every day. ***Job Description and Requirements*** As an Advanced Software Engineer at Relativity, you will independently take features from design to production in our cloud\-based SaaS platform, using AI both as a tool and as a product capability. You will write production C\# and SQL, and you will build the services, instrumentation, evaluation harnesses, and data pipelines that turn an Applied Science approach into something customers can rely on, and diagnose what goes wrong when they can't. Our team is the driving force behind Case Strategy, a comprehensive suite of applications designed to empower case teams in constructing winning cases. By seamlessly integrating with Relativity, Case Strategy allows users to quickly and easily define, validate, and present their case strategies. Our team owns the flagship AI product that significantly reduces the time and effort needed to analyze, organize, and understand case information, enhancing attorney productivity and case management. We are proud to be one of the few teams at Relativity leveraging AI to innovate our products, making us a leader in the legal tech space. You will build and operate the AI systems behind Relativity aiR at production scale, under real legal stakes. You will work side by side with Applied Scientists, who own the science, and with Product, who owns the value case, so that what we ship meets the reliability target it was promised at. Along the way you will work with multiple databases, processing and web servers, search engines, and clustering technologies, using many of the newer and stronger technologies available. **Responsibilities** **Core software engineering** * **Product Development.** Build our primary product offering, Relativity, using object\-oriented analysis, design, and programming with SOLID principles and design patterns in multiple languages. * **Agile Delivery.** Participate in our SCRUM process and deliver through CI/CD with strong observability. * **Performance.** Improve application and system performance at scale. * **Quality and Support.** Troubleshoot issues by fixing defects and responding to client\-specific problems. **AI engineering** * **Prototype to Production.** Independently take a prototype or notebook from Applied Science to a deployed, monitored production service, delivered through CI/CD. * **Instrument.** Instrument models and prompts for quality, latency, and cost, and build dashboards and alerts against the reliability target. * **Diagnose.** Diagnose and mitigate common failure modes, including drift, latency regressions, cost blow\-ups, tool\-call and retrieval errors, and data\-quality effects on outputs. * **Evaluation Harness.** Build and maintain the evaluation harness and regression checks that gate releases, and extend coverage as use cases grow. * **Component Design.** Design components of an AI solution with senior review, document interfaces and non\-functional requirements, and apply patterns proven elsewhere in the company. * **Data Pipelines.** Build and operate the pipelines for a feature with reproducibility, lineage, and automated data\-quality monitoring. * **Trade\-offs.** Make and document implementation trade\-offs (batching, caching, model tier, timeouts, fallbacks) with sound reasoning about quality and cost. * **Security and Compliance.** Work with Relativity's security team to protect customer data and meet compliance requirements in every AI feature you build. * **AI\-Assisted Development.** Use modern AI coding tools in your daily work to raise the speed and quality of design, development, testing, and code review, and share what works with the team. **Collaboration and growth** * **Prioritize.** Prioritize independently acr ties, and future directions. **Required Qualifications** * **3\+ years** of professional software development experience using **C\#** and **Microsoft SQL Server** , or related object\-oriented languages. * Experience building web applications with **JavaScript** and **ASP.NET** . * Experience building scalable solutions on **Azure** or another cloud platform. * Experience working on an agile software development team. * Experience with **CI/CD** and an understanding of DevOps principles. * **1\+ year** building or operating AI/ML systems or their data pipelines, such as LLM integrations, prompt design, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), or embeddings. * Experience deploying and monitoring models or LLM\-based services in a cloud environment. * Practical ML fluency: you can read evaluation results, reason about model failure modes, and make quality, latency, and cost trade\-offs. * Experience building data pipelines with orchestration tooling (such as Prefect or Airflow) and attention to reproducibility. * Working knowledge of **Python** alongside C\#. * Regular use of AI\-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when to trust and when to verify their output. * Ability to design and document a component of a larger system, including non\-functional requirements. Effective collaboration with scientists, engineers, and product partners. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building evaluation harnesses or regression suites for AI systems, including evaluating LLM output quality. * Experience with LLM orchestration or agent frameworks, agentic workflows, and tool calling. * Experience with large\-scale or sensitive data. * Experience with **Azure DevOps** and Azure AI and data services. * Experience with **Docker** , **Kubernetes** , and **Helm** . * Experience with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation). * Experience with MLflow or Kubeflow, or with big data frameworks such as Apache Spark or Kafka. * Experience building or deploying models with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras, or depth in an area such as NLP. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Artificial Intelligence. * **Why We Could Be a Great Fit** * **Impactful Mission.** Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It. Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path.** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, which accelerates career growth. * **Engineering Culture.** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment.** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * **Community Impact.** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation and Benefits.** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, a home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $103,000 and $155,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Engineering Principle, Hardware Integration, Innovation, Problem Solving, Process Improvements, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, System Designs, Technical Documents, Troubleshooting

jobs.title: Senior Inference Optimization ML Engineer
jobs.description: At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high\-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state\-of\-the\-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real\-world environments and handling long\-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end\-to\-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale\-up to make generalist robotics a reality. Running large multimodal foundation models for a growing fleet of robots is expensive. We can't rely on one hardware vendor or the most expensive accelerators. We're looking for an Inference Optimization engineer to make Rhoda's models run fast, correctly, and cheaply on a wide range of hardware: AMD Instinct GPUs, Google TPUs, wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators, consumer GPUs like the RTX 5090, and the Jetson/Thor\-class compute on our robots. You'll decide which chip runs which workload, and then make sure it runs well there. You'll work closely with the research, robotics, and infrastructure teams. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Own cost\-efficient inference end\-to\-end.** Make Rhoda's foundation models (vision, video, language, proprioception, action) faster and cheaper to run, measured in latency, throughput, and cost per inference. * **Port and optimize models for non\-NVIDIA and lower\-cost hardware.** This includes AMD (ROCm, HIP, MIOpen/hipBLASLt, Composable Kernel), TPU (XLA, JAX, Pallas, PyTorch/XLA), wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators (their SDKs and compilers), and consumer Blackwell GPUs such as the RTX 5090 (FP8/FP4, small memory, multi\-GPU setups over PCIe). * **Own on\-robot inference.** Deploy and optimize models on Jetson/Thor\-class embedded compute under tight latency, power, thermal, and memory limits, and decide how work is split between the robot and the cloud to meet real\-time control requirements. * **Evaluate hardware rigorously.** Build cost/performance models (perf/$, perf/W, memory capacity and bandwidth, interconnect) for each chip and model family. Write clear recommendations on which hardware to buy or rent for serving, offline evaluation, and on\-robot use. * **Build hardware\-portable optimizations.** Write and tune kernels that work across vendors where possible (Triton, Pallas, MLIR\-based compilers) and vendor\-specific ones where the speedup justifies it. Handle attention, KV cache, memory layout, and fused operators on every backend. * **Apply model compression for constrained hardware.** Use quantization (INT8, FP8, FP4/MX formats, AWQ/GPTQ), pruning, distillation, and model or tensor parallelism so models fit and perform well on chips with less memory or limited data\-type support. * **Keep results correct and consistent across backends.** Build tests that check numerical parity, policy quality, and robot\-relevant behaviour, so a model gives the same results whichever chip it runs on. * **Build benchmarking and regression infrastructure across hardware.** Track latency baselines, throughput curves, and cost per inference for every model version on every target, with automated detection of regressions. * **Work with research engineers** to design models that stay efficient and portable from the start, for example by avoiding operators that only exist on one vendor's hardware. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 2\+ years of experience in inference optimization, ML systems, ML compilers, or a closely related field. * Deep hands\-on experience with PyTorch. * Strong understanding of compute, memory bandwidth, memory capacity, and interconnect bottlenecks, and how they change from one hardware architecture to another. * Experience with model optimization techniques: quantization (INT8/FP8/FP4, AWQ), distillation, pruning, and compilation (torch.compile, XLA, TensorRT, IREE/MLIR, TVM, or vendor compilers). * Familiarity with inference serving frameworks and their support for different hardware (e.g. vLLM on ROCm/TPU, SGLang, JetStream, Triton Inference Server). * Excellent debugging and measurement skills. You can take "this is slow on chip X" or "this costs too much" and turn it into clear bottlenecks, experiments, and validated improvements. * A high\-ownership, pragmatic mindset. You care about the total cost of a solution, not just peak benchmark numbers. **Nice to Have (But Not Required)** ----------------------------------- * Experience optimizing inference for diffusion models. * Production or deep project experience with **at least one accelerator stack other than NVIDIA datacenter GPUs**: AMD ROCm, Google TPU, wafer\-scale and dataflow accelerators, Groq, Tenstorrent, AWS Trainium/Inferentia, Intel Gaudi, or similar, or serious work deploying on consumer GPUs. * Kernel authoring on more than one backend: HIP or Composable Kernel on AMD, Pallas on TPU, Triton on both NVIDIA and AMD, CUTLASS/CuTe. * Contributions to open\-source ML compilers or hardware backends (PyTorch, OpenXLA, Triton, vLLM, IREE, TVM). * Experience running inference on wafer\-scale systems, TPU pods, or fleets of consumer GPUs. * Hands\-on experience with Jetson/Thor\-class platforms (TensorRT on Jetson, JetPack, DLA, power and thermal profiling). * Experience with multimodal or video model inference (variable\-length sequences, packing/bucketing). * Speculative decoding, continuous batching, disaggregated prefill/decode, or other LLM serving optimizations. * Experience with streaming or low\-latency systems for real\-time robot control. * Experience working with hardware vendors on driver or compiler bugs and early\-access silicon. **Why This Role** ----------------- * **Direct impact on cost and scale.** Every gain in perf/$ you deliver lowers the cost of serving models and evaluating new ones, and of putting capable models on many more robots. * **Strategic influence over hardware.** Your benchmarks and recommendations will directly shape which accelerators Rhoda buys and builds on, in the cloud and on the robot. * **High ownership on a small, elite team.** You'll own the optimization layer that decides how fast and how cheaply our foundation models run in the real world, on every target we use.

jobs.title: AI Platform Operations Manager
jobs.description: **THE COMPANY:** STACK INFRASTRUCTURE (STACK) provides digital infrastructure to scale the world’s most innovative companies. We are an award\-winning industry leader in building, owning, and operating highly efficient, cost\-effective wholesale, colocation, and cloud data centers. Each of our national facilities meets or exceeds the highest industry standards in all operational categories of availability, security, connectivity, and physical resilience. STACK offers the scale and geographic reach that rapidly growing hyperscale and enterprise companies need. The world runs on data. Data runs on STACK. **THE POSITION:** The DevOps Engineer, AI Platform is responsible for automating, deploying, and operating the infrastructure and delivery pipelines that support STACK’s enterprise AI platform on Azure. This is a hands\-on engineering role focused on build and run — not oversight. Reporting to Head of AI, Enterprise AI \& Data Strategy org this individual owns the infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, containerization, observability, and release automation that allow AI engineers and enterprise application teams to ship agentic AI solutions, RAG pipelines, and integration services reliably and repeatably. The role sits at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, and MLOps — turning platform architecture into automated, governed, observable, and cost\-efficient environments that teams across the organization build on. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Infrastructure Automation \& Infrastructure as Code** * Build, maintain, and version infrastructure\-as\-code modules for Azure environments using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM, including compute, networking, storage, identity, and AI platform resources. * Automate provisioning of AI platform components — Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search, Cosmos DB, ADLS Gen2, and Databricks — as reusable, parameterized deployment patterns. * Maintain environment parity across development, test, and production, including configuration management, drift detection, and remediation. * Implement and enforce tagging, naming, and resource organization standards that support governance, chargeback, and lifecycle management. * Automate routine platform operations — patching, certificate rotation, key and secret rotation, backup validation, and disaster recovery testing. **CI/CD \& Release Engineering** * Design, build, and operate CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for application code, infrastructure code, container images, and AI/agent deployments. * Implement automated build, test, security scanning, artifact management, and promotion gates across environments. * Establish branching strategies, code review standards, and release management practices in partnership with AI engineering and enterprise application teams. * Build deployment automation for agentic AI services, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, and integration workloads running on Azure Container Apps and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). * Support model and prompt release workflows — versioning, staged rollout, evaluation gates, and rollback procedures for LLM\-based applications. **Container Platform \& AI Workload Operations** * Operate and tune AKS and Azure Container Apps, including cluster upgrades, node pool sizing, autoscaling, ingress, networking, and workload isolation. * Build and maintain container images, base image standards, and registry governance in Azure Container Registry. * Manage compute scheduling and scaling for AI workloads, including GPU\-backed and inference\-heavy workloads where required. * Implement resiliency patterns — health probes, retries, throttling, quota management, and failover — for AI endpoints and integration services. **Observability, Reliability \& Incident Response** * Instrument platform and AI services with logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and equivalent open\-source tooling. * Build dashboards and service\-level indicators covering platform availability, latency, throughput, error rates, token consumption, and model endpoint performance. * Participate in on\-call rotation, lead incident triage and resolution for platform issues, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions. * Develop and maintain runbooks, operational documentation, and automated remediation for recurring issues. **Security, Governance \& Cost Optimization** * Implement DevSecOps practices — secrets management in Azure Key Vault, managed identity usage, least\-privilege access, dependency and container vulnerability scanning, and policy\-as\-code. * Partner with Information Security to ensure pipelines and environments meet enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements. * Support Azure FinOps practices through cost visibility, rightsizing, reserved capacity, and automated controls on non\-production and idle resources. * Maintain audit trails and change records for infrastruct rack record. * Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Bicep, or ARM — including module design, state management, and reusable patterns. * Proven experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. * Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration — Docker, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and Azure Container Apps or equivalent. * Solid working knowledge of Azure core services — compute, networking (VNet, NSG, Private Endpoints), storage, identity (Entra ID), and Key Vault. * Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash. * Experience with monitoring and observability tooling — Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, or Grafana. * Working knowledge of Git\-based workflows, code review practices, and artifact/registry management. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot production issues across infrastructure, network, and application layers. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**: * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ\-400\), Azure Administrator (AZ\-104\), or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA). * Experience deploying and operating AI/ML workloads — model endpoints, RAG pipelines, vector databases, or agentic services in production. * Familiarity with MLOps tooling and practices — Azure Machine Learning, MLflow, Databricks, or equivalent model lifecycle platforms. * Experience deploying MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers or similar integration services connecting AI agents to enterprise systems. * Exposure to agentic AI frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or AutoGen from a deployment and operations perspective. * Experience with GPU compute provisioning, quota management, and inference cost optimization. * Knowledge of FinOps frameworks and Azure cost optimization practices. * Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Microsoft 365, Freshworks ITSM, Workday, NetSuite, or Procore. * Experience in data center, hyperscale, or infrastructure\-intensive industry environments. **Compensation Range:** $128,260\.00 \- $146,017\.59**THIS MIGHT BE RIGHT FOR YOU IF:** * You are a strong communicator, you are persuasive and clear, blending analytics with experience in decision\-making. * You do not get flustered easily. You can juggle multiple priorities while balancing urgent requests with shifting timelines and deliverables. * You are a team builder. You take the time to understand and develop the strengths of your resources while formulating long\-term plans for the growth and success of the team. * You are naturally curious and driven toward continual improvement. While you celebrate your successes, you take time to review and analyze campaigns for future learning. **WHY STACK?** * We offer a competitive compensation package with strong benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401K program, flexible spending accounts – even a cell phone subsidy. * We foster a culture of appreciation, including peer\-to\-peer recognition and rewards programs. * Fun is part of our DNA, with events, game nights, happy hours, and barbecues. * We’re growing – this is a great time to join and make an impact! *STACK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, mental or physical disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law* ***Note to external agencies****: We are not accepting any blind submissions or resumes/cvs from recruitment agencies. Any candidates sent to STACK Infrastructure, Inc. will not be accepted or considered as a submission without a signed agreement in place. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of STACK Infrastructure, Inc.*

jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **The Experience** The Digital Enterprise Technology – Legal, Risk \& Compliance (LRC) Application Development team is looking for a sharp, curious Full Stack Software Engineer who loves building great software and building it fast with modern AI tooling. This role is first and foremost about engineering excellence: strong fundamentals, clean architecture, and the ability to ship end\-to\-end features across the stack. We're looking for someone who treats AI coding assistants as a core part of the craft, not a side skill — using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex daily to move faster, explore designs, and raise code quality. You'll work across the full stack — frontend, backend, APIs, data, and integrations — with Salesforce as the primary building platform. Salesforce experience is a plus, not a must\-have — we'll get you ramped quickly if you bring strong core engineering skills. **What You'll Actually Be Doing** * Design, build, and ship full\-stack features end\-to\-end — UI, APIs, business logic, data models, and integrations — with a strong bias for clean, maintainable, well\-tested code. * Build modern frontend experiences (component\-based UI, responsive design) and robust backend services and APIs, applying solid object\-oriented and software design principles. * Use AI\-assisted development tools — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — throughout the SDLC: scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and code review, while maintaining engineering rigor over AI\-generated output. * Design and implement integrations using REST APIs, event\-driven patterns, and enterprise integration practices. * Where the work runs on Salesforce, develop using Lightning Web Components (LWC), Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Flows, and the platform's security model — with support to ramp up if you're new to the platform. * Explore and build agentic and AI\-powered features (e.g., Agentforce, workflow automation, AI agents) that bring real automation and intelligence into business processes, with appropriate governance and human\-in\-the\-loop checks. * Own features through the full lifecycle: solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Contribute to CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, and Agile ceremonies; and raise the bar on engineering practices across the team. * **You're Our Person If...** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. * 4\+ years of professional full\-stack software engineering experience — strong fundamentals across frontend, backend, APIs, and data. * Proficiency in modern frontend technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, CSS, modern frameworks) and backend development (object\-oriented programming, RESTful API design, databases/SQL, data modeling). * Hands\-on, daily experience using AI\-assisted coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar — able to write precise prompts and critically evaluate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, and performance. * Solid grounding in software design patterns, SDLC, Agile methodologies, Git, and CI/CD practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to independently design and deliver scalable technical solutions. Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * **Even Better If...** * Experience developing on the Salesforce platform (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce Flows, platform security model) — a strong plus. * Exposure to Agentforce, Data Cloud, Einstein AI, or other AI\-agent/workflow\-orchestration platforms. * Experience with enterprise integration tools (MuleSoft, Platform Events, Named Credentials) or event\-driven architectures. * Salesforce Platform Developer I/II certification, or equivalent industry certifications. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization, and observability/engineering productivity metrics. Experience shipping a production AI\-powered feature (e.g., agentic workflows, RAG, LLM\-backed UI) — one of the strongest signals we look for. * **What Makes You Successful** * A true engineer at heart: someone who can reason about architecture, write clean code, and diagnose hard bugs — with or without AI in the loop. * Genuinely AI\-native: you reach for Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex by default, and use them to build fluency across the stack, not just in your specialty. * Curious and adaptable — comfortable picking up new platforms (including Salesforce, Mulesoft) quickly when the work calls for it. * Ownership mindset: you drive features to done, care about quality, and elevate the engineers around you. * Excited about applying AI meaningfully to real business problems — automation, decision support, and smarter workflows . Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. **About this role:** Samsara's cloud\-connected sensor platform collects observations about the world in near real\-time. Samsara builds an extensive set of products, including battery\-powered, wireless sensors, Linux\-based IoT gateways, and Internet\-connected dashcams. These devices are the building blocks Samsara uses to construct enterprise solutions for a wide range of verticals, including commercial fleet management and industrial monitoring. Through a unique integration of sensor data such as GPS, acceleration, temperature, video, and more, we enable our customers to gain greater insights into operations, identify and eliminate inefficiencies, and react to alerts all in near real\-time. As a Firmware Engineer at Samsara, you will develop software that runs on millions of devices, deployed by our industrial and enterprise customers. You'll tackle challenges including evaluating and selecting hardware components, bringing up new hardware platforms and sensors, building systems to gather data and detect meaningful events, and structuring recorded data to allow efficient analysis across thousands of devices while providing deep insights into individual events. We use C for our MCU\-based platforms, Golang for embedded applications on Linux\-based gateways and backend services, Google protocol buffers to structure data, and various AWS technologies to process and store data. Experience with these exact technologies is not required. **You should apply if:** * **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. * **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. * **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. * **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high\-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. *Click here**to learn more about Samsara's cultural philosophy.* **In this role, you will:** * **Shape the hardware, not just the code that runs on it.** Sit in reviews with our electrical engineers and help choose the right SoC, amount of flash/RAM, and combination of sensors, then prove those choices out on prototypes that reach real customers in months, not years. * **Be the first person to make a new board do anything at all.** Bring up new platforms and prototypes from virgin silicon: configure I/O, get SPI, I2C, UART, BLE talking, debug system init, validate the design, and turn unproven hardware into a product. * **Build the layers everything else depends on.** Peripheral drivers, secure bootloaders, device firmware updates, as well as the core management layers like power and connectivity, that determine whether a device in the field quietly recovers on its own or becomes an RMA. * **Chase every microamp.** Design protocols and hardware management for battery\-powered sensors and gateways where the gap between good firmware and great firmware is measured in years of device life. * **Work with the people who ship the whole product.** Partner with product, full\-stack, mobile and quality engineers so the data your firmware produces arrives intact and useful as it lands in the hands of dispatchers, fleet managers, and technicians who depend on it every shift. * **Raise the bar for the engineers around you.** Your designs, reviews, and instincts help raise the ceiling for the whole tea  **OTA and device firmware update at fleet scale** \- A/B partitions, rollback, and the discipline of never bricking a device you cannot physically reach. * **Embedded Linux on the gateway side** \- Yocto or Buildroot, kernel drivers, device trees. * **CAN and J1939 work on commercial vehicles**, including reverse\-engineering data bus parameters across makes and models. * **Python and Bash for tooling**, and hardware\-in\-the\-loop test automation. * **You've been on the factory floor** \- You have an understanding of the processes behind the mass production and quality assurance of electronics. You have a track record of fixing production show stoppers. **Total Rewards** At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above\-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long\-term success: a flexible, employee\-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. **Flexible Working** At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in\-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on\-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. **Belonging at Samsara** At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. **Accommodations** Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. **Our Commitment to Authenticity** We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. **Fraudulent Employment Offers** Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us\-greenhouse\-mail.io or @mail3\.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer*
jobs.description: **The Job** ----------- The Innovation and Technology Department is seeking a versatile and experienced **Full Stack Engineer**\* to administer, integrate, customize, and support enterprise application platforms and related systems. This advanced technical position will work across multiple technology layers, including enterprise software platforms, cloud and software\-as\-a\-service applications, application interfaces, backend services, databases, scripting, automation, application security, and system integrations. The position will use both traditional programming and low\-code development tools to extend platform capabilities, automate operational processes, and securely connect enterprise systems. The Full Stack Engineer will support platforms and technologies such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, generative artificial intelligence solutions, application programming interfaces, and other enterprise applications. The successful candidate will be capable of diagnosing complex issues that span applications, integrations, databases, operating systems, networks, identity services, and cloud platforms. Although application development is an important component of the position, its primary responsibility is the administration, reliability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of enterprise systems and platforms. Duties may include, but are not limited to: * Administer, configure, customize, maintain, and support enterprise application platforms, cloud services, and software\-as\-a\-service solutions, including ServiceNow, Microsoft Power Platform, Power BI, and approved generative AI technologies. * Monitor system availability, performance, capacity, and resource utilization; diagnose complex issues across applications, integrations, databases, operating systems, identity services, and networks; and implement corrective actions. * Develop scripts, workflows, automation, platform applications, and supporting front\-end or backend components using traditional programming and low\-code development tools. * Design, secure, document, and support APIs, web services, connectors, Model Context Protocol connections, and integrations between enterprise platforms, data sources, identity services, and third\-party systems. * Support application databases, data models, queries, data transformations, reporting solutions, and related backup, recovery, performance, and access\-control requirements. * Implement security controls for authentication, authorization, service accounts, secrets, certificates, logging, auditing, data protection, and least\-privilege access; for more detailed information, view the* *Systems Support Analyst III* *job description.* **ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT** The Innovation and Technology Department provides enterprise technology services and safeguards mission\-critical systems, infrastructure, platforms, and data used throughout San Bernardino County. jobs.description: **Why Sarepta? Why Now?** Sarepta is on an urgent mission: engineer precision genetic medicine for rare diseases that devastate lives and cut futures short. We hold a leadership position in Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy and are building a robust portfolio of programs across muscle, central nervous system, and cardiac diseases. Our next\-generation siRNA platform is focused on chronically administered therapies for neurodegenerative and pulmonary diseases. We’re looking for people who see unlimited potential in themselves and who are motivated by an unwavering commitment to patients. **What Sarepta Offers** At Sarepta, we care deeply about all the people in our community and believe in the importance of supporting them in all aspects of their lives. We aspire to maintain a culture that acknowledges people bring their whole selves to work, and we will strive to help everyone in our community integrate their work and personal lives while maintaining productivity. We are committed to offering a range of benefits and work\-life resources designed to support people in the following areas: * Physical and Emotional Wellness * Financial Wellness * Support for Caregivers For a full list of our comprehensive benefits, see our website: https://www.sarepta.com/join\-us **The Importance of the Role** The Duchenne Nurse Educator (DNE) works in a highly visible, dedicated team environment. The DNE will support health care providers (HCPs), patients, and caregivers through education on Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD), the infusion process of our approved therapies, and Sarepta patient support programs. This role develops relationships with HCP’s, patients, and caregivers to support both the HCP’s and the families through their journey on therapy. The DNE also collaborates closely with their cross functional partners to ensure ongoing compliance with therapy. Triage support utilizes the nursing process to liaise with patient care teams to evaluate patient safety needs over the telephone. to patient care teams, if needed, while adhering to organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines.**The Opportunity to Make a Difference** * The DNE will educate providers, infusion nurses, patients, and caregivers on Sarepta’s approved therapies for DMD and the infusion process. * Serve as a recognized expert on DMD education (Genotype, deletions, disease process, etc.) * Stay current on the DMD environment. * Collaborate with internal cross functional partners and external partners to ensure ongoing support to HCP’s patients, and families. * Present to audiences compliantly. * Conduct Programs for disease state awareness. * Assist in improving infusion experience for DMD patients by providing ongoing support to the infusion nurses and sharing best practices. * Work with SareptAssist team and specialty pharmacy to ensure smooth transition from infusion center to home infusion for PMO therapies. * Educational support to patients and families prior to and after initiating therapy. * Attend advocacy meetings and represent Sarepta at industry conferences. * Travel to training meetings, medical offices, and home health agencies, as necessary. * Other related experienced physician in a confidential manner. * + Documents calls according to established guidelines (PV reporting).o Directs the patient care team to the proper Customer Service Center (e.g., Medical information, SareptAssist) based on the topic of the call. Requires on call coverage to provide day, night, and weekend coverage. **More about You** * Registered Nurse with a bachelor’s degree (BSN/BS/BA) from an accredited school. * At least 5 years of relevant experience; Infusion, Neuromuscular, Pediatric Neurology, or other specialty experience preferred. * Prefer 2 or more years’ experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry. * Highly interested in educating on the disease state of Duchenne and working with health care professionals to support patients and families. * Exceptional presentation, verbal, and written communication skills * Demonstrates team\-based skills collaborating with cross functional partners, both internally and externally. * Competent and comfortable presenting in group and individual settings, live and virtually, with and without technology. * Empathetic, friendly, and relatable, with effective communication skills. * Comfortable speaking with patients/families and providing education and support to them. * Willingness to work as part of a team in a demanding environment. * Embraces continuous learning/seeks knowledge. * Valid driver’s license and in good standing. * Requires flexibility in rotating on call coverage 24 hours/7 days per week. * Ability to travel, including ground and air transportation, up to 60% within assigned territory is required. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform (DevEx)
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ServiceTitan is building the Developer Platform for enterprise\-scale SaaS. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. jobs.title: Affiliate Rewards And Payments Engineer
jobs.description: **JOB TYPE**: Contract, full\-time, remote (US time zones) **PAY**: $500 per month to start, plus founding equity options \| Compensation review after launch **FULL JOB DESCRIPTION**: Affiliate Rewards And Payments Engineer, Founding Engineering Team HelpAfterAccident \| Remote \| Hiring Immediately **We launch in Florida in a matter of weeks, and we need an engineer who can start now.** HelpAfterAccident is building the app that takes an injured person from the accident scene to the right personal injury attorney and the right treating doctor, fast. One intake, one journey, everyone connected. The patient never pays. To grow, we are launching an affiliate program. Our affiliates will earn points when they promote the HelpAfterAccident brand and cash those points out for cash rewards. We need the engineer who builds the technology behind that program and connects it to our platform. This is a specialist role. You must have already built an affiliate, referral, rewards or payout platform and taken it live. If you have not built this type of system before, this role is not the right fit. **Why This Role Is Urgent** * Launch is weeks away, and the affiliate program is part of how we grow from day one. * We are interviewing now and want our hire working within days of an offer. * This is not a role that will sit open. When we find the right person, we close it. * If you can start this week, say so in your application. **What You Will Build** * Affiliate tracking that attributes clicks, likes, shares, sign\-ups and conversions to the right affiliate, using unique links, codes and UTM tracking. * A points engine that applies our earning rules and keeps a full ledger of every point earned, adjusted and redeemed, including reversals and clawbacks. * A cash\-out flow that turns points into cash through a payout provider (for example Stripe Connect, PayPal Payouts or Tremendous), with thresholds, approvals and status tracking. * Fraud controls: duplicate and self\-referral detection, bot and click\-fraud filtering, velocity limits and holds on suspicious activity. * Affiliate onboarding with identity checks and the tax information needed for payouts (W\-9 and 1099\). * An affiliate dashboard for links, activity, points, conversions and payout history. * An admin view for our team to manage affiliates, set earning rules, review flags and approve payouts. * Integration with our existing platform through APIs, webhooks and event tracking, with reporting on clicks, conversions, points and payouts. **What You Bring** * You have personally built at least one affiliate, referral, rewards, points or payout platform and taken it to production. We will ask you to walk us through it. * Hands\-on experience integrating payment or payout providers, including webhooks, reconciliation and failed\-payment handling. * Experience building ledger\-based systems where every balance can be traced and audited. * Experience with attribution and conversion tracking across web and mobile. * Experience preventing fraud in a referral or rewards program. * Strong back\-end and database skills, plus enough front\-end ability to ship dashboards. * A track record of shipping without a large team or perfect requirements. * Clear written and spoken English and reliable availability during US business hours. **Strong plus:** social media engagement tracking, points\-to\-cash or gift\-card redemption, KYC and tax reporting for payouts, and work in regulated industries such as healthcare, legal or financial services. **Compensation, Spelled Out** **Starting pay: $500 per month, paid monthly as a contractor.** **Prove\-it period:** the first 45 to 60 days are a prove\-it period for both sides. Either side can end the arrangement at any time. **Compensation review:** once the product launches, we review your pay based on what you delivered. We are honest about this: the starting pay is low because we are an early\-stage startup putting every dollar into launch. The upside is real ownership in a company at the very start, a pay review tied to launch and a seat at the table while the product is built. **What This Job Is Like** * This is startup life. Full\-time, all in and fast. * Weekends are required until the product launches. * You work directly with leadership. No layers, no committees and no hiding behind tickets. * You will not wait three days to solve a three\-hour problem. * You own the affiliate system end to end and say plainly when something is behind. **If you are looking for a 9 to 5 with weekends off, this is not the role.** **Be ready to provide verifiable professional references. We verify who we hire, including identity, work authorization, work history and technical skills, using independent and, where appropriate, official verification services.** People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Application Question(s): * REQUIRED: Describe the affiliate, referral or rewards payment platform you personally built. What did it track, how many affiliates or users did it support, and is it live today? (Dealbreaker if they have not built one.) * REQUIRED: Which payment or payout providers have you integrated (for example Stripe Connect, PayPal Payouts, Tremendous, Tipalti)? What did you build on top of them? * REQUIRED: How would you design a points ledger so every balance can be audited and reversed if a conversion is cancelled? * REQUIRED: How have you detected and stopped referral or click fraud in a past program? * REQUIRED: How would you track likes, shares and conversions from social media back to the right affiliate? * REQUIRED: When can you start? Starting pay is $500 per month, with a compensation review after launch. Does that work for you? * REQUIRED: How many hours can you commit in your first 7 days, and each week after? Weekends are required until launch. Experience: * Software development: 3 years (Required) Work Location: Remote
