jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real\-time, event\-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on. Solace is the leading real\-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real\-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees. So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work! **About the Role** Solace is building Solace Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka® (SSK), by the creators of Nisshi. SSK builds on Nisshi Diskless Streaming for Apache Kafka®, an open\-source project licensed under Apache\-2\.0\. Both implement the Apache Kafka® protocol and separate compute from storage. Stateless Protocol Engines scale out by adding more, and data is stored in object storage rather than on local disks. Other systems depend on this platform, so writes must remain correct under heavy concurrent load. The work covers wire protocols, storage engines, and the coordination problems that arise in keeping order and consistency across stateless engines. The team focuses on scale, security, latency, and robustness, and tunes for tail latency, throughput, and cost per byte; object storage sets its own floor on latency. You will own pieces of the data path end to end, working in Rust. Part of that work takes place in public, in the Nisshi repository. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build core data\-path components: request handling and storage, for a system that must hold strict ordering guarantees under load. * Implement and evolve Apache Kafka® wire\-protocol handling: parsing, framing, versioning, and backward compatibility with Apache Kafka® client libraries. * Build and harden storage engines: offset and sequence coordination, compaction, retention, and correctness under concurrent access. * Diagnose difficult defects: races, consistency edge cases, and security or robustness issues that surface only under real concurrent load. * Profile and tune throughput and latency against measured production numbers. * Work with the open\-source community on Nisshi: review, discuss, and contribute. **What You’ll Bring to the Role** One of the Following, at a Deep Level: * Hands\-on experience building a high\-throughput, log\-based streaming or messaging system, such as Apache Kafka® or a comparable platform: wire protocols, client/server compatibility, and the internals of a system that can’t lose data. * Deep experience with a database’s internals: storage engine, write\-ahead\-log or commit\-log design, replication and consensus, or query execution. Any flavor counts (relational, graph, document, or otherwise). If you’ve solved these problems inside a database, you understand the ones we’re solving. Both Paths Also Need: * Strong systems\-programming fundamentals (Rust, C\+\+, Go, or Java). * A track record of owning hard technical problems end to end, from design through production. * Comfort working remotely and asynchronously, across time zones. Preferred: * Production experience in Rust. * Working knowledge of the Apache Kafka® protocol, client libraries, and ecosystem. * Hands\-on experience working on the internals of a system like Apache Kafka®, Redpanda, Pulsar, WarpStream, NATS JetStream, or Solace Event Broker. * Experience running one of these systems at production scale. * Experience with security hardening, fuzzing, or performance engineering of network services. **Why You’ll Love Working at Solace** At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes. * **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry. * **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around. * **Hybrid\-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered. * **Values\-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience. * **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast. * **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world\-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it). * **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time. * **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!). **At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.** To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills. Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions. **Let’s Talk** Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you. Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you. Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted. At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us! \#LI\-NM1

jobs.title: Technical Automation Lead
jobs.description: **Technical Automation Lead \| Contract\-to\-Hire \| Stache Cups** Remote \| Immediate start \| Paid implementation engagement, with a path to full\-time employment START AND LAUNCH PRIORITY We need someone available to start immediately and work directly with founder Bo Wicker through the October 30\-November 1 weekend toward a substantial launch on Monday, November 2, 2026\. THE OPPORTUNITY I'm Bo, Founder and CEO of Stache Cups. We are connecting an automated e\-commerce infrastructure for schools, country clubs, Greek organizations, corporations, resorts and other markets. We need a resourceful technical owner to connect the existing components, resolve the remaining gaps, make the operation reliable and maintain it as we scale. Preserve working components and approved designs. Our targets are 40\+ new storefronts per day per market and ultimately 1,000\+ per week. The intended growth path is to transition some or all of that incentive into a higher guaranteed salary by mutual written agreement. Employment conversion and future compensation are subject to a separate written agreement. What complete Schools/Clubs deliverables you could realistically commit to by November 2, the dependencies, and a capped quote for the initial paid engagement. 4\. Your interest in the proposed contract\-to\-hire compensation structure and longer\-term 40\-hour role. 5\. Your weekly working availability, any supporting team, and the tools/costs included in your proposal. Please distinguish demonstrated production results from estimates. We are looking for someone excited to take ownership and grow with an established manufacturing business. Bo Wicker Founder \& CEO, Stache Cups Pay: $40,000\.00 \- $50,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Paid time off Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Software Developer Associate
jobs.description: The Solomon and Keller laboratories in Psychiatry and Behavioral Sciences at Stanford University are seeking a joint Software Developer Associate to develop software for the storage, management, access, and analysis of human electrophysiological data. The role will also be expected to contribute to existing software packages for conducting brain stimulation experiments. The goal of both labs is to understand the fundamental principles governing how the human brain responds to electrical stimulation, and to develop next\-generation neurotherapeutics to treat neuropsychiatric conditions. The Software Developer Associate will assist in this mission by developing software that enables research analysts to efficiently and flexibly interact with complex human neural data and associated metadata (including neuroimaging, behavioral, medical, and audio\-visual measures). The Associate will work under the general supervision of the laboratory PI and in direct collaboration with postdoctoral researchers and graduate students. **Duties include:** * Assessment of users needs relating to the flexible access and analysis of human electrophysiology data and associated research metadata. * Assist in the development of new Python\-based software packages and APIs to enable easy, efficient, and fast analysis of these data. * Assist in the integration of new software with in\-house and Stanford\-based data storage solutions. * Contribute to refinements of existing software packages for conducting transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) research experiments, including hardware/software interfacing and GUI development. * Real\-time technical support and troubleshooting during TMS experiments. * Develop user guides and tutorials for newly\-developed software and follow best practices for code documentation and version control. * Follow team software development methodology. jobs.title: Engineer
jobs.description: **Nature of Work** ------------------ Under limited supervision, within the Agency’s Architecture and Engineering Section, performs highly complex engineering in the area of mechanical engineering, including electrical, civil and/or technical work managing large, ongoing construction, maintenance and renovation projects for major infrastructure systems in the 40\+ buildings owned and operated by the Agency statewide (including the WV State Capitol Building). jobs.description: **The Company:** Sungrow North America is a leading provider of renewable energy solutions, specializing in the development and manufacturing of photovoltaic inverters and energy storage systems. The company offers a comprehensive range of products and services designed to optimize the performance and efficiency of solar power installations. Sungrow North America aims to provide sustainable and reliable energy solutions to meet the growing demand for clean power and is known for its commitment to innovation, high\-quality standards, and exceptional customer service. **The Position:** The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is a hybrid position based in the Sungrow Houston, TX office, reporting to the Service AI Agent product owner within the Strategic Expert team. The Service Innovation \& Development Engineer is an intelligent agent with Sungrow domain knowledge, deployed in Sungrow's company business software platforms including Microsoft Teams. Today it tracks and escalates unanswered field requests, answers technical questions from archived Q\&A, and identifies spare parts from photos using OCR, image embeddings, catalog retrieval and LLM\-based evidence checking. The developer owns the codebase end to end (design, implementation, deployment and operation) and leads the next wave of integrations with Sungrow business systems. This is a hands\-on role on a small team, working directly with the field service engineers who use the tool every day. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Design, implement, test and ship features for the Service AI Agent (Node.js/TypeScript, Microsoft Teams SDK, Azure Bot Framework) across the full stack: Teams ingress, request lifecycle, background workers, retrieval and data layer. * Own the production stack: PostgreSQL schema and knex migrations (pgvector, pg\_trgm), the Python SigLIP image\-encoder worker, public ingress (Cloudflare tunnel today, Azure App Service as the target), and the deployment runbooks. * Extend the spare\-parts identification pipeline: OCR of board labels and barcodes, hybrid retrieval (identifier, text\-embedding and image\-similarity), LLM evidence comparison, company part\-number validation and the human confirmation and learning loop. * Build integrations with Sungrow business systems: PLM 3DEXPERIENCE (parts and BOM), iQMS (serial\-number trace and as\-built records), SharePoint via Microsoft Graph, and the Airtable spare\-parts inventory; later, controlled write\-back for ordering and repair workflows. * Deliver structural\-part PDF drawing matching and BOM linkage, the next planned work package. * Build the real\-data evaluation harness: expert\-labelled test sets, regression suites, accuracy and latency comparisons; use the results to adapt OCR and retrieval models. * Operate the service: monitoring and Application Insights telemetry, incident response, catalog and data refreshes, and permission hygiene (Teams RSC scopes, Graph app roles, Key Vault secrets). * Manage LLM and embedding usage (OpenAI API): prompt and model\-version changes, cost and latency tracking, content\-minimization and data\-handling rules. * Write and maintain design documents, deployment runbooks and user guides for field engineers. * Coordinate with Sungrow HQ R\&D and IT in China on API access, authorization and data sources. * Set coding standards, CI and the release process; review and mentor the part\-time developer on the team. * Gather feedback from field service engineers and the Strategic Expert team, prioritize the backlog with the product owner, and deliver in staged rollouts. * Other duties as assigned. **Minimum Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ\-204 Developer, AI\-102 AI Engineer) desired but not required. * Solar, battery, power\-electronics or industrial\-service domain experience desired. * 3 plus years of professional software development, including 2 plus years with Node.js/TypeScript in production. * Experience building bots or integrations on Microsoft Teams and Azure Bot Framework (or a comparable messaging platform), and with Microsoft Graph and Entra ID app registrations. * Strong SQL and PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations (knex or similar) and query tuning; vector search (pgvector) a plus. * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar): prompt design, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval\-augmented generation and evaluation. * Working Python for ML inference services (PyTorch, transformers, image preprocessing), enough to maintain and extend the SigLIP encoder worker. * REST API design and integration, OAuth2 and token handling, retries and error handling. * Git, automated tests (vitest or similar), CI, Docker, and Linux/macOS server operation. * Must possess effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with field engineers and non\-technical stakeholders. * English Language Proficiency required. * Mandarin Chinese Proficiency desired but not required (coordination with HQ R\&D). **Travel:** * Up to 10% (Sungrow service and training centers and customer sites for user feedback and field testing). **Work Location and Status:** * Contract role based out of Houston, TX. * No visa/legal sponsorship. **Compensation:** * Compensation commensurate with experience * Competitive benefits package and employee programs * Strong personal and company growth opportunities *For candidates in the states of California, Colorado, New York and Washington, the anticipated annual base salary for this role is between $75,000 \- $105,000 This range does not include any other compensation components or other benefits that an individual may be eligible for. The base salary offered is dependent upon several factors, including but not limited to job\-related skills, qualifications, experience, education, location, or other factors related to the role.* ***Sungrow is an equal opportunity employer. Due to strong interest in this role, Sungrow will only reach out to those candidates who best meet the requirements of the position. Thank you for your interest in Sungrow.*** \#LI\-LV1

jobs.title: Staff Robotics Software Engineer, Perception & AI
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What we need** Symbotic is seeking for a Staff Robotics Software Engineer, Perception \& AI to join our Perception team within our Mobile Robotics organization. Your job will be to develop robust, production\-grade 3D perception systems for mobile robots while building intelligent agents and automated workflows that improve how perception data is labeled, validated, and used to drive future autonomous behaviors. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role with ownership spanning sensor processing, algorithm development, validation, and fleet deployment. You will help scale reliable collision avoidance across a growing robot fleet while advancing AI\-driven automation that reduces manual engineering effort. **What we do** The Collision group within the Perception team develops and deploys real\-time vision, LiDAR perception, collision avoidance, and intelligent autonomy capabilities for industrial mobile robots operating in live distribution environments. The team turns multi\-sensor data into reliable perception and collision\-prevention decisions, with a focus on maintaining safe robot movement while reducing false stops and improving fleet throughput. The team is also expanding these capabilities across new robot platforms and more demanding environments, including chilled and freezer structures. **What you'll do** * Architect, implement, optimize, and maintain real\-time 3D LiDAR and point\-cloud perception, filtering, calibration, and sensor\-noise handling algorithms using Modern C\+\+ and Python. * Own perception functionality end to end, from sensor characterization and technical design reviews through testing, validation, and fleet deployment. * Develop intelligent agents and automated pipelines for data labeling, dataset curation, edge\-case triage, and large\-scale offline regression validation. * Research and build approaches for autonomous recovery, robot learning, adaptive decision\-making, and behavior generation across perception\-driven robotic applications. * Partner closely with Controls, System Software, and System Test teams to integrate perception and autonomy decisions into core vehicle software. * Drive high engineering standards through architectural leadership, comprehensive unit and regression testing, code reviews, technical documentation, and mentoring. * Expand perception capabilities across multiple robot platforms and operating conditions, including environments where sensor noise and physical conditions introduce new perception challenges. **What you'll need** * Minimum of 8 years of related experience or equivalent work experience. * Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Strong software engineering proficiency in Modern C\+\+ and Python, including experience with Linux, real\-time or low\-latency systems, and multithreaded programming. * Hands\-on experience developing perception or autonomy software for physical robotic systems or autonomous vehicles, with strong knowledge of 3D point clouds, filtering, clustering, spatial calibration, and coordinate geometry. * Experience integrating, debugging, validating, and deploying production perception systems using ROS/ROS2 or comparable robotics middleware, with familiarity with PCL, OpenCV, Docker, and edge\-compute environments. * Experience building automated data or machine learning pipelines, intelligent agents, robot learning systems, automated labeling workflows, or related autonomy capabilities. * Strong technical communication and architectural leadership skills, including the ability to independently drive design reviews, document technical decisions, collaborate across engineering disciplines, and mentor other engineers. **Our Environment** * Up to 5%\-10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver's license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client locations and company HQ. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. \#LI\-JA2 \#LI\-Hybrid **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. jobs.title: Data Center Security Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced Data Center Security Engineer to oversee physical security operations and support the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of security systems within data center environments. This role is responsible for managing on\-site security teams, access control systems, CCTV surveillance, visitor management, and security screening processes to ensure the safety of personnel, assets, and critical infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have a solid background in physical security, property or facility management, and basic IT knowledge, with experience managing security personnel, coordinating security operations, and responding to security incidents. Previous experience in data center security is highly preferred. **Key Responsibilities：** 1\. Physical Security Operations \& Team Management: Oversee daily physical security operations; Develop and enforce security procedures, post orders, operational standards, and duty schedules; Ensure security operations comply with company policies, safety requirements, and applicable security standards. 2\. Access Control \& CCTV Surveillance Systems: Manage and maintain physical access control systems, including badge issuance, access permissions, entry/exit monitoring, and access audits; Oversee CCTV surveillance systems, security monitoring platforms, video recording, and incident footage reviews; Coordinate troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades of security technologies with IT teams and external vendors; Monitor system availability and ensure security systems operate reliably and effectively. 3\. Visitor Management \& Security Screening: Establish and manage visitor registration, identity verification, check\-in/check\-out, and escort procedures; Oversee security screening processes for employees, visitors, contractors, and deliveries; Ensure proper access authorization and compliance with data center security policies. 4\. Security Incident Response \& Risk Management: Respond to security incidents, unauthorized access attempts, alarms, and emergency situations; Conduct incident investigations, prepare incident reports, and coordinate corrective and preventive actions; Identify physical security risks and vulnerabilities through regular inspections, assessments, and audits; Coordinate with facility operations, IT teams, management, and external emergency services when necessary. 5\. Security Systems Optimization \& Compliance: Support the deployment, configuration, testing, and improvement of physical security technologies; Maintain security system documentation, operating procedures, maintenance records, and incident logs; Support security audits, emergency drills, and business continuity exercises; Identify opportunities to improve security processes, system reliability, and operational efficiency. **Job Requirements：** * Security Management, Property Management, Facility Management, Information Technology, Electronic Engineering, or other related disciplines. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered. * Minimum 1\-3 years of relevant working experience in physical security, property management, facility security, security operations, or related fields. Previous experience in data center or other critical facility environments is highly preferred. * Familiarity with physical security systems, including access control, CCTV surveillance, visitor management, alarm systems, and security screening procedures. * Basic IT knowledge and understanding of security technology infrastructure, including network\-connected CCTV systems, access control platforms, system monitoring, and basic network troubleshooting. * Proven experience handling security incidents, conducting investigations, coordinating emergency responses, and implementing corrective actions. * Strong knowledge of security procedures, personnel management, risk assessment, and operational compliance. * Ability to communicate professionally in English. Mandarin Chinese is a plus. * Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and coordination skills. * Highly responsible, detail\-oriented, and capable of working independently in a mission\-critical environment. Pay: From $4,800\.00 per month Language: * Mandarin (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Atlanta, GA 30331 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Information Security Engineer
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Your Role:** As an AI Security Engineer on Tenable's Information Security team, you will help shape and mature our approach to securing AI both within Tenable's products and across the enterprise. AI introduces a new class of risk at the intersection of application security, cloud risk, and data governance, and you will be on the front lines of defining how we assess, test, and address it. You will apply hands\-on AI engineering experience alongside product security and application security skills to design security controls for AI systems, lead assessments, and help engineering teams ship AI features securely. You will establish security standards for responsible AI use, influence decisions across the organization, and build tooling that raises our security posture. This role is ideal for a practitioner who has spent time building or tinkering with AI systems, looking under the hood of model internals, and wants to channel that experience into a security specialty. **Your Opportunity:** * Design, implement, and maintain end\-to\-end security controls across the AI/ML lifecycle. * Assist in the implementation of robust security guardrails, controls, and boundary mechanisms for Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and open\-source models. * Continuously monitor the AI landscape for novel vulnerabilities and attack techniques, applying deep engineering experience to proactively defend enterprise AI deployments. * Assist in developing security reference architectures for AI deployment patterns, including MCP servers and agentic AI workflows and harnesses. * Deploy controls to ensure model integrity, governance, and proper access control across models and feature stores. * Build AI\-driven tooling to strengthen cybersecurity posture across identity, incident management, vulnerability management, third\-party risk, and emerging AI threat vectors. * Perform AI safety, security assessments, threat modeling for AI/ML systems, identifying risks such as data poisoning, model evasion, model extraction, adversarial inputs, and integrity attacks. * Collaborate with software engineers, and product teams to integrate security best practices into AI development, training, validation, and deployment processes. * Create security guidance, documentation, and training for internal engineering and development teams; develop metrics that drive desired security behaviors and outcomes. * Assist in researching emerging trends in AI security and contribute to innovative solutions that support Tenable's AI initiatives. **What You'll Need:** * 2 or more years of professional experience in information security or application security, with at least a demonstrated interest on securing AI/ML systems. * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or a related field preferred. * Awareness of AI\-specific security threats, including adversarial ML, data poisoning, prompt injection, model inversion, model evasion, and inference attacks. * Knowledge of data security principles, including encryption, masking, and tokenization. * Knowledge of SSDLC, DevSecOps, and security testing practices, including SAST, DAST, SCA, and threat modeling. * Knowledge of application security architecture best practices and patterns, including modern web applications, Docker, and microservices. * Ability to work cross\-functionally across engineering, product, and business teams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to clearly translate complex AI security risks for both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to lead projects with end\-to\-end ownership. * Self\-motivated and effective working independently and across distributed teams. **And Ideally:** * Hands\-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial prompt testing, or LLM security assessments. * Basic coding experience in Python and/or Go. * Experience with frameworks \& libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow or similar. * Strong understanding of the ML/AI lifecycle and the security risks associated with each stage. * Experience with application security assessment tools (Burp Suite, ZAP, Tenable WAS, etc.) * Knowledge of cloud security platforms: AWS, Azure, or GCP including AI/ML\-related services. * Security certifications: CISSP, CSSLP, SANS GIAC, CEH, or AI\-focused security certifications are a plus, but not necessary. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-MS1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. applications. * Help transition successful AI prototypes into repeatable and supportable operational capabilities. **Security Automation \& Vulnerability Management** * Develop AI\-enabled workflows to identify, analyze, validate, prioritize, and support remediation of security vulnerabilities. * Use AI to analyze infrastructure, application code, configurations, and security findings for potential vulnerabilities and attack paths. * Develop automation to accelerate vulnerability validation and remediation while maintaining appropriate human review. * Support repeated and continuous analysis of systems and code rather than relying solely on point\-in\-time security assessments. * Help measure improvements in vulnerability coverage, remediation speed, and operational efficiency. security telemetry and existing security platforms to help analysts investigate and understand security events. * Work with security teams to identify manual or repetitive activities that can be technologies. * Support secure deployment and operation of AI capabilities within controlled enterprise environments. **AI Security \& Governance** * Implement technical controls supporting secure AI technologies** . * Experience with platforms such as **Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI models, or comparable enterprise AI platforms** . * Familiarity with **agentic workflows, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and model evaluation** . * Experience with security technologies such as vulnerability management platforms, SIEM/XDR, endpoint security, application security tools, or cloud security platforms. * Experience with **Git, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins or similar automation platforms, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code** . * Familiarity with secure coding, vulnerability analysis, threat modeling, or attack\-path analysis. * Familiarity with NIST and other cybersecurity or AI risk management frameworks. **Role jobs.title: Systems Design Engineer - Bioengineering
jobs.description: **Work Schedule** Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions** Office**Job Description** **Discover Impactful Work** Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Genetic Sciences Division develops integrated platforms, instruments, consumables and reagents for research and clinical applications. We are seeking an early\-career Bioengineer to help develop next\-generation genetic\-analysis, multiomics and automated scientific workflows. This is a hands\-on systems role for someone who enjoys building prototypes, designing experiments, integrating technologies and using data to solve multidisciplinary problems. The successful candidate will bring modern capabilities in computational modeling, automation, data science and AI. Working with experienced scientists and engineers, this person will contribute to system definition, architecture, integration and verification across instruments, consumables, assays, software and data. **Location** This is a fully onsite role based at our Pleasanton, CA facility. Relocation assistance is not provided for this position. **What You’ll Do** **Support System Definition and Product Development** * Collaborate with customers, scientists, engineers and external partners to understand product and workflow needs. * Translate customer and scientific needs into system requirements, specifications and measurable performance targets. * Maintain traceability among customer needs, system requirements, subsystem requirements and verification evidence. * Contribute to system architecture, interface definition, concept development and technical trade studies. * Evaluate candidate concepts based on scientific performance, feasibility, throughput, cost, usability and risk. * Support products from early feasibility through integration, verification and design transfer. **Build, Integrate and Test Systems** * Design and build prototypes integrating optical, electrical, mechanical, fluidic, biological and software components. * Develop test fixtures, automated experiments and data\-acquisition methods. * Conduct system integration, testing and troubleshooting of complex instrumentation and consumable workflows. * Design experimental plans, perform studies and analyze results using appropriate statistical methods. * Investigate failures using root\-cause analysis, DOE, FMEA and structured problem\-solving. * Provide clear, data\-driven recommendations through reports, presentations and technical discussions. * Contribute to design reviews, risk assessments and product\-development documentation. **Apply Models, Data and AI** * Develop models for process behavior, throughput, performance and system trade\-offs. * Apply MBSE practices to connect workflows, requirements, system behavior, interfaces and verification. * Use Python, MATLAB, R, JMP or comparable tools for modeling, data analysis and visualization. * Apply machine learning and advanced analytics to identify patterns, anomalies and system\-performance drivers. * Use AI\-assisted tools to accelerate literature review, concept exploration, coding, experiment design and technical analysis. * Develop reproducible analysis pipelines with appropriate version control, documentation and scientific review. * Validate AI\-generated results through independent analysis and experimentation. **Connect Biology and Engineering** * Evaluate interactions among samples, assays, reagents, consumables, instruments and software. * Support genetic\-analysis and sample\-preparation workflows such as qPCR, dPCR, sequencing or multiomics. * Help teams understand sources of biological and technical variability. * Partner with assay, consumables, systems, automation and V\&V teams to improve performance and robustness. * Ensure engineering decisions reflect complete customer workflows rather than isolated components. * Contribute to development of products for research\-use and regulated markets. **Advance Automation and Modern Engineering Methods** * Integrate sensors, microcontrollers, instruments, liquid handlers or robotics into experimental systems. * Develop scripts and software tools for instrument control, automated testing and data collection. * Use CAD, simulation, rapid prototyping and laboratory fabrication to evaluate concepts quickly. * Apply model\-based and automated methods to reduce development cycles and physical iteration. * Explore AI applications in workflow optimization, anomaly detection, predictive modeling and intelligent instruments. * Introduce useful new tools and methods while learning from experienced product developers. **What You Bring** **Education and Experience** One of the following combinations: * PhD in bioengineering, biomedical engineering, chemical engineering, biophysics or a related field, with zero to approximately three years of relevant experience. * Master’s degree in a related discipline with approximately two or more years of relevant research or industry experience. * Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline with approximately five or more years of relevant product\-development experience. **Additional qualifications** * Hands\-on experience developing experimental systems, prototypes or engineering solutions for biological applications. * Experience working across scientific and engineering disciplines. * Industry experience is valued but not required when academic work demonstrates practical system development and problem\-solving. **Technical Capabilities** * Strong foundation in bioengineering, molecular biology, biophysics or biological\-system development. * Hands\-on experience with several of the following: + Molecular biology or sample\-preparation workflows + Microfluidics and fluid handling + Optical, electrical or mechanical instrumentation + Sensors, data acquisition and instrument control + Robotics or laboratory automation + CAD and rapid prototyping + Computational modeling and simulation + Statistics, machine learning or AI * Experience with systems\-engineering practices, including requirements, interfaces, risk analysis and V\&V. * Familiarity with DOE, RCA, FMEA and statistical analysis. * Proficiency with tools such as Python, MATLAB, JMP, R, LabVIEW, SolidWorks or comparable platforms. * Experience with qPCR, dPCR, CE/Sanger sequencing, microarray, NGS, DNA synthesis or related workflows is preferred. **Behaviors** * Hands\-on builder who learns through experiments, prototypes and data. * Curious across biology, engineering, software and emerging technology. * Highly data\-driven and attentive to system\-level effects. * Comfortable working through ambiguity and complex technical problems. * Builds credibility and collaborative relationships across disciplines. * Communicates technical results clearly in writing and presentations. * Moves quickly while maintaining scientific rigor and reproducibility. * Uses AI ambitiously while validating results through sound engineering judgment. **Why This Role Matters** The next generation of life\-science platforms will be developed by engineers who can connect biology, instrumentation, consumables, automation, computation and AI. This role will bring modern capabilities and new perspectives into GSD while developing future technical talent through hands\-on product development. **Compensation and Benefits** The salary range estimated for this position based in California is $107,800\.00–$143,800\.00\. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. We offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that our U.S. colleagues and their families can count on, which includes: * A choice of national medical and dental plans, and a national vision plan, including health incentive programs * Employee assistance and family support programs, including commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement * At least 120 hours paid time off (PTO), 10 paid holidays annually, paid parental leave (3 weeks for bonding and 8 weeks for caregiver leave), accident and life insurance, and short\- and long\-term disability in accordance with company policy * Retirement and savings programs, such as our competitive 401(k) U.S. retirement savings plan * Employees’ Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offers eligible colleagues the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount For more information on our benefits, please visit: https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/total\-rewards

jobs.title: Lead Research Engineer – AI Evaluation & Benchmarking
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **Thomson Reuters Labs is seeking a Lead Research Engineer to lead the design and delivery of production\-ready software for artificial intelligence (AI) model evaluation and benchmarking. You will build scalable evaluation infrastructure that enables research and product teams to compare large language models (LLMs), measure quality, cost, and latency, and make informed decisions about model selection and development.** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **You will own the engineering approach from early prototypes through reliable, maintainable tools, collaborating closely with research scientists, engineering teams, and product partners while helping shape technical direction and engineering delivery.** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead technical delivery and engineering planning: Partner with program and research leaders to define priorities, break projects into delivery stages, estimate effort and cost, recommend staffing and required skills, identify dependencies, and adapt plans to available resources. * Design and build scalable evaluation infrastructure: Extend existing shared tools and services, design new components where needed, and develop production\-quality Python software, APIs, and reusable evaluation frameworks. Deliver useful initial versions, validate them with users, and improve them through iterative development. * Turn research methods into working software: Collaborate with scientists to build automated evaluation pipelines connecting model APIs, test datasets, and agreed scoring methods. Implement reliable workflows for comparing LLMs and other AI models using evaluation datasets relevant to products and customer needs. * Ensure reliable, reproducible model comparisons: Maintain repeatable experiments, separate evaluation data from model development, and make results traceable to evaluation inputs and methods. Measure model quality, operating cost, and latency to support product teams in validating model performance. * Build practical tools for researchers and product teams: Develop clear user interfaces, documentation, evaluation reports, and diagnostic capabilities. Enable scientists and product teams to run evaluations, understand failures, interpret results, and extend tools without depending on the original developer. * Own production reliability, performance, and responsible data use: Integrate automated testing, deployment, and monitoring from the beginning. Address performance, scalability, and operating costs, establish service maintenance and support ownership, and work with data specialists to implement access controls, permitted\-use rules, and retention requirements. Collaborate, mentor, and guide engineering decisions: Partner with foundational research, data engineering, platform engineering, and product teams to align interfaces, responsibilities, and delivery plans. Resolve technical dependencies, mentor engineers, communicate trade\-offs and delivery risks, and recommend changes to scope or technical approach when necessary. * **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 8\-10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production systems involving machine learning or complex data. * Strong hands\-on Python programming skills, including API design, automated testing, and working with structured and unstructured data. * Technical leadership and end\-to\-end delivery experience, including architecture decisions, engineering planning, staffing and effort estimation, project execution, and adapting priorities as requirements change. * Experience collaborating with research scientists or machine learning practitioners to translate experiments and research methods into working software. * Experience integrating or testing machine learning models, interpreting evaluation results, and applying findings to engineering decisions. Understanding of language models and the ability to recognize unreliable comparisons or test\-data leakage. * Cloud engineering experience using AWS, Azure, or a comparable platform, including distributed workflows, automated deployment, and monitoring. * Working knowledge of SQL and experience developing software that processes structured and unstructured data. * Strong collaboration, communicatio  100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption \& Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $146,800 USD \- $272,600 USD.\&\#xa;For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $127,400 USD \- $236,600 USD.\&\#xa;For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $140,000 CAD \- $175,000 CAD.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs.\&\#xa;This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.\&\#xa; **About Us** Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news. We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. jobs.title: Firmware Engineer (Python / Embedded Linux)
jobs.description: #### **About Torus** Torus is headquartered in Utah and is expanding manufacturing at our 545,000\-square\-foot facility in Salt Lake City called GigaOne. **We are** **the world’s first mesh energy infrastructure, uniting communities through resilient, sustainable, and intelligent power.** We design, engineer, manufacture, install, and support our systems end\-to\-end, standing behind them throughout their lifecycle. Torus systems help reduce costs, lower emissions, and protect facilities from outages, while strengthening the security and reliability of the broader utility grid. Torus is committed to American manufacturing, engineering excellence, and building energy systems that last. Torus has raised over $267 million from investors like Magnetar, Mercado, ICONIQ and Origin Ventures. The investments are helping to accelerate deployment of modular power plants across utilities, data centers, and industrial sectors. This investor confidence reflects the strength of our team, technology as well as the scale of the problem we are solving. At Torus, you will be part of something larger than a single product or technology. Your work will help build energy infrastructure that supports and strengthens our electrical grid, critical systems, industry, and communities for decades to come. We value accountability, collaboration, and clear thinking. We are looking for people who want to solve hard problems and build things that matter. #### **About the Role** *Embedded Systems and Firmware @ Torus* We’re building energy storage and management solutions that help: * Commercial and industrial businesses reduce their operating costs while increasing reliability. * Grid operators keep the electricity grid stable and cost efficient. Torus is hiring a **Firmware Engineer** to be an individual contributor on our firmware team, working in close partnership with our Firmware Architect. This is a hands\-on role where you'll translate architectural direction into well\-engineered, production\-grade firmware. #### **Our Tech Stack** Our firmware application layer is Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto)—not C, not C\+\+. This was a deliberate architectural choice: Python gives us speed\-to\-market, flexibility to respond to changing grid program requirements, and a clean separation between hardware and application logic. Our comms are primarily RS\-485, so Python runtime overhead is seldom the limiting factor. *If you've been writing Python to control hardware over serial protocols—in energy, robotics, industrial IoT, or test \& measurement—you'll feel immediately at home here. If you've spent your career in C/C\+\+ and are looking for that, this probably isn't the right fit.* Each Torus device generates over a million data points per day and integrates with our cloud platform via MQTT/AWS IoT. Our systems also participate in Virtual Power Plant (VPP) programs, responding to real\-time dispatch signals from utilities—which means our firmware decisions have direct, measurable impact on grid operations. #### **What You’ll Do** In this role, you will report to our Head of Embedded Systems and will be responsible for: * **Developing firmware** features across our energy storage product lines: telemetry, control loops, cloud connectivity, and hardware abstraction layers. * **Owning system integration**—working closely with hardware, data, and software teams to ensure seamless interoperability across the full stack. * **Driving quality** through design reviews, automated testing, and documentation. (We believe engineers own their own QA.) * **Debugging and optimizing** real\-time embedded applications and serial communication interfaces in the field and in the lab. * **Supporting scaling operations**—deployment tooling, remote monitoring, and root\-cause analysis of field issues across a growing fleet. * **Participate in on\-call rotation** for escalated technical issues. #### **Who Thrives Here** * You're a systems thinker who's comfortable owning a problem end\-to\-end—from a register on a Modbus device to a graph in a customer dashboard. You care about code quality without letting it become a bottleneck. You're energized by the fact that the firmware you write shows up in real buildings, on real grids, doing real work. * You don't need to be an energy domain expert on day one—but you're curious about how the grid works and motivated by the idea that good engineering here has an outsized impact on creating sustainable communities. * You're also comfortable in a structure where a Firmware Architect sets system\-level direction and you're the person who makes it real—bringing deep implementation judgment, surfacing tradeoffs, and pushing back when something won't work in practice. #### **Required Experience** * BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience. * 2\-5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing commercial embedded software or firmware applications. * Strong Python proficiency and real production experience running Python on Embedded Linux (Yocto or similar). * Solid understanding of serial communication protocols—RS\-485, Modbus, I²C, CAN, Ethernet. * Experience with real\-time embedded systems: multi\-threading, inter\-process communication, timing constraints. * Ability to read schematics and PCB layouts to troubleshoot hardware integration issues. #### **Preferred Experience** * Experience with IoT device management at scale (fleet OTA, remote diagnostics). * Familiarity with AWS IoT, MQTT, or data telemetry pipelines. * Exposure to energy storage systems, inverters, or grid\-connected hardware. * Knowledge of VPP programs, demand response, or utility interconnection standards (IEEE 1547, UL 1741\). * Experience with containerized embedded deployments (Docker/Balena on Linux targets). * CI/CD practices in embedded or hardware\-adjacent environments. #### **Additional Details** **Background Check** All candidates are subject to a background check. **Location \+ Travel** Remote U.S.\-based role with occasional onsite work in Salt Lake City and surrounding area locations (air\-conditioned and non\-air\-conditioned). Must be available during MT business hours. **Compensation** $135,000 \- 180,000 (Note: We have the flexibility to hire at different levels, which may impact the corresponding pay range.) **Work Authorization** Applicants must already have the legal authorization to work in the US without requiring any employer sponsorship. **Physical Requirements** * Regularly operates a computer and other peripheral office equipment such as a printer or mouse. * Ability to read, identify, observe and recognize details, color\-coding and fine print at close range on associated engineering drawings. * Ability to communicate information so others can understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. * Must report to work reliably and with the ability to use full and unimpaired skills and judgment to safely execute your job. * Proficiency in reading, writing, and speaking English required. * When on the production floor, required to don personal protective equipment to include, but not limited to ear protection, gloves, eye protection and/or safety helmet. * When on the production floor, ability to observe, detect and respond to audible and visual machine malfunction warnings. #### **Our Perks \& Benefits** Benefits eligibility is based on employment status. Financial * Employee Rewards Package including equity * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Torus paid life and AD\&D Insurance with options to purchase additional coverage * Voluntary short\- and long\-term disability insurance Health \& Wellness * Health Benefits Package: Choice between traditional PPO or HSA\-eligible medical plans with Torus covering 50% of medical premiums; Dental insurance; and Vision insurance * Plan participants have access to telehealth services, mental health support and coaching, and exclusive discounts on brands, dining, entertainment, and more. Time Off * Unlimited discretionary PTO * 10 paid company holidays * Waiting period\-free 100% paid parental leave Culture \& Community * Regular company\-wide offsites to showcase our progress and learnings. A time to step back, think strategically, and work on the business together. * Team members receive Torus branded gear * Peer Recognition Program * Fully stocked break rooms with free snacks and drinks. Because great work deserves great fuel. Torus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Torus participates in E\-Verify. Once you accept a job offer, we will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from your Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. \#li\-lw

This senior individual contributor role, with no direct reports, will connect Engineering business priorities with the data foundations, standards, and organizational capabilities necessary to make information trusted, accessible, and reusable. Working across Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Product Management, Service, and IT, the selected candidate will establish strategic priorities, guide data governance and stewardship, and partner with technical specialists to enable scalable solutions. The role will support engineering data domains including laboratory data, product lifecycle information, parts and materials, engineering documents, product configuration, and supplier data. The position will also help advance engineering taxonomies, ontologies, knowledge graphs, and semantic capabilities that enable Engineering IQ, digital\-thread initiatives, and AI\-driven engineering workflows. **Responsibilities** * Develop and advance Engineering's data and intelligence strategy, aligning priorities with Engineering IQ, business objectives, and enterprise data and technology standards. * Establish roadmaps and priorities for improving the accessibility, quality, governance, and reuse of critical engineering information. * Partner with Engineering leaders and subject matter experts to identify business needs, define information requirements, and prioritize opportunities for analytics, data science, and AI. * Establish and guide an Engineering data governance and stewardship operating model, including ownership, accountability, decision\-making, and escalation processes. * Partner with data owners, stewards, and technical architects to define and adopt common data definitions, classification standards, quality expectations, and ownership frameworks. * Guide the development of engineering taxonomies, ontologies, and semantic standards supporting knowledge graphs, digital\-thread capabilities, and AI initiatives. * Collaborate with data architects, engineers, and IT teams to establish scalable, governed data foundations across engineering systems, including PLM, ERP, laboratory, and knowledge repositories. * Identify opportunities to leverage automation and AI\-assisted data engineering, classification, and stewardship to accelerate delivery and reduce costs. * Facilitate cross\-functional alignment and lead organizational change to promote adoption of common standards, processes, and data\-driven ways of working. * Partner with technical teams to identify and address data quality issues, integration challenges, and barriers to information accessibility. * Establish measures of business value, adoption, data quality, and operational efficiency to evaluate progress and guide continuous improvement. Build partnerships across Engineering, business functions, and enterprise technology teams to promote reusable capabilities, shared accountability, and sustainable solutions. * **Ideal Qualifications and Competencies** * Bachelor's degree in engineering, data science, information systems, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * At least eight years of experience in data and analytics, business strategy, technology, or digital transformation, including experience leading cross\-functional initiatives. * Demonstrated experience developing data and analytics strategies, roadmaps, governance frameworks, or operating models. * Strong understanding of data management, analytics, data architecture principles, and the organizational capabilities required to support scalable data solutions. * Experience translating business objectives into data, analytics, and technology priorities that deliver measurable value. * Ability to lead through influence, build cross\-functional partnerships, and align stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization. * Experience driving organizational change, stakeholder engagement, and adoption of new technologies or ways of working. * Strong understanding of business intelligence, advanced analytics, data science, and emerging AI capabilities. * Excellent communication, facilitation, problem\-solving, and strategic planning skills. * Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and drive progress through collaboration and influence. * Experience in manufacturing, engineering, or industrial environments is preferred. * Familiarity with master data management, data governance, data quality, and stewardship practices is preferred. * Familiarity with cloud data platforms, semantic models, taxonomies, ontologies, or knowledge graphs is preferred. * Advanced degree in Data Science, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field is preferred. jobs.title: AI & Process Automation Developer
jobs.description: Truliant’s mission is to improve lives by putting our members first, providing great service and straightforward financial solutions. Our core values of Member Focus, Service, Guidance, Relationships, and Community define how we interact with members to fulfill our mission of improving lives and providing a foundation on which we conduct ourselves. Our Promise to Our Teammates: Truliant strives to provide all teammates with an enjoyable place to work where they feel valued, empowered and rewarded for all that they do. * **This position is remote within our NC, SC, VA footprint. Although this position is primarily remote, there are occasional events and meetings that may require you to work on\-site at one of our Truliant locations.** **Why this role matters** ========================= At Truliant Federal Credit Union, better technology helps our teams work more efficiently and creates a smoother experience for our members. As an AI \& Process Automation Developer, you’ll help turn business needs into secure, reliable automation and AI solutions that reduce manual effort and improve how work gets done. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving real business problems, building practical technology, and learning alongside experienced developers, architects, and business partners. **What you’ll do** ================== In this role, you’ll help design, build, test, deploy, and support enterprise automation and AI solutions. Your work may include robotic process automation, workflow automation, system integrations, intelligent document processing, and conversational AI. **Day to day, you’ll:** * Build and maintain reusable automation workflows, attended and unattended automations, and conversational AI capabilities using established development standards. * Connect solutions with enterprise applications through REST APIs, SOAP services, SQL databases, message queues, and enterprise connectors. * Test, document, deploy, troubleshoot, and support solutions across development, testing, and production environments. You’ll also partner with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to understand requirements, assess automation opportunities, and deliver solutions that are secure, scalable, and maintainable. **What you bring** ================== We’re looking for a hands\-on developer who combines solid programming and integration experience with a practical understanding of AI and automation. You can move an idea from requirements through testing and support while asking thoughtful questions and working well with both technical and business partners. **This role is a great fit if you have:** **Required Experience:** * 2\+ years of foundational experience with AI or automation technologies such as RPA, workflow automation, conversational AI, intelligent document processing, or an equivalent platform. * 3\+ years of experience using source control, CI/CD processes, and modern software development tools. * 1\+ years of automation development, systems integration, or related experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting technical solutions. * 2\+ years of experience with REST APIs, SQL, JSON, XML, and system integration concepts. * 3\+ years of experience with Python, Java, React JavaScript, Node.js, or similar programming languages. **Required Skills:** * Develop, test, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain automation solutions using reusable components and established development practices. * Build and support integrations using APIs, databases, services, and enterprise connectors. * Use source control and CI/CD practices to manage reliable software changes across environments. * Translate business requirements into technical designs, workflow diagrams, specifications, deployment instructions, and support documentation. * Apply unit, integration, and regression testing practices and support User Acceptance Testing. **Education/Certifications required within one year:** * UiPath Advanced Developer Professional Certification. * Kore.AI Automation AI / XO Platform, Kore.AI Agent AI, \& Kore.AI Agent Platform Builder advanced training or developer certification. You should also be comfortable working within Agile delivery, SDLC, DevSecOps, secure coding, change management, and enterprise governance standards, while collaborating closely with senior developers and cross\-functional partners. **What sets you apart** ======================= **You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive in this role:** * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * 2\+ years of experience working within Agile development teams. * 2\+ years of exposure to cloud\-based platforms, services, and development environments. * 2\+ years of experience in financial services, healthcare, government, or another regulated industry. * Curiosity about emerging technologies such as Generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation, prompt engineering, and Agentic AI. **What you’ll get** =================== We believe in supporting our team members both professionally and personally. **In this role, you can expect:** * Meaningful work that improves operational efficiency and supports a better member experience at Truliant Federal Credit Union. * Hands\-on opportunities to build across automation, integrations, conversational AI, and emerging AI technologies rather than being limited to one type of solution. * Collaboration with experienced developers, architects, and business partners who can help you strengthen both your technical skills and business understanding. * A team environment that values secure, maintainable solutions, thoughtful problem\-solving, continuous learning, and high\-quality service. **Ready to Apply?** =================== If you have a passion for member service and would like to invest in a meaningful career with opportunity for growth, we encourage you to apply to Truliant! As a member of the Truliant family, you will enjoy the following full time benefits: * No\-cost employee Medical, dental, vision coverage * Prescription benefits (including mail order) * Paid holidays and Paid Time Off (PTO) * 401(k) plan with contribution matching * Paid community involvement volunteers hours * Paid group life Insurance * Teammate loan discounts * Tuition reimbursement * Short and long\-term disability * Health \& Wellness program * Teledoc (physician video conferencing) * Onsite fitness facilities or health club reimbursement * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Medical flexible spending account * Dependent care flexible spending account

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff - Senior Robotics Software (San Francisco, CA)
jobs.description: ### **About Tutor** We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business. Tutor Intelligence is changing that. Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi\-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back\-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family\-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence. Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end\-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems. Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world. ### **The Role** Are you tired of writing incremental code for massive CRUD web apps? Do you want to architect and build systems from the ground up that affect change in the physical world, not just the digital one? At Tutor, we are motivated by atoms not electrons: every line of code you write impacts the foundation of the global economy, solving the core technical challenges in robotics and automation at scale. Lever As a **Member of Technical Staff**, you will lead design and implementation of critical robotics software across motion planning, real\-time control, perception and optimization systems, tooling, and robot infrastructure. You will influence technical direction, mentor other engineers, drive system architecture across the stack from embedded to cloud, and champion best practices in software and robotics engineering. ### **Requirements** * Exceptional programming skills with deep experience across multiple languages and systems. * Track record of designing and owning large, complex software systems. * Experience leading technical projects and mentoring engineers. * Comfortable working across the stack from low\-level robot control to cloud services. * Natural collaborator, strong communicator, and excited to solve hard problems that bridge software and robotics. ### **Nice to haves (zero or more)** * Proven experience with Python and prior experience programming robots (e.g. with ROS or other robotics frameworks) * Experience with manipulation, motion planning, optimization, or perception. * Experience with infra/dev tools (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD. * Background in hardware/software integration and real\-time systems. * Experience scaling robotics systems in production environments. ### **Why Tutor?** Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable. Our team of 160\+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in. ### **Benefits** We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get: * Fully employer\-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium. * A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future. * Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full\-time salaried employees, and 16\+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1\.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees. * Regular in\-office meals and team social events throughout the year. As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond. Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.
