jobs.description: *Tyler Junior College gives equal consideration to all applicants for admission, employment and participation in its programs and activities without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status or limited English proficiency (LEP).* *Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.* *All positions are on\-site, located in Tyler, Texas, unless otherwise stated in the job posting.* **ABOUT** --------- The Director of IT Operations directs, plans, and manages activities of TJC’s Information Technology Infrastructure, Systems, Network, VOIP, WAP, Endpoint, and AV support teams to ensure reliable, effective, efficient, and secure delivery of technology systems to all areas of the College. This position will collaborate with all departments of IT Services and the academic, research, and administrative leadership across the College in the development and implementation of enterprise\-wide IT strategy. Identifies changes and trends in technology and communicates impacts and consequences to the CIO. Works with the CIO and the Deputy CIO to develop long\-term information technology needs and contributes to setting the strategic direction of TJC’s information technology organization; ensures technical innovation and influences strategic business decisions regarding the use of technology. Develops and maintains key IT vendor relationships in support of critical platforms and services. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** -------------------- * Partner with the CIO and Deputy CIO to develop the enterprise\-wide strategic technology roadmap and design innovative technology strategies. Develop vision, long\- and short\-term planning, and build relationships with customers and service providers. Work across organizational boundaries to establish procedures, policies, and solutions. Stay abreast of new technology, industry trends, and vendor solutions. * Oversee the management and short\- and long\-range direction of the technology infrastructure, support services functions, and technological resources. * Lead teams responsible for Voice \& Data Networks; Servers \& Storage; Data Center Facilities \& Operations; Scheduling \& Monitoring; Cloud Computing Strategy \& Architecture; Endpoint technologies for end\-user platforms, including desktop/laptop hardware, mobile devices, software deployments, and user productivity tools. * Direct the planning, deployment, and lifecycle support of audio\-visual technology for campus learning and collaboration spaces—including classrooms, meeting rooms, offices, and event venues—to ensure high\-quality presentation, conferencing, and instructional capabilities. * Expand and oversee end\-user technical support operations and functions, Tier 2 and 3 escalation workflows, endpoint lifecycle management, desktop engineering, software distribution, user onboarding/offboarding technical processes, and troubleshooting standards. Ensure consistent delivery of high\-quality technical support across all campus locations. * Assist and collaborate with other departments on emerging technologies, articulating their applicability to the future of the College. Promote innovation and the adoption of IT enablers that support academic, business, and administrative offices. * Hire and develop capable operational team employees. Perform reviews, manage time off and coverage, and coordinate employee work assignments. Ensure staff maintain current technical knowledge, including end\-user support for best practices, by providing regular training and professional development opportunities. * Coordinate with other IT teams and provide exceptional service to customers throughout the campus. Attend relevant meetings and participate in planning or presentation activities at the team or leadership levels. Ensure issues are communicated effectively and resolved promptly, including end\-user\-impacting incidents. * Act as the ultimate technical escalation point and first functional/hierarchical escalation point for Server, Network, and Endpoint teams. Assist in resolving complex infrastructure and end\-user support issues and provide guidance or solutions as appropriate. * Serve as part of the incident response team as the Major Incident Manager, ensuring coordination of communications, root\-cause analysis, and user impact mitigation during major outages or service disruptions. * Collaborate with peers and department contacts to develop and implement technology refresh plans and maintain usage policies, including end\-user hardware/software standards, device imaging, and configuration management. * Participate in long\-range planning of end\-user, operational systems, and support activities by applying technical expertise and understanding the College’s current and future structure and business needs. Lead planning fo cially in end\-user support workflows such as incident resolution, request fulfillment, and device provisioning. * Along with the Deputy CIO and CIO, evaluate, plan, implement, and establish the operation of new technologies. Review drawings and consult with architects and engineers on remodel and building projects to ensure each facility has the necessary operational infrastructure and end\-user technology accommodations. Interact with campus colleges and departments to support their needs and ensure continuity of operations. * Oversee the development, maintenance, and regular testing of campus technology backups and disaster recovery plans, ensuring considerations for end\-user continuity and workstation recovery. * Review and recommend RFP contract verbiage as it pertains to information technology, including software licensing, endpoint procurement, and managed service agreements that support end\-user operations. **COMPETENCIES** ***Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities*** * Creates a positive, professional, service\-oriented work environment for faculty and staff supporting TJC’s mission and core values statement. * Must be able to work effectively as a member of leadership and other relevant teams. * Completes training and adheres to our standard of promptly providing a high level of service and respect to internal or external customers. * Maintains knowledge of and complies with organizational standards, policies, and procedures of the TJC Employee Handbook. * Maintains complete knowledge of office services and the use of all relevant office equipment, computers, and manual systems. * Maintains strict patient and employee confidentiality in compliance with all regulatory laws. * Serves as a role model by demonstrating exceptional ability and willingness to take on new and additional responsibilities. Embraces new ideas and respects cultural differences. **SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES** Direct Supervision **Work Environment:** Work may be required outside of normal business hours, including travel, shift work, weekend, holidays, or on\-call **Physical Demands:** Sitting, walking, standing, lifting, driving **Travel Required:** Yes \- Minimal *If travel is required, the candidate must have and maintain a current, valid Texas driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.* **WHO YOU ARE** --------------- ***Required Education*** Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field ***Required Experience*** Eight years of experience in Information Technology with applicable experience. ***Preferred Certifications*** Operational technical\-related certifications ***Span of Authority / Control*** * Decisions made independently by this position: Decisions regarding the day\-to\-day activities for OTS Operations. * Decisions referred to the supervisor or other individual: Broad, strategic decisions about the vision and direction of the College and the strategic direction of OTS will be referred to the CIO ***Regulations*** * Federal, state, institutional, or other types of regulations that influence job responsibilities. + All federal/state laws and requirements will drive solutions performed by the incumbent. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION** -------------------------- **EXPECTATIONS** * Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities are subject to change at any time, with or without notice. * Will have contact – in person, by email, or by phone – with staff, students, and the general public. * Must exhibit a sensitivity to and an understanding of the diverse academic, socio\-economic, cultural, and ethnic backgrounds of staff and students and to staff and students with disabilities. * Regular and punctual attendance is an essential function of each employee. *This is a security\-sensitive position. Candidates will be subject to a criminal background check.*

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer - Web Platform
jobs.description: **About the role and team** The Web Platform team is looking for a senior engineer to join the team responsible for the foundation of all web applications at Uber. We provide a high\-performance, secure, and reliable web ecosystem for our users (riders, drivers, eaters, and our internal operations and logistics teams) through developer tools, systems, and frameworks. A big part of that foundation is how our code gets built, tested, and shipped. We own Uber's web monorepo and the CI and build systems that thousands of engineers depend on every day. Our goal is to make every change fast to validate and safe to release, using a modern tech stack. That means incremental and cached builds, reliable and fast CI, reproducible pipelines from commit to production, and tooling that catches problems before they reach users. Our products include Fusion.js, the React framework behind hundreds of internal and external web applications, and Base Web, Uber's React component library. We also own the monorepo build and CI platform that ties them together. As a senior engineer, you'll help make Uber's web engineers productive and its web applications high quality by owning the systems that decide how quickly and reliably code builds, tests, and reaches production. **What you’ll do** * Build developer tooling that makes product engineers more productive and their applications more reliable, performant, and secure. * Own the build, test, and CI systems for a large web monorepo, making them fast, reliable, and scalable as the codebase and the number of engineers grow. * Drive fleet\-wide change and new framework capabilities, so they land across many teams with minimal disruption. * Shape the technical direction of our platform through design docs. jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Vynyl's technologists, designers and product strategists are experts at system modernization, new product development, and rescuing projects in distress. We use the best cloud\-native and AI\-enabled tools, and apply a battle\-tested combination of Agile, Lean, and design thinking to collaboratively solve our client's most pressing challenges \- and do it right the first time. We often work in regulated industries, such as healthcare, financial services, government and education. Our work helps detect diseases, identify kids who need special educational support, applies AI to support complex legal settlements, helps people access mental health services, and so much more. **The Role** ============ As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key leader across the entire software development lifecycle, from conceptual design to deployment and monitoring. You will be responsible for building robust, scalable backend services using Python and AWS Serverless technologies (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge), developing event\-sourced systems that provide complete state history and auditability. A critical component of this role is a demonstrated fluency with modern AI/ML development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, agentic coding tools, large language models). We are looking for candidates who not only use these tools daily but can articulate a clear, thoughtful perspective on their limitations, security implications, and the strategic opportunities they create for the engineering profession. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== * **Design** **and implement** highly scalable, cost\-efficient backend services using Python and AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge). * **Architect and build** event\-sourced systems and event\-driven pipelines, ensuring reliable message processing, idempotency, and eventual consistency across distributed services. * **Collaborate** with product managers and designers to translate requirements into technical designs and shippable code. * **Implement** best practices for security, logging, monitoring, and infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform or CloudFormation). * **Perform** rigorous code reviews, mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and drive technical excellence across the team. * **Actively research, propose, and integrate** new technologies and patterns, with a focus on optimizing development velocity and system performance. * **Clearly articulate** a professional point of view on how to effectively, securely, and ethically integrate AI tools into the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** ================== **Required** ------------ * **5\+ years** of professional experience in full\-stack software development. * **Expert\-level proficiency** in Python for backend development (including Django). * **Strong** working proficiency with Vue.js (and typescript). * **Deep practical experience** designing, deploying, and maintaining applications using serverless architectures (preferably AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and managed services). * **Proficiency** with SQL, preferably PostgreSQL. * **Solid understanding** of event sourcing and event\-driven architecture patterns, including experience with message brokers or streaming services (e.g., SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kinesis). * **Experience** with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code. * **Demonstrated Fluency in AI\-Assisted Development**: Candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, hands\-on experience using AI\-powered coding tools to achieve specific, quantifiable productivity gains, while also clearly understanding and mitigating the associated risks (e.g., code quality, security, IP concerns). **Nice to Have** ---------------- * **Experience** with advanced AWS services (e.g., Step Functions, Kinesis, SageMaker). * **Experience** working in a regulated or compliance\-focused environment. * **A Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science or a related technical field. **AI and the Evolution of Software Engineering \& Ops** ======================================================= All candidates must be prepared to discuss and demonstrate the following during the interview process: * **Practical AI Tool Usage:** Specific examples of AI tools used in professional or personal projects to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, or accelerate development. If you have a preferred agentic tool setup, please share! * **Understanding of AI Limitations:** A clear understanding and articulation of the current technical, ethical, and accuracy limitations of modern AI tools in the engineering context. * **Strategic AI Opportunity:** A viewpoint on how AI tools create new opportunities for software engineering, such as shifting focus from boilerplate code to complex problem\-solving or architectural design. * **Evolution of the Engineering Role:** A well\-articulated point of view on how your role has already changed (e.g., new workflows, skills, ways of collaborating) due to the introduction of AI and how you expect the role to evolve in the coming years based on your assessment of coming advancements in AI tools and technologies. **Application Process** ======================= To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter. Your cover letter should be informed by the "AI and Forward\-Looking Requirements" section above. The hiring process includes: * **Initial** **screening email** * **Technical** **Assessment Interview** * **A Panel Interview** **Salary Range $140,000 \- $175,000** ===================================== **Benefits for Full\-Time Employees** Excellent health, dental, vision, and life insurance Excellent 401(k) plan with annual employer match of 4%

jobs.title: Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management
jobs.description: ### **Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!** Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance. **WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values: * RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered. * AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind. * LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives. * MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making. ### **Summary:** As we grow, we are seeking a strategic and collaborative Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management to ensure the integrity, accessibility, and effective use of data and knowledge assets across the organization. This role will execute component\-level analysis, utilizing data and knowledge resources critical to our process development, regulatory, and operational activities. The Process Engineer I, Data and Knowledge Management is instrumental in ensuring scientific data integrity, regulatory readiness, and the preservation of institutional knowledge in a dynamic, fast\-paced clinical environment. ### **Essential Functions:** **Engineering Analytics \& Process Insights:** * Assess process trends and discrepancies using engineering knowledge, and evaluate the technical rationale and potential impact of proposed process improvements * Apply chemical and biochemical engineering principles to evaluate relationships between process parameters, unit operation performance, and product quality attributes * Partner with data science team to drive data visualization, reporting, and insights. * Support the use of AI/ML and automation for improved data analysis and knowledge extraction. **Manufacturing Process Data Management \& Governance:** * Acquire, integrate, and technically evaluate manufacturing process data from internal teams and contract manufacturing sites to support process monitoring, continuous improvement, and CMC regulatory submissions. * Develop data management and verification workflows that preserve the accuracy, integrity, and traceability of manufacturing process data. * Lead and own data verification for all commercial regulatory submissions. **Process Knowledge Management:** * Develop structured systems and workflows to capture and retain organizational knowledge, including protocols, study results, lessons learned, and decision rationales. * Develop tools and processes that enable technical teams to access, share, and apply process knowledge to support manufacturing and process improvement. * Champion a knowledge\-sharing culture across technical, scientific and operational functions. **Collaboration \& Technical Leadership:** * Partner with regulatory, quality, R\&D, IT and contract manufacturing teams to understand technical needs and develop appropriate solutions. **Compliance \& Risk Management:** * Ensure compliance with data protection and clinical trial regulations, including GDPR, HIPAA, and 21 CFR Part 11\. * Identify and mitigate risks related to data security, access, and retention. ### **Requirements:** Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Bioprocess Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. 8\+ years of relevant experience in biopharmaceutical process engineering, Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT), process development, manufacturing technical support, or related engineering work, including at least 3 years in the life sciences or biotechnology industry. Other combinations of education and/or experience may be considered. * Experience interpreting manufacturing process data and applying engineering and statistical methods to evaluate process performance. * Proven experience leading enterprise data governance and knowledge sharing initiatives in a highly regulated environment. * Strong technical communication, project management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering, scientific, and manufacturing teams. * Experience with tools like SharePoint, Veeva Vault, Confluence, Tableau, and SQL is highly desirable. **Preferred:** * Experience supporting clinical trials and regulatory submissions (e.g., IND, BLA). * Background in immunology, vaccines, or infectious disease R\&D. * Experience in scaling systems and processes in a high\-growth, early\- to mid\-stage. **Reports to:** Senior Director, Process Validation, Global MSAT **Location:** United States **Work Arrangement (may be adjusted based on business needs, job responsibilities, or changes to company policy):** Remote **Compensation:** The compensation package will be competitive and includes comprehensive benefits and an equity component. **Salary Range:** $121,000 \- $142,000 **Relocation:** This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.**Equal Opportunity** *We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.* **Recruitment Fraud Notice** *Please be aware of fraud or scams from individuals, organizations and/or internet sites claiming to represent Vaxcyte in recruitment activities. Vaxcyte has an established recruitment process for all positions prior to issuing an offer for employment and we will never extend unsolicited employment offers or ask candidates to provide financial or sensitive personal information as part of the application process. All legitimate communication from Vaxcyte will come from an official @vaxcyte.com email address. Qualified and interested candidates should apply to current openings at* *vaxcyte.com/careers**.*

jobs.title: Associate Director, AI Connect Sales Engineering
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. Every AI model trained, every GPU cluster lit, and every inference workload served depends on physical fiber: dark fiber, long\-haul routes, and metro rings that connect campuses, power\-advantaged regions, and cloud on\-ramps. Hyperscalers and neoclouds are committing billions to this build\-out, and they will choose the partner that can design it right and deliver it on time. Verizon is building AI Connect to be the intelligent fabric of the AI economy. As an Associate Director, you will lead the experts who turn that ambition into signed, buildable, and profitable designs for our largest strategic customers. **About the Role** You will lead the sales engineers who design dark fiber, ultra\-long\-haul, metro and campus interconnect solutions for hyperscalers and neoclouds. Your team shapes route strategy, fiber count, diversity, latency and cost inputs before a deal is won, and makes sure what we quote can be built. **The Team You Will Lead** You will lead some of the most experienced people in the industry, typically with 15\-25 years in the field. Many have: * Come up through outside plant (OSP) planning and engineering design, and know what a route costs, how long it takes and where it breaks. * Led ultra\-long\-haul and metro fiber programs from engineering through construction and delivery. * Built cost studies and facility designs that balance customer needs against margin. * Worked inside carriers, fiber builders and construction firms, so they understand every hand\-off from the sales call to the splice. They don't need managing. They need a leader who is technically credible, drives innovation and standardization, clears obstacles, sets direction and makes them more valuable to the customer and to the company. **What You Will Do** * **Set the vision.** Build and execute the strategy for dark fiber and AI Connect design engineering so customers reach AI\-forward outcomes. * **Lead the design team.** Guide sales engineers supporting Verizon's top strategic AI Connect customers across a multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio, driving bookings and revenue growth. * **Direct world\-class designs.** Own solutions for GPU campus interconnect, data center interconnect, long\-haul and intercity routes, metro rings, and cloud on\-ramps. * **Set design standards.** Define standards for ultra\-high\-count fiber, route diversity, latency budgets, splice and handhole strategy, ILA/regen siting and phased growth for multi\-stage AI builds. * **Bring commercial rigor.** Evaluate build, IRU, lease and swap options with Finance and Product, and build ROI and cost models for every large pursuit. * **Connect design to delivery.** Partner with Network Planning, Construction, Right\-of\-Way, Legal and Operations so quoted routes are constructible, on schedule and on budget. * **Differentiate Verizon.** Equip the team to articulate Verizon's advantages across AI Connect, Dark Fiber, Lit Fiber/Wave and Edge Data Centers, and to be recognized as thought leaders. * **Raise efficiency.** Introduce automation and off\-load low\-value work so senior engineers spend time on customer\-facing design. * **Develop talent.** Hire, coach and retain top engineers, maintain certifications and build a succession bench. * **Build a public presence.** Represent Verizon at industry events, in thought leadership and on customer advisory boards. **What We're Looking For** **You'll need to have:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical discipline or directly related equivalent experience. * 10\+ years in engineering and architecting telecom, IT or network infrastructure, with deep expertise in dark fiber and the intersection of physical assets with AI/ML digital transformation. * 3\+ years leading senior technical talent, including workforce planning, coaching and performance management. * Proven record designing and winning large, multi\-year infrastructure deals, including technical qualification, pricing and contract negotiation. * Experience engaging senior executives and delivering effective customer presentations. * Demonstrated financial analysis skills: P\&L, ROI, cost analysis and business\-case development. **Even better if you have:** * MS or MBA. * Direct experience with hyperscalers or neoclouds. * OSP engineering, construction or delivery background, including ULH or metro fiber programs, permitting and right\-of\-way, and contractor management. * Knowledge of AI and GPU cluster networking, including scale\-out and scale\-across topologies and their requirements on the fiber layer. * Familiarity with power\-driven site selection and its effect on network routes. * Experience with IRUs, swaps, anchor\-tenant builds, SLAs and MSAs. * Relevant certifications (for example CCIE/CCNP, optical vendor or FOA CFOS). **Why This Role** * **Real scale and authority.** A multi\-billion\-dollar portfolio and the mandate to set design standards, hiring and operating model. * **A team worth leading.** Work with deeply experienced fiber, OSP and network design professionals. * **A front\-row seat to the AI build\-out.** Your team's designs connect the campuses where the next generation of models is trained and served. * **Competitive rewards.** Base salary, annual incentive, long\-term incentive, and comprehensive health and retirement benefits. **How to Apply** Apply through the Verizon careers site with your resume, and include a brief note on the largest infrastructure design or pursuit you have led and the team you built around it. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this mobile role, you'll primarily work from customer or field location(s), with occasional visits to a Verizon location for in\-person training and meetings.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. jobs.title: Senior AI/ML Engineer - AI Live Operations
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. **What you'll be doing...** As a Senior AI/ML Engineer \- AI Live Operations, you will apply your advanced technical expertise in data science, system orchestration, and software engineering to maintain the stability, safety, and efficiency of our deployed artificial intelligence models. You will be a key individual contributor within the Live Operations team, taking responsibility for the health of machine learning systems once they are exposed to real\-world datasets and production traffic. At Verizon, we are on a multi\-year journey to industrialize our data science and AI capabilities. Very simply, this means that AI will fuel decisions and business processes across the company. At over one hundred thirty billion dollars in annual revenue, this is a pioneering opportunity to build and scale production AI systems in the telecommunications industry. With our leadership in bringing 5G network nationwide, you will help us transition from millions of automated predictions to trillions of real\-time inferences. In this role, your responsibilities will include: * Building and maintaining real\-time monitoring and observability pipelines to track system throughput, latency, and token consumption costs for large language models. * Monitoring production model behavior to identify data drift and model degradation, ensuring our systems maintain high predictive accuracy over time. * Implementing automated continuous evaluation loops that capture user feedback and ground\-truth telemetry to dynamically assess performance. * Deploying real\-time safety filters, system guardrails, and input/output moderators to mitigate model hallucinations and prevent inappropriate content generation. * Integrating robust fallback systems, including routing failures to traditional rule\-based software systems or human queues, to preserve end\-user experience. * Developing automated continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines to retrain, validate, and seamlessly release updated models without downtime. * Resolving production model incidents as a senior escalation contact, diagnosing issues with live models, and shipping immediate hotfixes or prompt adjustments. * Collaborating with platform architects and core data science teams to scale backend architectures across cloud, on\-premises, and edge network infrastructures. * Partnering with peer engineering and development teams to foster technical alignment, conduct code reviews, and champion secure, ethical AI standards. **What we're looking for...** You are a highly skilled engineer who excels in the intersection of data science, software development, and operations. You understand that machine learning models are not static, and you thrive on solving the complex, real\-time challenges that occur once algorithms meet actual users. You are a self\-starter who values precision, system resilience, and clean, scalable code. You enjoy mentoring junior team members and sharing technical knowledge across the larger engineering community. You'll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training. Even better if you have one or more of the following: * Master’s degree in computer science, data science, electrical engineering, mathematics, or another highly technical discipline. * Extensive hands\-on experience deploying, monitoring, and debugging complex machine learning or deep learning models in large\-scale production environments. * Practical familiarity with MLOps frameworks and automated pipeline tools, including Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow. * Advanced programming expertise in Python, Java, or C\+\+, with a strong grasp of data structures and cloud systems such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. * Deep experience developing safety guardrail middleware, system monitoring dashboards, and telemetry systems for Generative AI applications. * Knowledge of distributed compute architectures, database design, and real\-time streaming technologies such as Kafka or Spark. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every even better qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer- Product Reliability Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us** Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. **Job Description** Every time someone taps, swipes, or clicks to pay\- Visa infrastructure makes it happen in milliseconds, across 200\+ countries. As a Software Development Engineer on the Product Reliability Engineering (PRE) team, you won’t just watch those systems run\- you’ll be one of the engineers building, automating, and evolving them. PRE is not a traditional ops team. We are a software engineering organization that treats infrastructure as code, reliability as a product, and automation as a strategic advantage. You’ll write Python, build agentic AI tools, manage data platforms, and contribute to the distributed systems that process billions of real\-time transactions. From day one, you are an engineer\- and from day one, your work matters. If you are endlessly curious about how large\-scale systems stay resilient, obsess over elegant automation, and want to launch your career at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, and global financial technology — this role was built for you. **Build Automation That Scales** * Design and ship end\-to\-end automation for deployment pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and release orchestration — code that runs millions of times so engineers never have to repeat themselves. * Write clean, production\-grade Python (and Go or Bash where it counts) to eliminate toil, reduce manual intervention, and make systems self\-managing. * Develop modular frameworks for release scheduling, validation, rollback, and reporting that integrate across the full software delivery lifecycle. **Manage \& Evolve Data Platforms** * Support the build, deployment, and operations of relational database systems, contributing to schema design, architecture decisions, and solution engineering for critical payment data infrastructure. * Gain exposure to real\-time event streaming architectures that support payment processing at scale * Perform database health operations including patching, upgrades, backups, and recovery to maintain the availability and integrity of tier\-1 production databases. * Optimize query performance through index tuning, execution plan analysis, and replication monitoring — targeting metrics like query execution time, CPU usage, and replication latency. * Automate database tasks and configuration management using tools like Ansible and Liquibase, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines that govern schema changes through TEST and PROD environments safely. * Build predictive and reactive monitoring dashboards for database anomalies, surfacing health signals before they become incidents. **Ship Agentic AI \& ML\-Powered Tools** * Build GenAI\-powered engineering assistants that automate deployment orchestration, release governance, and environment lifecycle management. * Integrate LLMs into observability, incident response, and developer support workflows, transforming reactive operations into proactive, AI\-driven intelligence. * Contribute to prompt engineering, model fine\-tuning, and agentic automation initiatives that position PRE as one of the most AI\-forward reliability organizations in financial technology. **Own Observability \& Platform Health** * Build dashboards, alerts, and metrics using Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or ELK that give engineers real\-time clarity on complex, globally distributed systems. * Analyze system performance and availability data and turn insights into infrastructure improvements that prevent incidents before they occur. * Contribute to self\-healing and auto\-scaling capabilities that keep critical payment infrastructure resilient without human intervention. **Engineer for Reliability \& Security** * Ensure infrastructure and data platforms meet security and compliance standards across cloud\-native deployments supporting global financial services at scale. * Support zero\-downtime deployment strategies and high\-availability architectures that Visa’s partners and billions of cardholders depend on around the clock. * Participate in threat modeling, vulnerability remediation, and audit readiness activities as part of a team that treats security as a first\-class engineering concern. **Collaborate, Learn \& Grow Fast** * Embed within Agile squads, working alongside senior engineers, product managers, and global PRE peers across sprint planning, reviews, and release discussions. * Document runbooks, SOPs, and engineering guides that make the team smarter, faster, and more autonomous over time. * Participate in on\-call rotations (with robust support structures and mentorship) to build the incident response instincts that distinguish great reliability engineers. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.**Qualifications** **Basic Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree, OR 3\+ years of relevant work experience **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field (2023–2025 graduates preferred; December 2025 graduates welcome). * Solid foundations in data structures, algorithms, and systems design \-you can reason about complexity, tradeoffs, and failure modes. * Proficiency in Python and comfort writing scripts or tools in at least one additional language (Go, Java, or Bash). * Foundational understanding of relational databases (RDBMS): SQL, data modeling, query optimization, and database connectivity troubleshooting. * Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments and meaningful command\-line fluency. * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and a conceptual understanding of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). * Understanding of CI/CD principles and how modern software delivery pipelines are structured and maintained. * Genuine curiosity about GenAI platforms and agentic systems (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar)\- hands\-on exposure is a plus, intellectual interest is a must. **Bonus Points:** * Hands\-on experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tools: Terraform, Ansible, or Pulumi \-even from coursework, a capstone, or an internship. * Experience with database CI/CD tooling, particularly Liquibase for schema change management across environments. * Experience with observability tooling: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, ELK, or Datadog. * Database administration exposure: backup/recovery procedures, performance tuning, index management, or replication monitoring. * Familiarity with Git workflows and modern DevOps toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD). * Academic or project experience with ML frameworks: scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain / LangGraph. * Understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, service mesh, or TCP/IP. * A GitHub profile, personal project, hackathon entry, or open\-source contribution that shows us how you think and build. **Information for US Applicants** Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program.**Work Hours** Varies upon the needs of the department. **Travel Requirements** This position requires travel 5\-10% of the time. **Mental/Physical Requirements** This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. **Visa is an EEO Employer** Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: At VyStar, we offer competitive pay, an excellent benefit package that includes a 401(k) Plan, an extensive paid technical and on\-the\-job training program, and tuition reimbursement\-available to all full and part time employees. Part time positions start at a minimum of 30 hours per week. We encourage you to become a part of VyStar Credit Union's family of employees. Senior Cloud Engineer ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT: The Senior Cloud Engineer will plan, design, configure and maintain VyStar’s enterprise Azure cloud server and storage environments and will lead the management and further development of VyStar’s private and public cloud infrastructure. The person in this role will work closely with the architecture team, development team, system engineering team and InfoSec team to design and implement cloud resources in an optimal manner. They will review the cloud environments to validate implemented technologies and improve performance and reliability by ensuring security practices are followed. The incumbent will also manage cost optimization and ensure correct structure and tagging are in place for cost awareness and departmental chargeback. This role will serve as a technical subject matter expert by actively participating in configuration consultation, vendor evaluation, and problem resolution of multiple systems. The candidate should have a clear understanding of how to research, design, implement and troubleshoot information systems, cloud technologies and technology solutions in support of business needs. Under limited supervision, the candidate will be required to effectively manage and prioritize assigned tasks and projects, as well as design complex multi\-system solutions to meet the needs of the business. They will be required to make recommendations in these areas with a high level of technical competency. Assigned hours will primarily be standard VyStar corporate business hours but may also include evenings, nights, and weekends to implement changes or for support purposes. This role also participates in an on\-call support rotation.**ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** * Responsible for day\-to\-day Azure cloud infrastructure operational tasks such as monitoring metrics and logs, responding to alerts, and system troubleshooting. Design, develop, and deploy modular cloud\-based systems. * Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure resources, including compute instances, storage, network configurations, and security. Participate in troubleshooting issues in the environment and takes part in the on\-call rotation with other cloud engineers. * Develop and maintain cloud solutions in accordance with best practices. Foster a DevOps mindset among the various engineering teams utilizing BICEP, ARM, Terraform and YAML templates. * Use of automation such as Infrastructure as Code to create infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to apply changes. Participate in production deployments with other cloud and software engineers. * Develop scripts and other automation to streamline cloud and on\-premises operations. * Maintain documentation of infrastructures design, related technical procedures, operations manuals, and other guidance. * Other duties as assigned by the supervisor * All employees and business units, as first line of defense, are expected to proactively help identify, assess, manage, and report risks within their domain of work. To enhance a healthy risk culture and support our growth for good pillar, employees will maintain vigilance in safeguarding our operations while ensuring compliance with regulatory mandates. The Risk team serves as the second line of defense by providing risk oversight and credible challenge whereas the Audit team serves as the third line of defense by providing risk assurance. Incumbent is expected to demonstrate each of the following VyStar Excellence behaviors in performing the duties and responsibilities of their job: * Focus \- Focus your full attention by carefully listening to and observing client or member. * Connect \- Consistently be friendly and approachable. Demonstrate your care. * Understand \- Listen empathetically and ask questions (70%/30% rule). * Counsel \- Recommend solutions based on your member’s needs and objectives. * Advance \- Ensure that member’s expectations were exceeded. * Verify necessary follow\-up actions. **JOB QUALIFICATIONS** ====================== **Education** * This position requires a 4\-year degree in Information Systems, Computer Engineering or a related academic area and a minimum of 5 years’ experience as a systems engineer or in a related position. Additional years of related experience in the field may be substituted for the formal education. **Experience** * 5 \- 7 years of Enterprise level work experience in Systems Engineering or in a related position with physical and virtual Microsoft\-based systems; ideally in a financial services organization (or related industry). * 3\+ years of experience managing a production Azure cloud environment * Experience with establishing technology guidelines based on best practices in enterprise level systems engineering. * Demonstrated ability to lead project initiatives from beginning to end. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills are required. * Understanding of IT, software development, and DevOps best practices * Expert knowledge of multiple Windows Server versions (2016/2019/2022/2025\). * Knowledge and experience in Microsoft Azure. Google Cloud or AWS (Amazon Cloud Services) a plus. * Experience with automation technologies and the ability to streamline processes * Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform. * Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and container orchestration platforms like Azure Kubernetes Services (AKS) a plus. * Experience with bash, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting language. * Experience with version control tools such as Git a plus. * Familiarity with Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment tools such as Azure DevOps * Advanced troubleshooting abilities across multiple technologies and vendors. Able to calmly provide support on bridge lines during outages. * Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, and VPN. * Knowledge of security best practices, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA), and data protection mechanisms in the cloud. * A solid understanding of the financial services industry and the laws and regulations that govern and/or impact the credit union is a plus. * A high level of interpersonal skills and social sensitivity are required. The candidate encounters employees on all levels of the organization. The candidate is a resource to the organization and must be an effective listener and communicator. The candidate must set the example in attitude, behavior, and work ethic within multiple teams. **DISCLAIMERS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** Nothing in this position description is an implied contract for employment. The position description is intended to be an accurate account of the essential functions. The functions are not all encompassing and are subject to change at any time by management. The work environment characteristics described are representative of those that an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. As required or requested, may exert up to 20 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. **VyStar Credit Union is not seeking outside assistance or accepting unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies or search firms for employment or contractor opportunities. Any resumes submitted by an outside vendor to any employee at VyStar via e\-mail, internet, or directly to hiring managers without a valid written search agreement with the Talent Acquisition / HR department will be deemed the sole property of VyStar Credit Union.** **No placement fee will be paid if a candidate is hired as a result of the referral, or through other means.** Thank you for your inquiry regarding our current job opening. Your resume will be carefully reviewed against the position requirements. Should your experience and skills match, you will be contacted by one of our Human Resources department staff members. Thank you again for your interest in this position! *VyStar Credit Union Human Resources*

jobs.title: Software Controls Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** **Join us as our newest Software Engineer II and make code that even our telescopes admire!** Are you someone who genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays?” Do you ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego? Do you communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something? Do you appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome? If so, apply to be our newest Software Engineer II! **What the Software Engineer II Does:** The Software Engineer II spends their days turning ideas into clean, reliable, scalable software—preferably without summoning any new and exciting bugs. They work with friendly humans across multiple engineering disciplines to transform napkin sketches and ambitious brainstorms into real, working features. They review code (theirs and others’) in a way that is constructive, kind, and ideally free of passive\-aggressive comments. They have room to stretch into new areas, experiment with tools they’re curious about, and grow their technical and professional chops along the way. They may also use previous robotics or control systems experiences to understand what design tradeoffs that may exist when updating our software systems implemented in EPICS (Experimental Physics and Industrial Control System). Tapping into any knowledge or previous experiences with motors and electric drives, embedded systems, or DFx would also help out greatly. In this role the Software Engineer II genuinely enjoys solving problems—even the weird ones that start with “so… this only happens on Tuesdays.” They ask good questions, share ideas freely, and collaborate without ego. On a daily basis they communicate clearly, write code thoughtfully, and aren’t afraid to admit when you don’t know something. They appreciate a workplace where the vibe is friendly, the work is interesting, and humor is very welcome.### **Why Choose W. M. Keck Observatory:** * Competitive starting salary * Generous benefits package, including 4 weeks of annual paid vacation * A robust 8% 403(b) employer contribution (with a 4% employee contribution) * Tuition assistance for dependent children grades K\-12 attending private school on Hawai’i Island * Comprehensive, employer provided health insurance * We offer relocation support for candidates moving from outside the area. * Be a part of a dedicated team working on the frontiers of astronomy. ### **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor of Science or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Physics, Mathematics or other relevant engineering or science field * 3\-7 years of experience in developing code used for observing tools, data tools, and/or general software development * Practical experience creating software applications with Python * Software applications with hardware interfaces * Practical experience of change control, build and release management processes * Unix/Linux shell scripting * Experience with communication protocols (RS\-232/485/422, SPI, I2C) * Broad knowledge of modern software engineering practices, especially in areas of re\-use and testability * Good knowledge of database design * TCP/IP networking * Fundamental operating system administration * Competency in C/C\+\+, Python, databases * User interface development with Java, Qt, React, or other GUI toolkits * Competency using O\-O paradigm and design patterns ### **About W. M. Keck Observatory** At the W. M. Keck Observatory, we approach our work with wonder about the mysteries of the universe and with deep respect and care for Maunakea – a mountain revered in Hawaiʻi and unlike any other in the world. For more than three decades, astronomers using Keck Observatory’s twin 10\-meter telescopes have vastly expanded our understanding of the cosmos through astonishing findings about our solar system, exoplanets, supermassive black holes, the evolution of the universe, and more. We are dedicated to the values of service and stewardship, while advancing the frontiers of astronomy, sharing our discoveries, and inspiring the imagination of all.

jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Financial systems must keep working, even as the technology behind them changes. As an IT Application Developer with the Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS), you'll update financial applications to support Washington's One Washington initiative and the transition to Workday. These systems support accounting, budgeting, and financial operations that help DSHS serve Washington residents. You won't be expected to learn these systems alone. You'll work alongside senior developers to understand requirements, design solutions, write code, and test changes. Your week will include Agile development cycles, troubleshooting, peer reviews, and collaboration with business and technical teams. **We encourage you to apply if** you enjoy solving technical problems, can explain your design decisions, and welcome feedback. You understand that reliable software depends on both sound code and a clear understanding of business needs. **Your first 90 days** are about learning the applications, development tools, and business processes. You'll review existing code, work with senior developers, and begin contributing changes. Within your first year, success means you can develop, test, and implement changes that support the One Washington transition. The opportunity comes with a defined timeline. There are two one\-year project positions, with possible extensions dependent on additional funding. You'll work Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with at least two days each week at Office Building 2 during your first three months. No additional travel is expected. The Olympia area offers access to South Puget Sound, parks, and trails, although wet winters and commuting conditions are worth considering. Still reading? Here's what you'll do. **Some of What You'll Do** * Develop and maintain financial applications and data interfaces. * Analyze requirements and design technical solutions. * Write, test, debug, and review application code. * Update systems and integrations for One Washington and Workday. * Troubleshoot production issues and application failures. * Participate in Agile development cycles and peer reviews. * Collaborate with senior developers and business teams. * Document system changes, designs, and test procedures. * Follow development, security, and quality standards. **Who Should Apply** Meet one of these pathways: * Seven years of recent professional software development and maintenance experience; or * An associate degree in computer science or a closely related field and five years of professional software development and maintenance experience; or * A bachelor's degree or higher in computer science or a closely related field and three years of professional software development and maintenance experience. Qualifying experience includes analyzing, designing, implementing, programming, or maintaining software applications. You must also have experience or training in some of these technologies: Java, C\#, .NET, Microsoft SQL Server, Transact\-SQL, HTML, CSS, or JavaScript. **Preferred knowledge, skills, and abilities** * Experience with C\#, .NET, JavaScript, SQL Server, or Transact\-SQL. * Knowledge of SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) or Integration Services (SSIS). * Experience with TFS, Azure DevOps, or Agile/Scrum. * Experience with application integration and production troubleshooting. * Ability to explain technical decisions and collaborate during reviews. **How to Apply** Submit: * Your resume. * Your cover letter. * Three professional references. Include details about the applications you've developed, technologies used, and your contributions. **Questions?** Email recruiter Kris George at kris.george@dshs.wa.gov and reference job number 08822\. jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Ideal Candidate** We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer who wants to leverage cutting\-edge artificial intelligence —including Generative AI, LLMs, and modern Agentic frameworks—to fix a broken healthcare system. The ideal candidate possesses a strong foundation in production machine learning, deep experience with cloud\-native GenAI architectures (specifically on AWS), and a proven track record of working with sensitive healthcare data. You thrive in a high\-impact, collaborative environment where you will design and deploy scalable AI\-driven solutions that automate complex billing workflows, detect fraud, extract insight from unstructured claims, and power our next generation of AI products. This role is eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement. Candidates located near the company office may be expected to work onsite up to 2 days per week. Remote employees may be required to travel to an office location based on business needs. This role reports to the Vice President of Artificial Intelligence. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and orchestrate Machine Learning, GenAI, and Agentic AI applications leveraging foundational models (via AWS Bedrock, SageMaker) for automated billing, cost prediction, and document intelligence. * Design and build production\-grade, scalable Machine Learning (ML) pipelines integrating Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic decision\-making workflows to process complex medical claims and unstructured data. * Establish end\-to\-end MLOps standards, automated model testing, and robust CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and release cycles of both ML models and AI services. * Define, provision, and maintain secure cloud environments for AI/ML services using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as AWS CDK or Terraform. * Leverage modern AI\-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or Kiro) to accelerate code generation, optimize Python queries, auto\-generate documentation, and maintain high engineering standards. * Develop APIs and microservices to enable seamless integration of ML/AI models into existing business applications. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (product, technology, operations, etc.) to align AI solutions with business goals. * Implement techniques to improve transparency in AI decision\-making, ensuring traceability and model explainability. * Ensure compliance with healthcare data regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, etc.). **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's (preferred) degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production ML, GenAI, and Agentic solutions enterprise\-wide for business applications. * Deep practical knowledge of combining OCR engines (e.g., AWS Textract) with NLP, LLMs, VLMs, and AI foundational models to parse, structure, and query complex healthcare documents. * Proven expertise within the AWS ecosystem (AWS Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS) and proficiency in Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, and modern GenAI and Agentic frameworks (e.g., Strands Agents, AgentCore, Kiro, etc.). * Strong foundation in algorithm design, data structures, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and ability to deploy ML models as scalable APIs using Flask, FastAPI, or similar frameworks. * Strong hands\-on experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like AWS CDK or Terraform to manage cloud infrastructure, paired with practical experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc). * Experience working with healthcare data structures (e.g., insurance claims, EHRs, medical billing coding like CPT/ICD, or EDI 837/835 feeds). * Strong understanding of HIPAA compliance, data masking, secure prompt/data handling, and AI safety guardrails. * You are intellectually curious, obsessed with measurable business impact, and naturally inclined to build better solutions. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently. * Must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future company sponsorship. **How to Apply** To be considered, apply through our official Career Site by clicking the **Apply** button and completing the full application. Only applications submitted through our Career Site will be considered. Applications submitted through other channels or third\-party platforms will not be reviewed.

years of professional backend software engineering experience. * Experience delivering and operating production software for complex business workflows, with demonstrated technical leadership across well\-tested code. * Demonstrated ability to interface with multiple product domains, particularly in developing backend solutions for resilient, high\-throughput data processing networks, task automation, and streamlined workflows to optimize business operations * Deep experience with cloud\-based infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) and distributed systems. * A strategic problem\-solver with the ability to turn ambiguous business needs into practical technical plans and communicate decisions clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * A proactive, collaborative team player, eager to take on new challenges, continuously learn, and adapt in a fast\-paced, data\-informed environment * Experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross\-functional partners through collaboration, sound technical judgment, and a focus on shared outcomes. * Strong commitment to embracing and leveraging AI tools in day\-to\-day tasks, ensuring AI\-assisted work aligns with the same high\-quality standards as personal contributions. *Learn more about our Software Org and how to be successful in your engineering career at WHOOP via our* *Career Framework**.* ***This role is based in the WHOOP office located in Boston, MA. jobs.description: **Schedule:** Generally Monday\-Friday, during regular business hours **About the role:** Windstar Technologies, Inc. is seeking a Web Designer and Developer to build and maintain client websites, adapt and publish marketing content, and improve website usability and search visibility. Most work will involve WordPress and Elementor, along with HTML\-based websites and AI\-assisted development tools. You will work directly with clients and carry out content and website priorities set by marketing and the CEO. Check compatibility, document results, and escalate complex errors or unfamiliar code changes. \- Test changes in staging and confirm backup and recovery options before production updates. Check important pages, forms, links, mobile layouts, and integrations after changes, including automated updates. \- Adapt, edit, format, and schedule marketing\-supplied blog articles and social media posts for Windstar and selected clients. Check business details, factual claims, links, images, tone, brand consistency, and relevant SEO fields; obtain approval before publication. Write occasional website copy or additional content as needed under the approved strategy and editorial calendar. \- Implement on\-page SEO improvements, including page titles, headings, internal links, image optimization, and approved redirects. Monitor website and search performance and recommend practical improvements. \- Apply foundational answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) concepts through useful content, clear page structure, accurate business information, and approved search optimization practices. \- Use approved AI tools to assist with coding, code review, troubleshooting, content, and documentation. Inspect and test changes after AI\-assisted review, protect client information, and submit code for CEO review before production changes. \- Improve usability, accessibility, and performance, including readable layouts, keyboard\-friendly navigation, appropriate image text alternatives, and efficient images. \- Gather client requirements, explain progress clearly, manage assigned requests, and keep accurate records of changes, testing, approvals, and outstanding issues. **Required qualifications:** \- Practical WordPress experience and website samples demonstrating page design, responsive layouts, or useful website improvements. Professional experience is welcome but is not required when relevant project work demonstrates your skills. \- Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, including the ability to edit existing code and troubleshoot common layout problems. \- Basic JavaScript knowledge and familiarity with how WordPress themes, plugins, and PHP affect website behavior. Sound judgment about when additional technical review is needed. \- Clear writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with the ability to adapt supplied material into accurate, readable content for its intended audience. \- Foundational understanding of SEO and awareness of how useful, well\-structured content supports search and AI\-assisted discovery. \- Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to explain, check, and test the work produced with them. \- Professional client communication, organization, attention to visual detail, and reliable follow\-through on assigned work. \- Ability to work in person in Culpeper, Virginia. **Preferred qualifications:** \- Experience with Elementor or another WordPress page builder and managed WordPress hosting tools. \- Familiarity with staging, backups, deployments, Git, browser developer tools, and basic PHP troubleshooting. \- Experience with search performance tools, web analytics, structured data, local SEO, or conversion tracking. \- Familiarity with accessibility, performance testing, image editing, or design mockup tools. \- Experience adapting and publishing blog or social content, maintaining an editorial calendar, or tailoring approved messaging for different audiences. explicit entry, exit, and handoff criteria so proofs of concept do not become unsupported production solutions. 3\) Architecture Enablement and Reference Implementation (20%) a) Partner with Enterprise Architects to validate target\-state patterns through working implementations rather than documentation alone. b) Create reference implementations for integration, API\-centered design, application decomposition, telemetry, resiliency, security, and other enterprise standards. c) Provide hands\-on technical guidance to delivery teams adopting approved patterns and help resolve difficult implementation issues. d) Identify where architecture standards are impractical, incomplete, or creating unnecessary delivery friction and recommend improvements. 4\) Application Modernization and Delivery Acceleration (15%) a) Assess legacy and vendor\-constrained deployment patterns and identify opportunities for full or partial automation, repeatability, auditability, and risk reduction. b) Help teams establish practical modernization approaches, including API enablement, modular decomposition, automated deployment, database change automation, and improved testability. c) Facilitate short technical spikes that reduce uncertainty before major investments or implementation commitments are made. d) Support knowledge transfer, pairing, and mentoring so delivery teams can independently sustain the resulting approach. 5\) Governance, Risk, and Operational Readiness (10%) a) Embed security, risk, SSDLC, change control, and audit\-evidence requirements into reusable engineering patterns wherever practical. b) Ensure experimental work uses appropriate controls, approved environments, representative non\-production data, and clearly documented limitations. c) Coordinate with accountable teams to define production support, monitoring, service ownership, recovery, and lifecycle responsibilities before handoff. d) Ensure proper policies, procedures, risk mitigation activities and operating controls are followed. Report gaps in policies, procedures, operating controls and impacts to member experience to leadership to ensure that member impact and risk is mitigated. Required Skills 1\) Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred. systems integration, DevOps, platform engineering, cloud engineering, or a closely related technical field. 3\) Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn unfamiliar technologies and create working proofs of concept. 4\) Hands\-on experience with source control, build/release practices, deployment automation, or CI/CD platforms. 5\) Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language, with the ability to read and work across multiple technology stacks. 6\) Ability to distinguish prototypes from production solutions and to design appropriate handoff, support, documentation, security, and lifecycle requirements. 7\) Strong technical writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex engineering tradeoffs to architects, delivery teams, operations teams, vendors, and leadership. 8\) Valid driver’s license and ability to operate a motor vehicle. 9\) Ability to pass background checks required for access to WPCU facilities or supported third\-party locations, where applicable. **Preferred qualifications** 10\) Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable CI/CD platforms, including build automation, artifact management, approvals, testing, security scanning, and deployment orchestration. 11\) Experience designing or consuming REST APIs, webhooks, event\-based integrations, authentication mechanisms, or secure system\-to\-system integrations. 12\) Working knowledge of SQL databases and database delivery practices. 13\) Experience with automated testing, secure software development practices, secrets management, configuration management, or infrastructure/configuration as code. 14\) Working knowledge of observability and reliability concepts, including logs, metrics, traces, health checks, alerting, and operational readiness. 15\) Experience in a regulated industry or with auditable technology controls.
